Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een data- of analytics rol
Ervaring met SQL en datamanipulatie
Bekend met tools zoals Power BI, Tableau, Qlik of vergelijkbaar
Kennis van Python en/of R is een pré
Begrip van datamodellering, ETL-processen en datakwaliteit
Sterk analytisch vermogen en oog voor detail
Communicatief vaardig en in staat om complexe informatie helder over te brengen

Een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring
Maandelijkse bonus + jaarlijkse bonus
Auto van de zaak of mobiliteitsregeling

Maandelijkse activiteiten en een hecht teamgevoel

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Hoor jij een vraagstuk uit de organisatie en vraag je meteen door? Bouw je de ene dag een dashboard in Power BI en analyseer je de volgende dag met SQL of Python? Als Data Analist in de energiemarkt help je collega's om zélf antwoorden te vinden, met selfservice én AI. Herken je jezelf? Lees dan snel verder.

Wat is jouw rol als Data Analist?

Bij Budget Thuis nemen we weloverwogen besluiten op basis van data. Jouw rol staat daarin centraal. Als Data Analist ben je de verbinding tussen data en de business: je begrijpt wat er speelt in een domein, stelt de juiste vragen en denkt kritisch mee over de beste oplossing.

We zijn altijd op zoek naar manieren om slimmer te werken. Daarom investeren we in innovatieve technologieën zoals generatieve BI en AI (denk aan Power BI Copilot en Claude). Zodat collega’s steeds vaker zelf antwoorden kunnen vinden zonder tussenkomst van het data team. Jij helpt die beweging mede mogelijk te maken: door business users te begeleiden, door te zorgen dat het semantisch model klopt en begrijpelijk is, en door te toetsen of AI-gedreven analyses betrouwbaar zijn.

Een ander deel van je werk draait om de Power BI-omgeving waar meer dan 200 gebruikers dagelijks hun inzichten vandaan halen. Je houdt die omgeving relevant, door alleen de meest waardevolle inzichten beschikbaar te maken en wildgroei actief te voorkomen. Jouw doel is niet om steeds meer rapporten toe te voegen, maar om ervoor te zorgen dat collega’s zelf de antwoorden kunnen vinden die ze zoeken, en dat de omgeving daarvoor betrouwbaar en overzichtelijk genoeg is.

Wat zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden?

  • Het gesprek aangaan met de organisatie, nog voordat er een ticket ligt;
  • Bewust kiezen tussen een dashboard, een analyse, begeleiding of niets doen;
  • Bouwen aan een betrouwbaar semantisch datamodel, met eenduidige definities van klant, churn en omzet;
  • Collega's zelfredzaam maken met selfservice, begeleiding of AI, zodat ze minder afhankelijk zijn van BI;
  • Eigenaarschap nemen voor de Power BI-omgeving: kwaliteit, consistentie en bruikbaarheid;
  • Achteraf toetsen of jouw werk tot een betere beslissing leidde, en je aanpak bijstellen;
  • Documenteren alsof je morgen vertrekt, zodat je werk altijd overdraagbaar is.

Wat breng jij mee?

Jij voelt je thuis tussen de data en de mensen die ermee werken. Dit neem je mee:

  • Gedegen SQL-kennis, om ad-hoc vragen snel te beantwoorden en anderen op weg te helpen;
  • Werkervaring met Power BI, van semantisch model tot rapportage;
  • Ervaring als data-analist, BI-analist of business analyst in een datagedreven omgeving;
  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar generatieve BI en AI, zoals Power BI Copilot, Claude of andere natural language interfaces;
  • De durf om nee te zeggen en dat helder te onderbouwen richting een opdrachtgever;
  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting;
  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi Meegenomen

  • Kennis van Python, of de duidelijke wil om je daarin te ontwikkelen;
  • Ervaring met het datagedreven maken van collega's, via selfservice of begeleiding.

Met wie ga je dit doen?

De afdeling BI & Data Analytics telt 14 dataspecialisten. Samen met je collega Data Analist lever je inzichten via rapportages en ad-hoc analyses. Drie collega's bouwen aan de ETL-pipelines, de rest werkt aan Data Science-vraagstukken. Samen leggen we het fundament voor datagedreven beslissingen in de energiemarkt, waarbij steeds meer collega's die beslissingen zelf kunnen onderbouwen.

Bij Budget Thuis kun je 100% jezelf zijn

We staan open voor verschillende achtergronden en perspectieven. Voor deze functie zoeken we bij voorkeur iemand die ons team in alle opzichten verrijkt vanuit eigen achtergrond en persoonlijke eigenschappen.

Waarom het gras bij ons groener is

  • Bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 4.100 en € 6.360 op basis van 40 uur;
  • Een 13de maand;
  • Budget Zomer vrij: in juli en augustus is elke vrijdag een betaalde vrije dag en daarmee 9 extra vrij(e) dagen (o.b.v. 40uur);
  • Gratis toegang tot OpenUp: werk aan je mentale gezondheid en volg cursussen om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;
  • Een werkdag per jaar krijg je om te besteden aan vrijwilligerswerk;
  • 25 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en als je wilt kan je nog 1,5 week bijkopen;
  • Pensioenregeling; Je spaart 16% van je brutosalaris incl. vakantiegeld. 11% daarvan spaart Budget Thuis en 5% draag je zelf bij;
  • Maandelijks ontvang je ClassPass-credits voor diverse fitness- en wellnessactiviteiten;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: je kunt kiezen voor een Swapfiets of NS Business Card;
  • Je kunt gratis gebruik maken van Budget Mobiel en Budget Internet.

Vragen & Contactpersoon

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze vacature? Stuur dan jouw cv en motivatie via de onderstaande knop! Heb je vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem contact op met Wouter van Ittersum via: wouter.vanittersum@budgetthuis.nl

Actively contribute to improving data quality, reporting, and data-driven decision-making

Contribute to various data and business intelligence projects within the organization

Eager to learn, independent, and proactive

Title: Data Analist Videoland
Description:
Jouw uitdaging

Als Data Analist bij Videoland speel je een belangrijke rol in het verbeteren van de ervaring van miljoenen gebruikers. Je zet data om in waardevolle inzichten die direct bijdragen aan de groei van ons platform. Door jouw analyses help je teams om betere beslissingen te nemen.




Wat ga je doen?

Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar impactvolle analyses en concrete aanbevelingen.
Je combineert en analyseert verschillende databronnen om trends, patronen en kansen te ontdekken.
Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere inzichten en praktische adviezen voor stakeholders binnen Product, Marketing en andere B2C teams.
Je presenteert jouw analyses en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier aan zowel kleine als grotere groepen.
Je denkt mee over de kwaliteit, structuur en beschikbaarheid van data en ziet verbeterkansen in de volledige dataketen: van dataverzameling tot analyse.
Je werkt nauw samen met andere data disciplines om businessbehoeften te vertalen naar schaalbare en toekomstbestendige data-oplossingen.




Wie ben jij?

Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig en krijgt energie van het oplossen van complexe vraagstukken. Je kijkt verder dan de cijfers en weet data te vertalen naar inzichten waarmee teams direct aan de slag kunnen. Je bent proactief & communicatief sterk.




Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

Minimaal 4 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Analist of een vergelijkbare functie.
Ervaring met het analyseren en combineren van verschillende databronnen.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
Ervaring met moderne data- en AI-tools, zoals Snowflake, Python en Claude of vergelijkbare technologieën.
Uitgebreide kennis van SQL.
Affiniteit met digitale producten, streamingdiensten en de Nederlandse entertainmentmarkt.
Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en oplossingsgerichte instelling.
Het vermogen om prioriteiten te stellen en analyses om te zetten in concrete verbeteringen.




Zo ziet de sollicitatieprocedure eruit

We vinden het belangrijk dat jij een goed beeld krijgt van de rol, het team en Videoland. Tegelijkertijd willen we ontdekken hoe jij denkt, samenwerkt en complexe vraagstukken aanpakt.

De procedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken:

Kennismakingsgesprek (1 uur) – We leren elkaar kennen en vertellen je meer over de rol, het team en Videoland.
Experience Interview (1 uur) – We gaan dieper in op jouw ervaring, werkwijze en de impact die je hebt gemaakt.

Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring kan hier nog een technische case aan worden toegevoegd. Hierbij zijn we niet op zoek naar perfecte antwoorden, maar vooral naar hoe je denkt, communiceert en tot oplossingen komt.




Wat krijg je van ons?

Een salaris tussen € 4.500 en € 5.400 bruto per maand op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring.
Een aantrekkelijke winstuitkering.
200 vakantie-uren.
Een bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering.
Een abonnement op Videoland.
Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden.
De kans om te werken aan een product dat dagelijks door miljoenen Nederlanders wordt gebruikt.




Jouw team

Je komt terecht in een hecht en ambitieus team van vier Data Analisten, een CRO Specialist en Team Manager. Samen hebben jullie één missie: Videoland laten uitgroeien tot het grootste en beste streamingplatform van Nederland. Dat doen we door data centraal te stellen in onze beslissingen, continu te experimenteren en nauw samen te werken met Product, Marketing, Tech en andere disciplines. We geloven in open communicatie, kennis delen en elkaar iedere dag een beetje beter maken.

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze functie? Solliciteer dan uiterlijk 26 augustus. Alleen sollicitaties die vóór deze datum zijn ontvangen, nemen we mee in de selectieprocedure.

We kijken uit naar je sollicitatie en hopen je snel te ontmoeten!

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst, Python & SQL - Energy Trading & Optimization, Amsterdam (Hybrid)

Our client is an Amsterdam based energy trading and optimization company on a mission to accelerate the energy transition. The company has grown to over 40 people, with a 12 person tech organization split across software, infrastructure, and data teams.




You'll work in a fully AWS-based environment, primarily using Python and PostgreSQL, turning incoming market and forecasting data into insight that directly supports trading decisions. This is a long-term, end-to-end project: you'll take ownership of making the underlying data accurate, validated, and usable for the business, with room to grow into more responsibility as a medior analyst.




Depending on seniority, the role is a mix of analysis and engineering, roughly 75/25, or 50/50: validating and benchmarking incoming data from external providers (including meteorological and energy market data), extracting insights from time series data, building dashboards, and shaping the data pipelines that feed the business's forecasting and trading strategies.




Tech stack

Python, PostgreSQL, AWS (Timestream and DynamoDB experience a plus), Docker and a bit of

Kubernetes a nice to have.




What we're looking for

5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst.
Excellent Strong Python skills for data analysis.
Hands-on SQL experience, particularly PostgreSQL.
Experience working in a cloud environment, specifically AWS.
An affinity, and already transferable experience for data engineering, as well as comfort with data analysis responsibilities.
A proactive self-starter who takes initiative and can work independently.
Knowledge of the energy market is a plus.




Hours and hybrid

Full time, 40 hours per week. 3 days per week in the Amsterdam office, Monday and Friday compulsory, third day flexible.




Salary & contract

70 - 90 K range depending on experience




Package

Fully covered travel allowance (NS Traject Vrij).
Sports subscription (up to €200/year).
Udemy account plus additional learning budget on request.
Monthly social activities.
Pension contribution.




Interview Process

Phone screening, on-site technical interview round, final interview with the Data Team.




Interested? Please contact me at j.vanbaalen@doghouse.nl

Title: Data Analyst HSE (Dutch)
Description:
Als HSE Data Analist gebruik je data om de organisatie slimmer en veiliger te laten werken. Je brengt informatie uit verschillende systemen en onderdelen van de organisatie samen, verbetert de kwaliteit van de beschikbare data en helpt om waardevolle inzichten uit cijfers en patronen te halen.

Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar wat er in het verleden is gebeurd. Je onderzoekt ook welke trends, signalen en verbanden kunnen helpen om vooruit te kijken. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met nieuwsgierigheid en weet complexe informatie te vertalen naar een duidelijk verhaal waarmee verschillende stakeholders daadwerkelijk verder kunnen.




Wat je gaat doen

HSE-data uit verschillende systemen en bronnen verzamelen, structureren en analyseren
De kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van data bewaken en verbeteren
Rapportages over veiligheidsprestaties verder ontwikkelen en automatiseren
Trends, patronen en afwijkingen herkennen en vertalen naar concrete inzichten
Nieuwe mogelijkheden onderzoeken op het gebied van AI, innovatie en voorspellende analyses
Verschillende databronnen en signalen met elkaar verbinden om nieuwe inzichten te ontwikkelen
Samenwerken met stakeholders om hun data- en informatiebehoeften duidelijk te krijgen
Bijdragen aan een meer gestructureerde en datagedreven manier van werken binnen HSE




Waar je gaat werken

Je wordt onderdeel van een centraal HSE-team binnen een grote technische organisatie actief in bouw en infrastructuur. Vanuit Bunnik werkt het team aan een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving en ondersteunt het verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie met kennis, expertise en innovatie.

Binnen deze functie werk je nauw samen met HSE-collega's en bouw je tegelijkertijd een netwerk op met stakeholders uit verschillende delen van de organisatie. Je krijgt ruimte om te leren, te experimenteren en nieuwe technologieën toe te passen binnen een omgeving waarin data een steeds belangrijkere rol speelt.




Wat je meebrengt

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Informatietechnologie, Data Science, Wiskunde of een andere technische richting met een sterke focus op data-analyse
Ervaring met Power BI voor data-analyse, rapportages en dashboards
Kennis van en ervaring met SAP
Affiniteit met AI, innovatie, voorspellende analyses, datakwaliteit en automatisering
Het vermogen om complexe data om te zetten in begrijpelijke en bruikbare inzichten
Een analytische, nieuwsgierige en leergierige instelling
Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en procesmatige manier van werken
Het vermogen om verder te kijken dan cijfers en verbanden en oorzaken achter de data te onderzoeken
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken
De motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen data en HSE




Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden

Meer tijd om van het leven te genieten: 43 vrije dagen per kalenderjaar
Blijf jezelf ontwikkelen: Persoonlijk ontwikkelpad met trainingen en opleidingsmogelijkheden
Flexibel werken: Mogelijkheden voor hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans
Goed uitgerust: Laptop en iPhone voor je werkzaamheden
Wij betalen je reis: Reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer
Extra voordelen: Onder andere korting op sport, privéverzekeringen en andere regelingen

Title: Data-analist
Description:
Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van het vertalen van data naar bruikbare inzichten? Vind je het leuk om informatieproducten te ontwikkelen waarmee collega's betere beslissingen kunnen nemen? Dan is deze functie als Data Analist bij het CIBG iets voor jou.

Wij zijn het CIBG, een uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van VWS. In het hart van de zorg, met hart voor de zorg. Wij verbinden de werelden van zorgverleners, zorgaanbieders en mensen met een zorgvraag door gegevens te beoordelen, te registreren en te verstrekken. In de vorm van informatie, registraties of vergunningen. Zodat iedereen kan beschikken over de juiste zorginformatie, waar je ook bent en op elk moment.

Het CIBG werkt de komende jaren verder aan het vergroten van de datavolwassenheid van de organisatie. De basis hiervoor is inmiddels gelegd met de inrichting van ons Azure dataplatform en de ontwikkeling van verschillende informatieproducten. Nu zetten we de volgende stap: het verder versterken van onze data-expertise, het vergroten van het data-bewustzijn en het slimmer benutten van data binnen de organisatie. Als Data Analist lever jij hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan.

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Publieke Knooppunten en Registers (PKR), waar je samen met collega's werkt aan de ontwikkeling van informatieproducten die waardevolle inzichten bieden aan de organisatie. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de wensen van gebruikers en de technische oplossing. Je brengt informatiebehoeften in kaart, vertaalt deze naar functionele ontwerpen en ontwikkelt en beheert dashboards en visualisaties waarmee data toegankelijk en begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Data Engineer, Data Scientist en andere collega's om informatieproducten continu te verbeteren. Daarbij denk je actief mee over nieuwe mogelijkheden en zorg je ervoor dat data op een slimme en betrouwbare manier wordt ingezet. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische en bestuurlijke omgeving, werkt zelfstandig en weet technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar oplossingen die aansluiten bij de behoeften van de organisatie.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden

Inventariseren van de informatiebehoeften van gebruikers en deze vertalen naar functionele en technische ontwerpen.
Ontwikkelen, beheren en doorontwikkelen van dashboards, data visualisaties en andere informatieproducten voor de organisatie.
Opstellen en onderhouden van datamodellen en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dataomgeving.
Samenwerken met de Data Engineer en Data Scientist om informatieproducten optimaal aan te laten sluiten op de beschikbare data en technische mogelijkheden.
Adviseren van collega's en stakeholders over de inzet van Business Analytics en het effectief gebruik van dashboards en rapportages.

Deze rol is zowel vanuit onze locatie in Heerlen als vanuit Den Haag in te vullen, waarbij we wel vragen om af en toe op de andere locatie aanwezig te zijn voor overleg of samenwerking.




Dit vragen wij

Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring op het gebied van Business Analytics en/of front-end development.
Je hebt ervaring met Agile werken, bent een proactieve teamspeler en weet resultaten te behalen.
Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van informatieproducten, dashboards en data visualisaties in Power BI voor eindgebruikers.
Je vertaalt de informatiebehoefte van stakeholders naar mock-ups en functionele en technische ontwerpen.
Je hebt ervaring met een Azure Analytics-omgeving, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server en beschikt over aantoonbare kennis van SQL en DAX.
Je bent in staat dimensionele datamodellen te ontwerpen volgens bijvoorbeeld de Kimball- of Data Vault-methodiek en kunt jouw oplossingen helder toelichten aan stakeholders.

Wij zijn het CIBG, een uitvoeringsorganisatie van het ministerie van VWS. In het hart van de zorg, met hart voor de zorg. Wij verbinden de werelden van zorgverleners, zorgaanbieders en mensen met een zorgvraag door gegevens te beoordelen, te registreren en te verstrekken. In de vorm van informatie, registraties of vergunningen. Zodat iedereen kan beschikken over de juiste zorginformatie, waar je ook bent en op elk moment.

Het CIBG werkt de komende jaren verder aan het vergroten van de datavolwassenheid van de organisatie. De basis hiervoor is inmiddels gelegd met de inrichting van ons Azure dataplatform en de ontwikkeling van verschillende informatieproducten. Nu zetten we de volgende stap: het verder versterken van onze data-expertise, het vergroten van het data-bewustzijn en het slimmer benutten van data binnen de organisatie. Als Data Analist lever jij hier een belangrijke bijdrage aan.

Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Publieke Knooppunten en Registers (PKR), waar je samen met collega's werkt aan de ontwikkeling van informatieproducten die waardevolle inzichten bieden aan de organisatie. Jij bent de verbindende schakel tussen de wensen van gebruikers en de technische oplossing. Je brengt informatiebehoeften in kaart, vertaalt deze naar functionele ontwerpen en ontwikkelt en beheert dashboards en visualisaties waarmee data toegankelijk en begrijpelijk wordt gemaakt.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Data Engineer, Data Scientist en andere collega's om informatieproducten continu te verbeteren. Daarbij denk je actief mee over nieuwe mogelijkheden en zorg je ervoor dat data op een slimme en betrouwbare manier wordt ingezet. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische en bestuurlijke omgeving, werkt zelfstandig en weet technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar oplossingen die aansluiten bij de behoeften van de organisatie.

Een greep uit je werkzaamheden

  • Inventariseren van de informatiebehoeften van gebruikers en deze vertalen naar functionele en technische ontwerpen.
  • Ontwikkelen, beheren en doorontwikkelen van dashboards, data visualisaties en andere informatieproducten voor de organisatie.
  • Opstellen en onderhouden van datamodellen en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de dataomgeving.
  • Samenwerken met de Data Engineer en Data Scientist om informatieproducten optimaal aan te laten sluiten op de beschikbare data en technische mogelijkheden.
  • Adviseren van collega's en stakeholders over de inzet van Business Analytics en het effectief gebruik van dashboards en rapportages.

Deze rol is zowel vanuit onze locatie in Heerlen als vanuit Den Haag in te vullen, waarbij we wel vragen om af en toe op de andere locatie aanwezig te zijn voor overleg of samenwerking.


Dit vragen wij

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring op het gebied van Business Analytics en/of front-end development.
  • Je hebt ervaring met Agile werken, bent een proactieve teamspeler en weet resultaten te behalen.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van informatieproducten, dashboards en data visualisaties in Power BI voor eindgebruikers.
  • Je vertaalt de informatiebehoefte van stakeholders naar mock-ups en functionele en technische ontwerpen.
  • Je hebt ervaring met een Azure Analytics-omgeving, Power BI, Microsoft SQL Server en beschikt over aantoonbare kennis van SQL en DAX.
  • Je bent in staat dimensionele datamodellen te ontwerpen volgens bijvoorbeeld de Kimball- of Data Vault-methodiek en kunt jouw oplossingen helder toelichten aan stakeholders.

Title: Club Data Analyst
Description:
This Is What Your Role Looks Like

Are you excited about turning building and facility data into insights that make a real difference to how our clubs run? Are you able to spot a recurring issue in a mountain of maintenance data and translate it into a number a manager can act on? Our Facility Team is expanding, and we're looking for a Club Data Analyst who will help our Facility Department make the most out of data and take club performance to the next level. You'll turn raw club data — starting with facility ticket data (preventive and corrective maintenance) and financial data — into standing dashboards, flagged issues, and cost/impact figures.

Your Responsibilities


Analyse existing facility ticket, maintenance, and financial data (mainly in Databricks) to identify recurring issues, root causes, and cost drivers.
Build and maintain dashboards, so managers have a standing, self-serve overview instead of one-off analyses.
Flag day-to-day issues and anomalies for the responsible managers to investigate and act on.
Evaluate the cost impact of processes and supplier performance (SLA adherence, benchmarking between suppliers, cost-per-intervention on recurring assets).
Write your own SQL/Genie queries and build new views and aggregations on existing data.
Projects: your scope naturally grows as the long-term data-landscape approach makes more club data available.


Who Are You?

You're an analytical thinker who can digest complex maintenance and cost data, spot trends versus noise, and translate them into a clear signal for non-technical stakeholders such as facility managers. You're a self-starter and proactive in flagging issues, without pulling the decision or the fix toward yourself.

Additionally, We're Looking For Someone Who Has


A completed Bachelor's/Master's degree (HBO/WO), in Data Science, (Business) Informatics, or similar.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Databricks/Genie or a comparable data platform.
Experience building and maintaining dashboards and a solid grasp of statistical analysis.
Knowledge of and experience with data related to buildings and Facility Management (e.g. maintenance, ticketing, asset, or supplier/SLA data) — a requirement for this role.
Affinity with cost and financial analysis (cost-per-intervention, benchmarking).
Experience independently building your own views/aggregations on existing data.


What We Offer You

At Basic-Fit, it's not just about work, it's about your growth. As a Club Data Analyst, you'll have the freedom to make an impact and develop yourself in a dynamic environment.

What You Can Expect From Us


Learning & Development: Unlimited access to GoodHabitz and LinkedIn Learning.
Career Growth: Plenty of opportunities for professional and personal development.
Work Culture: An informal, international, and down-to-earth environment. We value working together, so we work 4 days in the office, 1 day from home.
Innovation: Your ideas contribute to strategic projects.
Salary: A monthly gross salary between €3.500 and €5.500 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience and background.
Perks & Benefits: Travel allowance, bike plan, health insurance discounts, remote work allowance, and a pension plan (52% contribution by Basic-Fit).
Fitness: Access to our gym at HQ.


About Basic-Fit

Basic-Fit is Europe's leader in the value-for-money fitness market, with more than 4.7 million members across 1,650+ clubs in 6 countries. We are continuously growing and improving. If you're looking for a place where you can make an impact while having fun at work, you've come to the right place!

What Makes Us Unique?


Work with Impact: What you do makes a difference. We don't just work for our members, partners, and teams—we work with them.
Collaboration: Everyone works together to achieve goals and celebrate success.
Diversity & Inclusion: We welcome everyone into our workplace.


🎯 Apply Now!

Ready for your next adventure? Click the Apply button, and we'll get in touch with you as soon as possible.

Questions? Feel free to contact Yara van Bodegom at yara.vanbodegom@basic-fit.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




We bouwen met Just Good People een nextgen data team met leuke mensen met sterke data, AI, human & biz skills. Geen PPT-consultancy, maar datakansen kraken en echt waarde realiseren bij toffe klanten. En veel opleiding.




Zie jij in bergen info – naast getallen – vooral kansen? Wil je die liever omzetten in actie dan in rapporten die in een la verdwijnen?




Wil je maximaal leren door in korte tijd bij meerdere bedrijven in de keuken te kijken? Terwijl wij je helpen ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van data, business en people?




Dan hebben we de uitdaging voor jou.




🟡 Just Good People

Bij JGP hebben we twee simpele regels: We nemen goede mensen aan. En we zorgen goed voor deze mensen. Dat betekent dat we samen optrekken om jou maximaal in je kracht te krijgen op een manier die bij jou past.




🌱 Unieke data filosofie

“As machines get better at being machines, humans have to get better at being more human.”

Deze nieuwe tijd vraagt om een nieuw soort data professional. Bij Just Good People Data helpen we bedrijven versnellen met top notch data professionals met goed ontwikkelde data, business én human skills. En trainen je naar nog hoger niveau. Met aandacht voor:




Volgende levels in Data | AI
“Waarde denken” voor klanten/ gebruikers
Stakeholder management
Communiceren & inspireren




⚡ Wat je gaat doen

Je werkt aan projecten bij mooie bedrijven zoals Bol.com, Defensie, Action, Rabo, NS, AMC, ASML, Essent.




Denk aan:




Het maken van veel impact met data
Stakeholders meenemen in de kracht van data – op een begrijpelijke manier
Verbinden van mensen, processen en tech
Vertalen van data naar heldere inzichten, dashboards en rapportages die helpen bij besluitvorming
Signaleren van trends, kansen en verbeterpunten en stakeholders adviseren op basis van data
Meedenken over slimme oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken




👩 Wie je bent




Je bent technisch sterk maar ook nieuwsgierig naar de mens achter de vraag
Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken simpel te maken
Je krijgt energie van verandering en nieuwe omgevingen
Je wilt blijven groeien in data, business én human skills
Je hebt 4+ jaar ervaring als Data Analist
Je hebt een WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science of Econometrie
Je bent ondernemend en denkt in zowel risico’s als kansen
Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen strategie, business en data
Je durft vragen te stellen en bestaande werkwijzen uit te dagen
Je bent een echte teamspeler en communicatief sterk
Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels




🚀 Dit ga je krijgen

Vast dienstverband met goed salaris, bonusregeling en aantrekkelijke voorwaarden
Veel persoonlijke aandacht voor waardegroei, inzetbaarheid en “in je kracht komen“ als data professional. Maar ook data inhoudelijke mentoring.
Opleiding en kruisbestuiving met andere professionals in state of the art AI skills
De kans om in diverse keukens te kijken en veel te leren
Leaseauto of NS-Businesscard (ook privégebruik)
Gezellige borrels, kennissessies en team-events
Collega’s die naast slimme analyses ook goed zijn in slechte grappen




Wij zoeken goede data-mensen, die goede dingen doen. Van die types die je er gewoon heel graag bij wil hebben – net zo goed met mensen als met code!

Title: Data Analyst - Entry Level
Description:
At TCC Global, we create innovative loyalty marketing solutions that drive customer engagement and strengthen brand loyalty for some of the world’s leading retailers. Our passionate team delivers exceptional results through precision execution, strong client partnerships, and seamless operational processes.

As a Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics (D&A) department, you will sit in TCC’s client- and stakeholder-facing BI team. You will play a central role in proving TCC’s value proposition by measuring loyalty campaign ROI, analyzing the drivers of campaign performance, and translating findings into clear proof points and business insights that inform commercial and operational decisions. The role carries hands-on tasks across measurement, analysis, data pipeline building, and report development. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to deliver insights, scale campaign measurement, support commercial proposals, and optimize campaign execution through in-store and digital channels. Working day-to-day with Power BI, Azure ML, and AI tooling, you will help shift the business toward democratized, AI-served insights — delivered faster, embedded with stakeholders, and closer to the decisions they support.

The role supports the BI function within the Data & Analytics department, with the following responsibilities:


Measure and analyze campaign performance and ROI; translate results into proof points that demonstrate TCC’s value proposition, in close collaboration with Marketing.
Deliver business analyses that support commercial proposals, client conversations, and internal de-cision-making across Commercial, Delivery, and Operations.
Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests from across the business — turning open-ended questions into structured analyses with clear, timely answers.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
Develop and optimize data pipelines on TCC’s data platform (Azure).
Contribute to the evolution of analytical and AI-served tools (including Enterprise AI / text2sql) that put insights directly in the hands of colleagues and clients.
Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate analysis, pipeline, and reporting work.
Support running solutions — monitor pipelines and reports in production, investigate issues, and contribute to iterative improvement.
Apply data governance standards in day-to-day work, ensuring trusted, well-documented outputs.
Participate in agile delivery ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and share best practices across the team.



Must‑haves: 


1–2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role, with hands-on experience in performance/campaign analysis and dashboard development;
Strong analytical and technical skills across SQL, Python, statistics, Power BI (including DAX/data modelling), and cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure);
Ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments, collaborating cross-functionally, and using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis and reporting workflows;
Fluent English.



Nice‑to‑haves:


Exposure to Azure AI Foundry and broader modern AI/data platforms;
Experience in retail, loyalty, marketing, or campaign analytics;
Additional language skills such as Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, or German;
Strong curiosity for emerging AI tooling and continuous learning across the data and AI stack;
Practical experience with data pipelines, ELT/ETL processes, testing/data quality practices, and software engineering fundamentals such as Git and code reviews.



What we offer:


Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Opportunities for growth and professional development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas truly matter.
Hybrid working model.



TCC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered without distinction of age, culture, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnicity, or disability status.

Title: Sales Data Analyst
Description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:


Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Be the first dedicated analyst behind n8n's go-to-market motion.

Our commercial motion has two engines running at once: a self-serve product that thousands of developers adopt on their own, and an enterprise sales team closing the accounts that grow out of it. We've moved to usage-based pricing, migrated to Salesforce, and built a serious data foundation. What we don't have yet is someone whose entire job is making sense of the sales side of it.

That's this role. You'll own the analytics behind pipeline, funnel conversion and GTM planning, and partner with RevOps on the forecast - sitting inside the data team, embedded with RevOps and Sales, and in the room when the plan gets made.

Your mission: make our sales org measurably better at forecasting, prioritising and convertingOwn pipeline analytics, support forecasting


Build the models and views that tell us where pipeline actually stands - coverage, stage conversion, velocity, slippage.
Support RevOps on forecasting: supply the analysis and accuracy tracking behind it, and be the person leadership trusts to explain the number when it's uncomfortable.
Run win/loss analysis that goes past "price" and "timing" to something we can act on.


Connect product-led growth to sales


We have thousands of self-serve users and a sales team that can only talk to a fraction of them. Your job is to work out which fraction.
Build account and lead scoring on product usage and firmographic signal, with RevOps and the product/customer analysts.
Sharpen PQL and MQL definitions until reps trust what lands in their queue.


Shape how we plan


Model territories, quota and capacity for annual planning - and make the trade-offs visible.
Segment the base: which accounts, which motions, which segments actually pay back the effort.
Answer the questions that decide where the next euro of GTM spend goes.


Build foundations people trust


Partner with Analytics Engineering on Salesforce and product data models in dbt/BigQuery.
Standardise metric definitions so "win rate" means one thing across sales, marketing and finance.
Ship dashboards GTM managers genuinely run their week on - not decks that get opened once.


Bring a point of view


Sit in pipeline reviews and planning as a peer, not a reporting function.
Push back constructively, including on the numbers people are attached to.
Turn analysis into crisp, written recommendations that move decisions.


Must-haves


Senior GTM analytics chops: 5+ years in sales, revenue or GTM analytics at B2B SaaS, with real ownership of the sales funnel.
Sales metrics fluency: pipeline coverage, stage conversion, velocity, win rate, ACV, quota attainment, ramp, ARR/NRR - you think in these natively.
CRM depth: experience with Salesforce (or equivalent) - its structure, its quirks, and the hygiene problems that quietly ruin analyses.
Forecasting experience: you've built or contributed to forecast models and know what makes them defensible - here you'll support RevOps on the build.
Technical toolkit: expert SQL; comfortable in a modern warehouse stack (BigQuery, dbt, Metabase/Hex or equivalent).

Title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
Description:
How do you help bol make better decisions?

Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.

The biggest challenge

Advertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.

What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business Analytics

You'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.

In practice:


Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decision
Build and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and why
Dive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely on
Apply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't needed
Use AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagement
Coach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-taker
Write clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problems


Why you can make a difference

You have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.

Where you'll be working

You'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.

Something for you?


Story finder: You don't stop at "revenue is down." You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.
Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.
Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.


Nothing for you?


Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.
Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.
Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.


We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart


29 days: to recharge
Travel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging covered
Pension plan: 75% premium covered
Annual bonus: Based on sustainability goals

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Word jij enthousiast van het ontdekken van inzichten én het bouwen van slimme datagedreven oplossingen? Zie jij kansen om met predictive analytics, AI en moderne analysetechnieken betere beslissingen mogelijk te maken? En wil jij bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data- en AI-gedreven werken binnen Nederlandse Loterij? Kom dan in beweging en versterk Nederlandse Loterij als Data & Analytics Specialist.


Jouw speelveld

Nederlandse Loterij is georganiseerd in drie bedrijfseenheden: Loterijen, TOTO en New Business. Binnen Business Intelligence werken we aan de volgende stap in datagedreven besluitvorming. Naast het leveren van betrouwbare inzichten en dashboards, bouwen we ook voorspelmodellen, experimenteren met AI-oplossingen en ontwikkelen nieuwe manieren om de business slimmer te ondersteunen.


Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, data analytics en data science. Je schakelt met Marketing, Product, Retail en Business Control en krijgt de ruimte om niet alleen vragen te beantwoorden, maar ook zelf nieuwe kansen te signaleren.


Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen er beter onderbouwde strategische en operationele keuzes gemaakt worden. Je combineert scherpe analyses met voorspellende modellen en moderne AI-technieken om complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en aanbevelingen. Je werkt met SQL en Python op ons datawarehouse en lakehouse in Databricks en benut, waar relevant, externe databronnen en nieuwe AI-toepassingen. Zo bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie datagedreven besluitvorming binnen Nederlandse Loterij.


Je scoort in deze rol door:

  • complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar slimme analysevraagstukken;
  • analyses uit te voeren die verder gaan dan beschrijvende rapportages;
  • samen met collega's AI-toepassingen te onderzoeken en toe te passen, bijvoorbeeld met LLM's, Agentic AI of adaptive AI;
  • nieuwe en/of geavanceerde analysetechnieken actief naar het team te brengen;
  • collega’s te stimuleren om meer datagedreven te werken.


Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus Business Intelligence team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. We combineren klassieke BI met advanced analytics en AI. We geloven dat de grootste impact ontstaat wanneer analyses, voorspelmodellen en AI-oplossingen samenkomen in de dagelijkse besluitvorming.


Samen werken, samen winnen

Nederlandse Loterij is dé betrouwbare kansspelorganisatie van Nederland met acht sterke spelmerken. We zijn marktleider, expert en staan voor verantwoord, eerlijk en veilig spelen. Bijna alles wat we verdienen dragen we af voor een gelukkig, gezond en sportief Nederland. Naast een kansspelorganisatie met een maatschappelijke insteek zijn we een werkgever. Binnen onze organisatie werken we samen met ruim 500 toptalenten.


Door samen te werken en samen te winnen, is er altijd reden om te juichen. Binnen het Business Intelligence team helpen we elkaar presteren en gaan we niet voor het eigen succes. Onze verschillen maken ons samen sterk. Sport verbindt ons.


Jouw talent

De mensen die bij Nederlandse Loterij werken zijn nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en continu in ontwikkeling.


Jouw talent is een optelsom van:

  • een afgeronde wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science of een vergelijkbare sterke analytische rol;
  • uitstekende kennis van SQL en ervaring met Python/PySpark voor complexe analyses en voorspelmodellen;
  • ervaring met Databricks;
  • ervaring met statistische analyses, voorspellende modellen of experimentatie (zoals A/B-testen);
  • ervaring met DBT is een pré;
  • ervaring met BI-tools zoals Qlik Sense is een pré. Geen eis;
  • affiniteit met of ervaring in een adviserende rol, waarbij je complexe analyses vertaalt naar heldere inzichten voor de business;
  • nieuwsgierigheid naar de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen AI en de motivatie om deze praktisch toe te passen. Ervaring met generatieve AI, agentic AI of andere moderne AI-toepassingen is een pré.


Daarnaast beschik je over sterke analytische vaardigheden, ben je kritisch op de kwaliteit van data en analyses en vind je het leuk om nieuwe technieken te verkennen. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen uit te dagen en helpt collega's om data én AI slimmer in te zetten.


Jouw score

Als Data & Analytics Specialist bieden we jou:

  • een salaris dat ligt tussen €4.900,- en €6.800,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring
  • een interessante bonusregeling
  • een functie voor 32 - 40 uur per week
  • Voor €3,25 geniet je van een gezonde en gevarieerde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant


Ons kantoor in Rijswijk is in principe de plek waar jij je werk doet, maar je werkt vooral op een plek die het beste past bij wat je doet. Neem gerust contact op met Rani Adjodhia, Corporate Recruiter bij Nederlandse Loterij via rani.adjodhia@nederlandseloterij.nl.

Title: Digital Analyst
HTML:
Turn B2C data into sharper journeys, smarter trading and stronger growth.

Lijnden | B2C (Ecommerce, IT, UX & Online Merchandising) | 40 hours | Full-time

At Just Brands, we build menswear brands with character. PME Legend, Cast Iron and Vanguard each have their own voice, their own audience and their own place in the market. In B2C, growth is shaped by thousands of decisions across ecommerce, retail, CRM, digital marketing, site merchandising, site experience, IT, UX and marketplaces.

The challenge is not having more data. The challenge is knowing what matters, what it means and what to do next. That is where ecommerce performance, customer behaviour, trading insights and business intelligence come together.

But what really sets us apart is how we work together.

We’re team first. No ego, no unnecessary layers, no endless talking, no corporate theatre. We back each other, speak up, take ownership and keep pushing for better. We work hard, stay sharp and make sure there’s room to enjoy the ride too.

That’s where you jump onboard.

Why this role matters

This is where ecommerce analytics, B2C performance and digital decision-making become commercial impact. As our Ecommerce Performance Analyst, you support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels: Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and Marketplaces.

You collect, analyse and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency. You help teams understand what is happening, why it is happening and which actions will create better results. You are not here to build dashboards that quietly gather dust.

You are here to turn B2C data into decisions that teams trust, use and act on.

What you’ll do

  • Support data-driven decision-making across all B2C channels, including Retail, E-Commerce, Digital Marketing & CRM, Site Merchandising, Site Experience, IT & UX and marketplaces;
  • Collect, analyze and interpret data to generate actionable insights that improve performance, customer experience and operational efficiency;
  • Build, maintain and improve dashboards for ecommerce performance, customer behavior, campaign performance, trading, funnel performance and channel results;
  • Design forecasting tools to anticipate customer behavior, sales trends, demand patterns and commercial opportunities;
  • Provide performance analytics to senior stakeholders, supporting decision-making and P&L accountability across online channels;
  • Lead department-wide projects that improve data collection, data integration and financial insight generation across B2C operations;
  • Analyze ecommerce KPIs such as revenue, conversion rate, traffic quality, average order value, margin, retention, customer lifetime value, funnel drop-off and product/category performance;
  • Translate data into clear recommendations for Ecommerce, CRM, Digital Marketing, Site Merchandising, Retail, Marketplaces, UX and IT;
  • Monitor digital marketing and CRM performance across paid media, email, automation flows, campaign traffic and customer segments;
  • Support ecommerce trading rhythms with weekly and monthly insights on what is selling, what is slowing down and where commercial opportunities sit;
  • Analyze customer journeys and identify friction points across web shops, apps, landing pages, checkout, content and onsite experience;
  • Support A/B testing and experimentation, including test setup, measurement, analysis and learnings;
  • Improve data quality, tracking consistency, reporting definitions and governance across B2C;
  • Help teams understand the story behind the numbers by presenting insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What success looks like in your first year

  • B2C teams use your dashboards and insights in weekly and monthly decision rhythms;

Description:
Position Title:Commercial Analyst

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 44045

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

McCain feeds the world — from the fries in your favorite restaurant to the snacks in your freezer. Behind every commercial decision we make sits a question only data can answer: Where are we winning? Where are we losing? What should we do next? That's the work of this role.

You'll be the analytics partner to our QSR channel team, supporting the largest customer relationships in global foodservice. You’ll have access to our syndicated data, and rely on your creativity and skills to source new data. Your dashboards and analyses won't sit on a shelf; they'll shape how we work with customers, set targets, and place bets for the years ahead.

What You’ll Be Doing.


Sit with QSR sales leads to understand their growth plans, then build the data products (dashboards, deep-dives, scorecards) that let them track and act on those plans week to week.
Stitch together internal data (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) with syndicated sources (Datassential, Technomic, Circana/NielsenIQ) to answer questions.
Design semantic models in Power BI that hold up under real stakeholder use — clean DAX, performant Power Query, and reporting that people genuinely return to.
Draw on field and customer conversations to bring broader context to the analysis, so the story explains not just what happened but why
Lead the evaluation and onboarding of new third-party data sources when the existing stack can't answer the question.
Partner with IT and other Commercial Analytics teams so the solutions you build plug into the broader McCain data ecosystem rather than becoming one-off islands.
Translate analysis into story — the kind that lands in a customer meeting, not just a quarterly review.


What You’ll Need To Be Successful.


3+ years in a data analyst, BI developer, or commercial analytics role, working directly with sales, customer, or commercial datasets.
Power BI at a builder level — you've designed and maintained semantic models that other people depend on, not only consumed dashboards someone else built.
Strong DAX — comfortable writing time intelligence, iterators, and context-aware measures; can diagnose and fix a slow or incorrect calculation.
Data modeling fundamentals — star schema, fact/dimension design, handling slowly changing data, and knowing when to push logic upstream vs. into the model.
Comfort working across multiple source systems (Salesforce, SAP, Databricks) and a bias toward fixing data quality at the source rather than patching it in the visual layer.
Experience with AI development tools and comfort using GPT tools to write and debug code
Commercial business acumen — you can translate a stakeholder's vague ask ("we want to understand the customer better") into a concrete analytical plan, and you push back when the data won't support the conclusion they're hoping for.
Communication and data storytelling — you can present an analysis to non-technical leaders, defend the methodology, and make the "so what" land.
Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline — or equivalent demonstrated experience.
Preferred / strong plus
SQL — can read, write, and validate queries independently (joins, window functions, CTEs). You use it to check whether the data is telling the truth before publishing a report.
Experience in CPG, retail, or foodservice — especially supporting a QSR, grocery, or large-customer channel.
Hands-on work with syndicated industry data: Datassential, Technomic, Circana (IRI), NielsenIQ, or similar foodservice panels.
Working knowledge of Salesforce, SAP (ECC or S/4HANA), and Databricks — or comparable enterprise source systems and lakehouse platforms.
Experience working in a global or matrixed organization, with comfort navigating multiple stakeholders across regions and functions.
Exposure to Python or PySpark for data prep and analysis beyond what Power Query handles efficiently.
Familiarity with version control (Git), Power BI deployment pipelines, or other practices that bring engineering discipline to BI work.
Knowledge of the UK / European retail or foodservice landscape.

Benefits Of The Role.


Real customers, real decisions. You're not building reports for the sake of it. The QSR channel is one of McCain's most strategic, and your work is read by our top leaders.
Scope to build, not just maintain. This isn't a ticket-queue analyst role. You'll have room to choose tools, propose new data sources, and shape how we measure commercial performance in GB&I and Europe.
A data team that takes the craft seriously. You'll join a Global Commercial Analytics function that invests in modern tooling (Power BI, Databricks), values clean semantic modeling, and treats analysts as partners to the business — not order-takers.

Title: Finance & Data Analyst
Description:
Help us build the finance function of the future
Insify is looking for a Finance & Data Analyst who turns raw financial and operational data into clear, actionable insight, and who helps build how we do that. You get real ownership, a small team and a direct line to leadership. And the room to do it better than you are used to.

About Insify
Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

Technology and data are in our DNA, and finance is where a multi-entity, multi-carrier business either holds together or does not. That is why we build our finance function ourselves, with people who know how it can be done better. That means you.

Your role
You are good at what you do. You know how to reconcile a messy dataset, when a number deserves a second look and how to explain a discrepancy to someone who does not live in spreadsheets. What you are probably missing is influence over how that work is organised: the systems, the workflows, the good ideas that never make it out of an inbox.

At Insify, that changes. You work at the intersection of finance, accounting and data. You reconcile premium, commission and claims positions across our insurance carrier partners, build the dashboards and automations that keep our finance operations reliable, and flag anomalies before they become problems. You do this in a small, sharp finance team in a multi-entity, multi-carrier business, which means real responsibility from day one and direct contact with the finance and operations teams, and with leadership itself.

You get a complete picture fast, even when the data is imperfect, and you know when something needs to be driven to root cause and when it can be parked. You explain your findings clearly, to accounting, to operations and to the leadership team. And within your mandate you decide how you work: no bureaucracy, just your judgement and the freedom to act on it.

The best part of this role: you do not just report the numbers, you help redesign how the numbers come together. We use technology and AI to take the repetitive work out of your day (data extraction, first-pass pattern recognition, recurring workflows), so you can spend your time on the questions where a human really makes the difference: why does this number look wrong, what does it mean and what should we decide? You help determine what we automate, what we deliberately do not automate and how we strengthen our data quality and financial controls as the company grows. You build the solution, rather than handing it to another team.

And building means building. You write your own SQL to get to the data, your own Python to clean, reconcile and automate, and you use Claude and other AI tools as a matter of course to get there faster: drafting a query, debugging a script, turning a one-off analysis into a repeatable workflow. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do not wait for one either. Where something belongs in our production systems, you are the finance-side liaison to our data team and engineers: you translate finance's reporting needs into requirements they can build against, and translate what is technically possible or already available back to finance.

What you will do as Finance & Data Analyst at Insify


Extract, clean and reconcile financial data across our accounting, banking and carrier systems, including premium, commission and claims positions across multiple insurance carrier partners
Write your own SQL to query our data warehouse and financial systems, and your own Python to clean, match, reconcile and analyse data that Excel cannot handle well
Build and maintain the scripts and small tools the finance team runs on: reconciliation scripts, carrier statement parsers, checks that flag unreconciled items automatically, and pipelines that turn a one-off analysis into a repeatable, scheduled workflow
Use Claude and other AI tools as part of your daily toolkit to write, debug and document your code, explore data and speed up analysis, while staying accountable for the result
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools (for example in QuickSight and Excel/Sheets) that give the business real-time visibility into cash, receivables and payables
Identify trends, anomalies and unreconciled items in financial datasets, and drive them to root cause rather than just flagging them
Support forecasting, budgeting and cash flow planning with data-driven insight, including carrier-related working capital exposure
Automate recurring finance workflows (for example via n8n) that connect our operational tools to our financial systems
Partner with accounting and finance on VAT, insurance premium tax and other compliance-related reporting across our markets
Improve data quality, financial controls and reporting processes as the company and its entity structure grow




Who You Are


You have a bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, data analytics or a related field, and 2 to 4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting or data analytics
Experience in insurance, insurtech or a fast-growing scale-up is a plus; curiosity about how insurance works is a must
You have strong Excel and SQL skills; other languages (for example Python) are a strong plus
You have worked with BI and reporting tools (for example Amazon QuickSight, Power BI or Tableau) and you build dashboards that support real decisions, not static reports
You have a solid understanding of financial statements, reconciliations and key financial and operational metrics, and you are comfortable with general ledger structures (we use Exact Online); multi-entity or multi-currency experience is a plus
You reconcile positions across multiple counterparties (bank accounts, receivables, payables) and explain discrepancies, not just report them
You use AI-assisted tools for data cleaning, analysis and reporting as a matter of course
You communicate clearly in English, verbally and in writing, to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike; we work with an international team, so English is our daily working language.
You are critical and analytical, self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity in a scale-up environment
You see a process that could be better and want to change it yourself




What We Offer


A salary of 50- 70k gross per year, depending on your experience
A small team with short lines; you work closely with our finance leadership and directly with the leadership team
Hybrid working from our office in Amsterdam
Room for training (for example in data, BI or finance certifications) and growth as the company grows
Insify pension plan with a 6% employer contribution
Travel allowance for your commute
25 holidays per year, plus 24 December when it falls on a weekday
Up to 4 weeks per year of working remotely
A €50 Alleo budget per month, to spend on whatever you like: sports, food, whatever
Monthly drinks, a quarterly offsite, lunch-and-learns, and all the other fun things that come with a team that wins together
A MacBook




Apply
Does this sound like you? Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and a few lines on why this role fits you. No three-page cover letter needed.

Samen met je collega's bouw en optimaliseer je de data-infrastructuur en dashboards van Argenta. Je slaat de brug tussen techniek en business:

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

Shape the Future of Data-Driven Airline Operations

At SAS, data plays a critical role in keeping our operation running safely, efficiently, and reliably. We are looking for a curious and driven Data Analyst who wants to turn complex data into meaningful insights that help shape decisions across one of Scandinavia's most dynamic operational environments.

As a Data Analyst within SAS Operations, you will work at the heart of our airline business, partnering with stakeholders across Airline Operations, Ground Handling, Fleet Line Maintenance, Operations Control Center, Resource Management, and Global Line Stations.

You will join our Data Analytics team, where your work will directly influence operational performance, resource planning, and strategic decision-making. This is an opportunity to combine analytical expertise, business understanding, and storytelling skills to create solutions that make a real impact across the organization.

The challenges You will work on

As a Data Analyst, you will transform data into actionable insights that help our stakeholders make smarter and faster decisions.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Designing, developing, and maintaining insightful Power BI dashboards and reports.
Translating business needs and operational challenges into analytical solutions.
Identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through data analysis.
Supporting management with ad hoc analyses and decision-support materials.
Ensuring reporting accuracy, quality, and alignment with business requirements.
Driving process improvements through data-driven recommendations.
Presenting findings and recommendations to leaders and stakeholders across the business.
Turning complex data into clear, engaging, and actionable stories.


What Makes This Role Exciting


Work with data that supports the daily operation of an international airline.
Collaborate with stakeholders across a broad range of operational functions.
Influence business decisions at both tactical and strategic levels.
Be part of a team that is accelerating SAS's journey toward data-driven decision-making.
Help shape new analytics solutions and continuously improve how insights are delivered across the organization.


To be successful we believe you have

You are passionate about using data to solve business challenges and communicate insights that drive action. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, asking the right questions, and finding opportunities to improve processes and performance.

You Bring


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
A data-driven mindset and attention to detail.
The ability to communicate complex concepts in a simple and engaging way.
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
A proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation.


Qualifications

We are looking for someone who has:


At least 2-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong experience with Power BI and data visualization.
Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, and data modelling.
Experience translating business challenges into analytical solutions.
A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


It Would Be a Plus If You Have


Experience from the airline, aviation, transportation, or operations industry.
Experience with automation, data modelling, or advanced analytics.
Relevant certifications in analytics, BI, or data management.


Why SAS?

At SAS, you will be part of a company undergoing an exciting transformation, where innovation, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making are key to our future success. You'll work alongside passionate colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and see the impact of your work reflected in the daily operation of Scandinavia's leading airline.

Benefits

We offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travellers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional information

Ready to join us?

We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as we review applications and conduct interviews continuously. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we are unable to process applications received via email. All applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

We might use online tests and an on-demand interview tool to give more applicants the opportunity to engage with us.


Employment Type: Full-time (100%) position with a 6-month probation period.
Location: Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). We value in-person collaboration and expect you to work primarily from the office, while offering flexibility for remote work upon agreement with your leader.


Come and fly with us!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Coop Sverige – Together we make food-Sweden sustainable




At Coop, data plays an increasingly important role in how we understand our customers, improve our operations and make better decisions. With over 4 million members and data across stores, logistics and digital channels, we have both the scale and the opportunity to create real impact. To add to this, our data platform runs on an architecture suitable for providing agentic analytics!




Within our AI & Business Intelligence organization, we have built a modern analytics platform that we are proud of – and we are now looking for a Senior Data Analyst to help us turn even more of that data into action.




Om tjänsten:
You will join our Analytics team within AI & Business Intelligence, working closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists and stakeholders across Coop.




As a Data Analyst, you sit at the intersection of technology and business. The role is not only about answering questions with data, but understanding the problem behind the question, challenging assumptions and determining what we should actually do with the insight.




You will have considerable freedom in how you approach problems. We believe in building reusable, scalable solutions in code rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.




What you will do



Translate business challenges into analytical questions, solutions and recommendations aid all of Coop in decision making
Work with large datasets across customer behaviour, sales, assortment, logistics and digital channels and develop scalable and reusable solutions with any too you see fitting the purpose.
Build analytical agents, dashboards, ad hoc analyses or any other data product that democratizes our data.
Challenge existing questions and ways of working – moving from “can you analyse this?” towards “this is what we should do.”



Who are you?




We believe you enjoy operating at the intersection of data, technology and business. You are curious enough to dig into the details, but can also step back and understand the bigger picture.




You don't see an analysis as finished when the numbers are correct – you want to understand what they mean and what action they should lead to. You are comfortable taking ownership even when the path forward is not completely defined.




We believe that you



Have experience turning business needs into analytical questions and solutions.
Are comfortable programming in SQL and Python, with experience of PySpark or similar technologies and have experience working with version control, such as Git.
Have strong business understanding and can connect analytical findings to concrete actions and can communicate this effectively with any audience.
Understand fundamental statistical methods and when different analytical approaches are appropriate.



It’s meritorious if you



Have experience from a modern cloud-based data platform or Lakehouse environment.
Have worked with providing agentic analysis, analytics engineering, BI tools or code-first analytical workflows.
Have worked in a scale-up, technology company, consultancy or another environment where broad ownership is expected.
Have experience from retail, e-commerce or another data-intensive consumer business.



About us




The grocery trade is a stable, long-term industry, and Coop’s offering is essential to the transition toward a greener, more sustainable future. You’ll join a culture defined by humility, initiative and strong values, where we take joint responsibility and genuinely want to help each other succeed. Our office in Solna Business Park offers a modern work environment with great transport links, a fantastic staff restaurant, and the option of hybrid work in agreement with your manager. At Coop, we work for our 4.2 million members, making us by far the largest cooperation in Sweden.




If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson (Emil.Nilsson@coop.se) or the recruiter Andreas Nilsson (andreas.nilsson2@coop.se)




Welcome with your application!

Placeringsort StockholmDiarienummer FK 2026/026355
