Title: Senior Product Analyst - Consumer Experience
Description:
What We Do At Qliro

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What You Will Do

As a Product Analyst, you own the analytical thinking behind how consumers experience Qliro's payment products, not just running the numbers, but setting the standard for how the rest of the organization uses data. You'll work closely with your product teams and PMs, sharing insights and trends in order to improve our products. You'll work closely with tech, product, data and the rest of Qliro to build our consumer experience on data and insights.

In this role you will:


Set product strategy recommendations together with product managers, backed by evidence you've built yourself, with the consumer's experience of paying with Qliro as the throughline
Own measurement, reporting and interpretation of consumer-facing product performance end to end
Lead performance improvement initiatives across teams, including designing and evaluating A/B tests on the consumer journey
Run and shape the analytical forums on consumer product performance, and use them to spread analytical method, not just conclusions
Mentor and upskill less experienced analysts and non-analysts on data tools, encourage AI-assisted analysis, statistical reasoning, and how to ask better questions of the data
Challenge current business performance and practice proactively, without waiting to be asked
Take a full-business view, pulling from whatever database, system or study gets a clear answer, not just the one closest at hand


Who you are:

You're curious by default and don't wait for someone to hand you a question — you notice something off in the data and dig into why. You've reached a point where you don't just do the analysis; you also teach it, and you take real satisfaction in other people getting better at their own thinking because of you.

Your experience:


4-7 years of experience in product or data analytics
Experience with SQL, data preparation/data processing and visualisation tools (QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI, …) are a must.
A decent knowledge for how to perform data extraction and manipulation.
Expereince in designing and evaluating A/B tests end to end
Good at communicating and presenting insights from data analysis to any type of audience.
Bonus if you have experience in owning analytics for a consumer-facing digital product or conversion rate optimisation


Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age.

Title: Senior NRM Specialist, Data and Insight - Stockholm
Description:
Data & Insight Specialist at Arla - Stockholm

Are you passionate about turning data into insights that create real business value? Do you enjoy combining analytical expertise with commercial understanding and working closely with stakeholders to influence decisions?

We are looking for a Data & Insight Specialist to join our team at Arla’s head office in Solna, Stockholm. In this role, you will turn complex data into actionable insights, develop data and reporting solutions, and help our commercial teams make smarter, data-driven decisions.

How You Will Make An Impact

As a Data & Insight Specialist at Arla, you will play a key role in strengthening data-driven decision-making across our commercial organization. You will combine analytical expertise, business understanding and a strong data product mindset to maximize the value of both internal and external data.

You will own and develop a portfolio of commercial data products and solutions and work closely with colleagues across Category Development, Sales and Marketing. An important part of the role is also managing external data providers and ensuring that the data and solutions we invest in create tangible value for the business.

In this role, you will


Own and manage a portfolio of commercial data products, reporting solutions and analytical capabilities.
Integrate and work with data from multiple internal and external sources to deliver reliable and actionable business insights.
Develop and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and analytical tools that support Customer Marketing and the broader commercial organization.
Manage syndicated market and shopper data from external partners and ensure that data deliveries meet Arla’s business requirements and quality standards.
Own relationships with key data suppliers, including budgets, contracts and commercial negotiations with partners such as NielsenIQ, ICA Self-Serve, Matpriskollen and other market data providers.
Partner closely with Category Development, Sales, Marketing and other stakeholders to translate business needs and challenges into relevant analytical solutions.
Turn data into meaningful category, shopper and commercial insights that support both strategic and operational decision-making.
Conduct ad hoc analyses and provide data-driven recommendations on business opportunities, risks and performance.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve and automate data processes, analytical capabilities and ways of working.


What Will Make You Successful

To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical expertise, technical capability and commercial understanding, with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights.

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has


5+ years of relevant experience within business intelligence, analytics, data science or a related field.
A relevant degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics or equivalent practical experience.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, modern data platforms and both relational and NoSQL databases.
Strong Power BI capabilities, with experience designing and developing intuitive dashboards and reports from concept to deployment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, opportunities and business risks.
Experience with data process automation, testing and data quality assurance.
Experience working in cloud-based data and analytics environments.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and influence decisions through data-driven recommendations.
A solid understanding of commercial KPIs, category management, pricing and promotion metrics.
Experience working effectively across functions and stakeholder groups.
Strong communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage


It would be an advantage if you also have


Hands-on experience with Python, Spark/Hadoop, R or similar analytical and data engineering technologies.
Experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics or generative AI to business challenges.
Experience from FMCG, retail or consumer goods.
Experience working in an international environment.


Who are you?


You are curious and commercially minded, with a strong interest in what drives business performance.
You are proactive, take ownership and are comfortable driving work forward independently
You build trust and strong relationships across functions and levels of the organization.
You communicate complex insights clearly and use data to influence, challenge and support decision-making.
You combine attention to detail with a broader business perspective and a continuous learning mindset.


What do we offer?

At Arla Foods, we are committed to creating the conditions for a sustainable work life. Through our flexible working model, Power of the Mix, we combine the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work, balancing the needs of both the business and our employees.

We are equally committed to helping our people grow. You'll have opportunities to develop your professional skills, take on new challenges, and build your career within a collaborative and supportive international organization. Our culture is built on trust, cooperation, and a shared ambition to make a meaningful impact.

By joining Arla, you'll become part of a market-leading dairy company and a farmer-owned cooperative, producing trusted household brands enjoyed by millions every day. Together, we strive to create nutritious products and sustainable solutions that make a positive difference for our customers, our owners, and society as a whole.

Arla Foods has collective agreements, and we always ensure to offer good and competitive working conditions. In addition to that, safety and working environment are our top priorities, which is why we, among other things, conduct random drug and alcohol tests.

Create the Future. Grow with Arla.

Would you like to join us?

If you're passionate about turning data into insights and business value, we'd love to hear from you. Take this opportunity to join a team where your expertise can help shape decision-making and drive commercial success.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-15. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Please note that we are not able to process any applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

If you have questions or would like more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Mikael Augustinson at miaug@arlafoods.com. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Hannah Lagerstedt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hannah.lagerstedt@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

We are looking for a Data & Insight Specialist to join our team at Arla’s head office in Solna, Stockholm. In this role, you will turn complex data into actionable insights, develop data and reporting solutions, and help our commercial teams make smarter, data-driven decisions.

How You Will Make An Impact

As a Data & Insight Specialist at Arla, you will play a key role in strengthening data-driven decision-making across our commercial organization. You will combine analytical expertise, business understanding and a strong data product mindset to maximize the value of both internal and external data.

You will own and develop a portfolio of commercial data products and solutions and work closely with colleagues across Category Development, Sales and Marketing. An important part of the role is also managing external data providers and ensuring that the data and solutions we invest in create tangible value for the business.

In this role, you will

  • Own and manage a portfolio of commercial data products, reporting solutions and analytical capabilities.
  • Integrate and work with data from multiple internal and external sources to deliver reliable and actionable business insights.
  • Develop and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and analytical tools that support Customer Marketing and the broader commercial organization.
  • Manage syndicated market and shopper data from external partners and ensure that data deliveries meet Arla’s business requirements and quality standards.
  • Own relationships with key data suppliers, including budgets, contracts and commercial negotiations with partners such as NielsenIQ, ICA Self-Serve, Matpriskollen and other market data providers.
  • Partner closely with Category Development, Sales, Marketing and other stakeholders to translate business needs and challenges into relevant analytical solutions.
  • Turn data into meaningful category, shopper and commercial insights that support both strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses and provide data-driven recommendations on business opportunities, risks and performance.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve and automate data processes, analytical capabilities and ways of working.

What Will Make You Successful

To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical expertise, technical capability and commercial understanding, with the ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights.

We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

  • 5+ years of relevant experience within business intelligence, analytics, data science or a related field.
  • A relevant degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, modern data platforms and both relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Strong Power BI capabilities, with experience designing and developing intuitive dashboards and reports from concept to deployment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, opportunities and business risks.
  • Experience with data process automation, testing and data quality assurance.
  • Experience working in cloud-based data and analytics environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trust and influence decisions through data-driven recommendations.
  • A solid understanding of commercial KPIs, category management, pricing and promotion metrics.
  • Experience working effectively across functions and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage

It would be an advantage if you also have

  • Hands-on experience with Python, Spark/Hadoop, R or similar analytical and data engineering technologies.
  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics or generative AI to business challenges.
  • Experience from FMCG, retail or consumer goods.
  • Experience working in an international environment.

Who are you?

  • You are curious and commercially minded, with a strong interest in what drives business performance.
  • You are proactive, take ownership and are comfortable driving work forward independently
  • You build trust and strong relationships across functions and levels of the organization.
  • You communicate complex insights clearly and use data to influence, challenge and support decision-making.
  • You combine attention to detail with a broader business perspective and a continuous learning mindset.

What do we offer?

At Arla Foods, we are committed to creating the conditions for a sustainable work life. Through our flexible working model, Power of the Mix, we combine the benefits of office collaboration with the flexibility of remote work, balancing the needs of both the business and our employees.

We are equally committed to helping our people grow. You'll have opportunities to develop your professional skills, take on new challenges, and build your career within a collaborative and supportive international organization. Our culture is built on trust, cooperation, and a shared ambition to make a meaningful impact.

By joining Arla, you'll become part of a market-leading dairy company and a farmer-owned cooperative, producing trusted household brands enjoyed by millions every day. Together, we strive to create nutritious products and sustainable solutions that make a positive difference for our customers, our owners, and society as a whole.

Arla Foods has collective agreements, and we always ensure to offer good and competitive working conditions. In addition to that, safety and working environment are our top priorities, which is why we, among other things, conduct random drug and alcohol tests.

Create the Future. Grow with Arla.

Would you like to join us?

If you're passionate about turning data into insights and business value, we'd love to hear from you. Take this opportunity to join a team where your expertise can help shape decision-making and drive commercial success.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-15. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Please note that we are not able to process any applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.

If you have questions or would like more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Mikael Augustinson at miaug@arlafoods.com. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Hannah Lagerstedt, Talent Acquisition Partner, hannah.lagerstedt@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Title: Försäljningsanalytiker
Description:
För En Hållbar Framtid Tillsammans

Coop är Sveriges största kooperation och en ledande aktör inom dagligvaruhandeln, med över 4 miljoner medlemmar. Vi har ett stort fokus på hållbarhet och arbetar för att skapa en mer grön och rättvis framtid genom att erbjuda hållbara produkter och tjänster.

Vi tror på att en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter är nyckeln till att skapa en mer inkluderande och framgångsrik arbetsplats. Därför välkomnar vi alla oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund och etnisk tillhörighet.

Vill du använda data och analys för att påverka kommersiella beslut och bidra till ökad försäljning och lönsamhet på Coop?

Vi söker nu en Försäljningsanalytiker som vill bidra med faktabaserade insikter och skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag för vår kommersiella verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan försäljning, kategori, kampanj och analys och som vill se ett tydligt samband mellan analys, beslut och resultat.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta nära affären och bidra till att våra prioriteringar baseras på stabil försäljningsdata, tydliga KPI:er och jämförbar effektmätning.

Om Tjänsten

Som Försäljningsanalytiker ansvarar du för att ta fram försäljningsanalyser som ligger till grund för organisationens förslag, beslut och uppföljning inom bland annat format, erbjudande, kategori och kampanj.

Du arbetar med att identifiera avvikelser, möjligheter och samband i försäljningsdata samt synliggöra vilka initiativ som driver försäljning, volym och marginal. Analysen ska inte bara beskriva vad som har hänt, utan också ge verksamheten tydliga insikter om vilka åtgärder och prioriteringar som kan skapa effekt framåt.

Du Kommer Bland Annat Att


följa och analysera försäljning, volym, marginal och andra relevanta KPI:er
ta fram analyser och beslutsunderlag inom format, erbjudande, kategori och kampanj
utveckla och kvalitetssäkra dashboards, rapporter och löpande resultatuppföljning
genomföra effektanalyser och utvärdera genomförda kampanjer och kommersiella initiativ
identifiera avvikelser, trender och förbättringsmöjligheter i försäljningsdata
synliggöra vilka aktiviteter och initiativ som driver försäljning och lönsamhet
presentera komplexa analyser på ett tydligt, pedagogiskt och handlingsorienterat sätt
kravställa datadefinitioner och bidra till jämförbara och tillförlitliga beslutsunderlag
initiera fördjupade analyser och eskalera databrister när underlaget inte håller tillräcklig kvalitet
samarbeta nära kommersiell samordning, säljstyrning, erbjudandeansvariga samt Kategori & Inköp.


Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken på vad som ligger bakom siffrorna. Du har ett tydligt kommersiellt perspektiv och förstår hur försäljning, kategori, erbjudande och kampanj hänger ihop.

Du tycker om att fördjupa dig i data, men är samtidigt skicklig på att lyfta blicken och förklara vad analysen faktiskt innebär för verksamheten. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna göra komplex information begriplig och omvandla analys till konkreta rekommendationer som andra kan agera på.

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket gör att du behöver vara kommunikativ, samarbetsorienterad och trygg i att ställa frågor, kravställa underlag och utmana befintliga slutsatser när data visar på andra möjligheter.

Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har


akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, statistik, dataanalys eller motsvarande
cirka 3–7 års erfarenhet av försäljningsanalys, Business Intelligence eller liknande arbete inom retail
god förståelse för försäljning, kategori, erbjudande och kampanj
mycket god analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta med stora datamängder
erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta med KPI:er, dashboards, rapportering och effektmätning
god förmåga att visualisera data och presentera analyser på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt
förmåga att omsätta data och analys till konkreta affärsinsikter och rekommendationer
god kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika delar av en kommersiell organisation.


Erfarenhet från dagligvaruhandel, retail eller FMCG är meriterande.

Varför Coop?

På Coop får du arbeta i en verksamhet där försäljning, kundbeteenden och kommersiella förutsättningar förändras snabbt. Rätt analys kan göra tydlig skillnad för våra prioriteringar, vårt erbjudande och våra resultat.

Du får en central roll nära verksamheten, med stora möjligheter att bidra till hur vi följer upp och utvecklar affären. Genom stabila dataunderlag, tydliga KPI:er och relevanta analyser hjälper du organisationen att fatta välgrundade beslut och skapa ökad försäljning, lönsamhet och kundnytta.

Så Ansöker Du

Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, senast 23/9, då vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer. För att rättvist matcha kandidater med de krav som rollen ställer kommer vi att använda tester under urvalsarbetet.

Title: Customer Lifecycle Analyst
Description:
We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.


Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex customer and lifecycle data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions and customer growth - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!







We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our lifecycle marketing and personalization capabilities to the next level. We need a proactive Customer Lifecycle Analyst to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our Omnichannel and CRM teams. 



Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is dedicated to driving real commercial value across our customer lifecycle journeys and personalized CRM efforts.






What you will be doing


As our Customer Lifecycle Analyst, your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our customer data, map behavior across lifecycle stages (onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation), and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed. 



A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Omnichannel team – led by Bjørnhild Kjørsvik (Head of Omnichannel) – providing them with the actionable insights, segmentation logic, and experimentation rigor needed to optimize relevance and customer lifetime value.



(We’re not looking for a static dashboard generator, but we do value foundational analytical hygiene. You own your data domain end-to-end: from building the pragmatic dashboards and streamlining monthly reporting that keep us grounded, to telling the commercial story behind the numbers.) 

Dig into the "why" behind customer behavior shifts, lifecycle drop-offs, and retention metrics (LTV, churn). You proactively spot anomalies and trends across our customer journeys and bring these insights to light. 
Streamline our recurring monthly lifecycle reporting and create clean, reliable dashboards/data structures that keep the Omnichannel team self-sufficient and aligned on core KPIs.
Independently design and analyze A/B tests and customer segmentations. Ensure statistical rigor and commercial impact while shifting CRM from tactical campaigns to data-driven lifecycle management. 
Drive initiatives proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions ("Have we looked into this?"), and run with them.
Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.




Who we think you are


You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical, analytical foundation with a deep understanding of CRM and customer lifecycle mechanics. 



You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When you spot anomalous data or hidden patterns in the member base, you react with curiosity—using your analytical skills and proactive mindset to connect the dots and drive clarity. 

Proven experience in CRM Analytics, Lifecycle Analytics, or Customer Data Analytics (around 5+ years of experience). Solid grasp of customer lifetime value, retention strategies, and personalization frameworks
Proficiency in SQL, visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau, or GA4), and hands-on experience working with customer data platforms (CDP) or CRM automation tools (e.g., Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot)
Strong background in experimental design (A/B testing) and segmentation methodologies






Details: 
You will report to Dianne Robillos, as part of her Commercial Insights & Personalization team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
Location: Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).
Working Language: Swedish, Norwegian, or English.






What we can offer you

A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling. 
Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family! 
Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.

Title: Analyskonsult – från affärsfråga till insikt
Description:
Söker du en roll där affärsfokus alltid kommer först – och där AI redan är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar analyslösningar?




Vi söker nya kollegor till Stockholm.

Den här rollen handlar om att göra data begriplig och användbar. Oavsett om du skapar dashboards, stöttar beslutsfattande eller hjälper till att definiera vilka visualiseringar som passar bäst för problemet – vi söker någon som ser helheten och inte är rädd för att dyka ner i detaljerna




Vi söker dig som har både öga för design och förståelse för data, och som brinner för att göra information tillgänglig och användbar.




Vad du får göra hos oss

Du kommer att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder och verkligen förstå deras behov på djupet. Du omsätter affärsfrågor till datadrivna analyser, prognoser och beslutsstöd som gör skillnad i vardagen. En viktig del av ditt arbete blir att utforma dashboards och rapporter som inte bara ser bra ut i teorin, utan faktiskt används och skapar värde.

Du kommer att:

Arbeta med moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker m.fl.) och bygga lösningar i SQL, Python eller liknande.
Vara en del av hur AI förstärker analytics – exempelvis i prediktiva modeller och automatiserad analys.
Utveckla dig själv och bidra till kunskapsdelning i vårt starka community av data- och AI-specialister.




Vi är ett team av passionerade experter som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och skapar värde tillsammans. Här får du frihet att påverka och en kultur där nyfikenhet och samarbete står i centrum.




Vi tror att du har med dig

Vi letar efter en erfaren BI- och analysspecialist som vill göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med oss. Du har en stark förståelse för affärsprocesser och vet hur man omvandlar dem till smarta datalösningar som skapar värde. Hos oss får du arbeta med moderna verktyg, utveckla din kompetens och bidra till ett öppet och kunskapsdelande community.

Vi tror att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta med analys/BI, som konsult eller internt
Förmåga att förstå affärsprocesser och översätta dem till datadrivna lösningar
Vana att skapa analyser och visualiseringar som används för beslut
Djup kompetens i moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) samt SQL

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Craft:

Job Description:

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join the Player Value team on Candy Crush Saga. You will own the analytics and operational support that helps the team understand player behaviour, run better experiments, and make faster, sharper decisions. Your primary focus will most likely be the In-App Purchases (IAP) area, though the role may span other parts of the player journey — early funnel, communication systems, or the in-game economy — as priorities evolve.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely independent and analytically driven: comfortable owning the experimentation lifecycle end to end, partnering closely with Product Managers, translating messy data into clear recommendations, and rolling up their sleeves on operational work at Candy scale without balking at it. You will work cross-functionally every day and gain hands-on exposure to AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, which the team actively uses to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom


Own the experimentation lifecycle end to end for your area — from problem formulation and hypothesis design through analysis, readout, recommendation and follow-up.
Perform quantitative (and, where useful, qualitative) analysis of player behaviour to identify opportunities to improve monetisation, retention and player experience.
Turn complex data into clear insights, recommendations and narratives that Product Managers, Designers and leadership can quickly act upon.
Support pricing decisions by analysing price points, offers and promotions, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and long-term player value.
Help manage the in-game economy by monitoring balance, sinks and sources, and the health of currency and reward systems while proactively identifying risks and opportunities.
Own tracking specifications by defining the events and metrics needed for new features, writing clear tracking documentation and ensuring instrumentation is implemented correctly so data is trustworthy from day one.
Take ownership of operational work at scale, including reporting, observability, data quality, event integrity and coordination, recognising these as essential parts of delivering value in a live game.
Build and maintain Looker dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable self-service analytics and faster decision-making.
Write robust, performant SQL in BigQuery to answer product questions and power analysis and reporting.
Partner closely with Developers, Product Managers and Data Scientists on end-to-end solution delivery, observability, experimentation and data model improvements.
Use segmentation, funnel analysis and journey mapping to explore complex product questions and uncover meaningful insights.
Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to accelerate analysis, prototyping and communication.
Support the Analytics craft through knowledge sharing, strong data definitions, shared standards and mentoring more junior analysts.


What Success Looks Like


You become a trusted analytical partner to your Product Manager, helping shape product decisions through data, experimentation and commercial insight.
You provide reliable, actionable insights that improve product decisions and deepen the team's understanding of players.
You help the team move quickly by surfacing the right facts, reducing ambiguity and connecting data to product outcomes.
You operate effectively in a fast-paced live-game environment, solving problems that rarely come with predefined solutions or established playbooks.
You build strong, trusted relationships with Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics partners, contributing to high-quality end-to-end delivery.
Operational work at scale is executed reliably and efficiently because you treat it as a core part of delivering value rather than a maintenance task.


Skills to Create Thrills Core


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of deriving meaningful insights from behavioural or product data.
Strong SQL skills (BigQuery preferred) and confidence working independently with large datasets.
Experience owning or contributing to experimentation and A/B testing, including helping design experiments, interpreting results and translating findings into product recommendations.
Dashboarding experience in Looker (or a comparable BI tool) to build reporting and self-service analytics.
Experience using data to support product, business or operational decisions.
Ability to communicate analysis clearly and concisely through strong data visualisation and evidence-based recommendations.
Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science.
Genuine independence and initiative — comfortable taking ambiguous product problems and driving them through to actionable outcomes.
Willingness to take ownership of operational work at scale, including tracking, observability and data quality, recognising these as essential parts of delivering product value.


Highly Appreciated


Good understanding of statistics, with confidence interpreting experiment results and supporting A/B test analysis.
Python or R for analysis, automation or modelling.
Curiosity about using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication. Previous experience is welcome but not required.
Experience in games, live-service products or another fast-moving consumer product.


Role Scope

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will typically operate at the product-theme or feature level, providing analytical leadership across end-to-end solution delivery. You will identify data-driven opportunities, support cross-functional teams through analysis and coordination, and tackle problems that rarely have predefined solutions.

The role complements Product Management and Data Science rather than replacing either. The Analytics craft's core contribution is data-driven discovery, experimentation, exploration and recommendation, with a strong emphasis on product understanding, operational excellence, technical independence, stakeholder partnership and the ability to translate data into better product decisions.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer

Location: Solna, Stockholm, Sweden

Start Date: 1st October 2026

End Date: 31st March 2027

Work Style: Monday - Friday / Hybrid, 40 Hours Weekly




Role Objective

Support the Power Forecasts product team in producing local-grid and regional-grid forecasts for housing, transport electrification, industry, and commercial premises.
Maintain and improve a data-driven, automated forecasting workflow centred on Python scripts.
Produce reliable forecasts and insights for network dimensioning, network-development planning, investment decisions, and customer dialogue.
Enhance the quality, efficiency, and analytical value of forecasting, data-modelling, and reporting processes.




Key Responsibilities

Automate forecasting activities previously completed manually using Python within a Databricks environment.
Analyse customer and time-series data to develop improved forecasting methodologies.
Build new Power BI reports and enhance existing reports through data modelling, calculations, and additional functionality.
Update power forecasts for specific geographical areas and generate quantitative and qualitative insights.
Assess data availability, combine information from multiple sources, and ensure data quality and reliability.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal and external stakeholders.




Tasks

Develop clear and efficient Python code to automate forecast preparation and processing.
Conduct both defined analyses and exploratory investigations into customer and time-series data.
Collaborate with colleagues from other disciplines to assess potential changes to forecasting methodology.
Develop Power BI data models, calculations, visualisations, and report functionality.
Gather, validate, process, and quality-assure input data used in power forecasts.
Liaise with municipalities and local-grid customers when updating forecasts for specific areas.
Prepare and present forecast results, insights, and supporting materials to relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous development of automated and data-driven ways of working within the product team.




Deliverables

Automated and maintainable forecasting workflows within Databricks.
Updated local-grid and regional-grid power forecasts.
Customer-data and time-series analyses supporting methodology development.
Accurate and usable Power BI reports, data models, and calculations.
Quality-assured datasets, analytical insights, and stakeholder presentation materials.




Decision Authority / Responsibility

Own assigned analysis, automation, reporting, and forecast-update activities through to completion.
Recommend improvements to forecasting methodologies, data models, and automated workflows based on evidence and analysis.
Identify and escalate material data-quality, reliability, and methodological risks.
Ensure analytical results and reporting outputs are clear, reliable, and suitable for stakeholder decision-making.




Requirements

Several years of experience analysing large datasets, particularly customer data and time series, including data manipulation, modelling, and presentation of results to stakeholders.
Several years of experience developing efficient, understandable code using Python or a comparable programming language.
Professional experience in the electricity-network sector or other relevant energy-industry experience.
Professional experience with data-visualisation tools such as Power BI.
Strong analytical ability and advanced problem-solving skills.
Able to communicate complex findings and messages clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant academic degree, such as an MSc in Engineering in Applied Physics, Energy Systems, Electrical Power Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
Previous experience in insight generation and/or forecasting is advantageous.
Experience working in an Agile Scrum team or equivalent environment is advantageous.
Experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning is advantageous.
Experience with SQL or an equivalent query language is advantageous.

Title: Business Performance Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Business Performance Analyst to join Packaging Solutions’ Business Unit Northern Europe Controlling team.

This role is part of our ambition to build a modern, AI-enabled analytics capability where data, automation, and business insight drive better decisions and stronger profitability.

Hybrid role, with location in Jönköping, Stockholm, Lahti, Helsinki, or Riga.

Your role

As a Business Performance Analyst, you help transform data, analytics, AI, and automation opportunities into tangible business value.

You work at the intersection of business, finance, analytics, and technology. Your focus is not only on analysing data but on understanding business challenges, identifying opportunities for improvement, and enabling better decision-making through data-driven insights.

Success in this role comes from your ability to challenge assumptions, connect the dots across functions, and translate emerging technologies into practical solutions that improve business performance.

The role reports to the Head of Controlling, BU Northern Europe, Packaging Solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze financial and business data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and improvement opportunities
Support business stakeholders and controllers with profitability analysis, scenario modelling, and decision-making
Proactively identify opportunities where AI, automation, and digital tools can improve efficiency, business performance, and insight generation
Explore external best practices, new technologies, and emerging solutions, and translate them into practical business applications
Act as a bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring initiatives create measurable value
Collaborate with IT and data teams to design and continuously improve datasets, analytical models, and reporting capabilities
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, reporting, and decision-support tools
Ensure data quality, consistency, and a reliable single source of truth across analyses and reporting
Combine and structure data from multiple systems and sources to support business insights
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders across the organisation
Challenge existing ways of working and drive continuous improvement through data, analytics, and automation



What You Bring


Relevant academic background in finance, business, economics, engineering, analytics, or a related field
Experience in business analysis, finance, controlling, commercial analysis, performance management, analytics, or a similar field
Strong interest and experience in leveraging AI, AI Agents, automation, and modern technologies to solve business problems
Experience with Power BI, Excel, and data analysis tools
Familiarity with SQL and Python is beneficial,
Business understanding and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to translate business challenges into analytical approaches and actionable recommendations
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
Curiosity to challenge numbers, ask "why", and identify opportunities for improvement
Structured, proactive, and collaborative way of working
Fluency in English



What We Offer

You will be part of our diverse working culture which supports you in exploring new perspectives and developing professionally. You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that anything made from fossil-based materials today can be made from a tree tomorrow. Sustainability and innovation are at the core of our strategy. To keep you going safely, we support your physical and mental wellbeing.

How can you apply for this role?

You can only submit your application via our recruitment tool. We hope to hear from you as soon as possible, but no later than 29, September, 2026 and please send your application in English. Depending on the role, we might invite you to a video interview and/or aptitude tests.

If you have questions about the position, please contact our Talent Acquisition Partner Veera Kaislasalo at veera.kaislasalo@storaenso.com.

Welcome to the The renewable materials company!

Stora Enso is a global leader in renewable materials with a strong focus on packaging. Our purpose is to replace non-renewable materials with renewable solutions. Together with our customers, we design and deliver competitive, high-quality packaging materials and solutions, made from fresh and recycled fibers, accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy. Stora Enso has approximately 19,000 employees and our sales in 2025 were EUR 9.3 billion.

We believe that diversity strengthens our competitiveness and leads to better decision‑making. Diverse teams with different backgrounds help us explore new perspectives and challenge our ways of thinking. We actively work to increase diversity in the workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Stora Enso is an equal opportunity employer that follows non‑discriminatory practices.

Description:
Challenges You Will Work On

At SAS, we are strengthening how we work with customer feedback and insight across the organization. We are looking for a CX Analyst to help manage our Voice of the Customer program, support research activities and turn customer feedback and customer data into actionable insights.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is curious, analytical, technically minded and eager to grow. You'll work closely with researchers, experience specialists and business stakeholders while developing hands-on expertise in modern insight tools, analytics and customer experience practices.

In this role, you will help manage and evolve our Voice of the Customer capabilities, turning customer feedback and data into insights that support better decisions and customer experiences across SAS.

Your Responsibilities Include


Manage and maintain customer feedback programs, primarily in Qualtrics
Support survey design, programming, testing, deployment, and reporting
Analyze customer feedback, customer data and operational data to generate actionable insight
Support reporting across key customer metrics such as NPS and CSAT
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting solutions
Help improve and automate insight processes, reporting, and workflows
Work with customer journey data and feedback to support experience improvement initiatives
Partner with your colleagues across the Customer Insight & Customer Experience team and the wider organization to ensure customer insight contributes to decision-making and experience improvements

A strong interest in analytics, customer insights, research and customer experience
1-3 years of experience in analytics, customer insights, market research, CX or a related field
Experience with SQL, or a strong interest in developing SQL capabilities
Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms
Quantitative and analytical skills, with an interest in turning data into actionable insights
Familiarity with statistics and survey methodologies, dashboarding and reporting tools

Why SAS?

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.

On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team and serve as the dedicated analytics partner to our Product organisation.

As a Product Analyst, you will help our product teams make better decisions through data. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to uncover user insights, measure product performance, and drive experimentation across the customer journey. You'll play a key role in establishing best practices for product analytics, event tracking, and experimentation while enabling teams to make confident, data-informed decisions.

Your insights will directly influence the experience of millions of consumers and thousands of professionals using Bokadirekt every month.

Beyond product analytics, we're looking for someone with an AI-native mindset—someone who knows how to leverage AI to work smarter while applying sound judgement to validate AI-generated insights and recommendations. This is an opportunity to shape how analytics, experimentation, and AI contribute to the continued growth of one of Sweden's most widely used consumer platforms.

What You'll Do


Drive product insights across the full customer journey by identifying user behaviour, friction points, drop-offs, and growth opportunities
Own A/B testing end-to-end, from experiment design and statistical validation to analysis and post-mortems
Champion our experimentation framework by coaching product managers, designers, and engineers on experiment design and data-informed decision-making
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define, implement, and continuously improve reliable event tracking standards
Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and apply sound judgement when validating AI-generated insights


Who You Are


Degree in Business, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
Proven experience (2–4 years) as a Product Analyst or Data Analyst, ideally in a technology-driven environment
Strong proficiency in SQL
Hands-on experience designing, analysing, and evaluating A/B tests
Experience working with product event tracking in fast-moving environments where processes and data are continuously evolving
Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous situations and turning insights into action
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Looker), Amplitude, Mixpanel, Confidence by Spotify or similar
Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a plus


What We Offer


The opportunity to influence product strategy and user experience through data at one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
The opportunity to shape how product decisions are made through experimentation, analytics, and AI
A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
A competitive salary and benefits package


About The Position

Start date: As soon as possible / By agreement

Location: Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Application

We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Title: Data Analyst / Data Scientist (French speaking)
Description:
About the role




This week CNN and Reuters reported on our work in DRC together with Vodacom, WHO, Congo government, African CDC and other where we are using mobile-phone data to understand population movements and get ahead of the Ebola outbreak. This is part of Flowminder's work, and we need one more person on the team doing it.




You'll turn mobile operator, survey and spatial data into population and mobility statistics that ministries of health, national statistics offices and UN agencies rely on for outbreak response, humanitarian planning and development decision-making in DRC and beyond. About a third of the role is training and building capacity with our partner institutions, in French and English, including travel to the countries we work in. It's a job where what you produce on a Tuesday can shape decisions on the ground by Friday.




We're looking for someone with a strong quantitative background, solid Python and time-series skills, spatial data experience, and professional working French.

Permanent, full-time, based in Stockholm or Southampton (hybrid).

Deadline: 30 September 2026. We review on a rolling basis.




Full details and how to apply: https://lnkd.in/d2eff96M




About Flowminder

Flowminder is a non-profit foundation. We enable decision makers to access the data they need to transform the lives of vulnerable people, at scale.

We analyse pseudonymised mobile operator data, satellite imagery and household survey data to measure where people are and how they move. Flowminder researchers were the first to use mobile operator data to track population movements after a large-scale disaster and during a major infectious disease outbreak, following the 2010 Haiti earthquake and cholera outbreak. We work with national statistics offices, health ministries and disaster management agencies in low- and middle-income countries, alongside UN agencies, the World Bank and development banks.

We are a small team, based mainly in Southampton and Stockholm, working in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti, Ghana and Pakistan. Our working language is English, but much of our work with partners is in French.

Vi söker en dataanalytiker med erfarenhet av business intelligence med fokus på datahantering och informationsförädling. Title: Paid Media Analyst
Description:
Job Description



WHAT YOU WILL DO



At H&M, we are on a journey to become a truly data-driven company, where insights and analytics help shape better customer experiences and smarter business decisions. Within Consumer & Marketing Insights, we partner closely with Marketing, Media, and Commercial stakeholders to understand what drives growth and how we can maximize the impact of our paid media investments.



We are now looking for a Paid Media Analyst to join our team.



As a Paid Media Analyst, you will help H&M understand the impact of our paid media investments across markets. By combining performance data from paid media channels, measurement outputs, and business context, you will generate insights that support decision-making, deepen our understanding of media effectiveness, and help identify future opportunities for growth.



You will work closely with media specialists, analysts, and measurement experts, connecting insights across different audiences, from creating performance narratives for leadership to helping activation teams understand performance drivers, optimization opportunities, and areas for testing and learning.



You will also play an important role in shaping how paid media performance is reported across the organization, partnering with BI and data specialists to improve reporting frameworks, automate processes, and develop scalable dashboards and performance views.



Your responsibilities will include:



Analyzing paid media performance to understand what drives business outcomes and media effectiveness.
Synthesizing insights across channels, markets, and measurement frameworks.
Creating clear visualizations, presentations, and performance narratives for different stakeholder audiences.
Interpreting results from attribution, incrementality measurement, marketing mix modeling, and other measurement approaches.
Identifying trends, performance drivers, and opportunities for future testing and learning.
Investigating business questions, identifying root causes behind performance shifts, and proactively recommending actions and opportunities for optimization.
Contributing to the development of reporting frameworks, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions in partnership with BI and data specialists.
Collaborating with media, activation, analytics, and measurement teams to continuously improve reporting and insight generation.





WHO YOU ARE



Experience in paid media, media analytics, performance marketing, digital performance analysis, or media effectiveness.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect data, business context, and commercial outcomes.
Experience translating complex analyses into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Strong data visualization and storytelling skills.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Understanding of media performance measurement and marketing effectiveness.
Understanding of attribution principles and how different paid media platforms measure and report performance.
Experience working with data from major paid media platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, or similar environments is highly valued.
Familiarity with incrementality measurement, marketing mix modeling, or similar methodologies is an advantage.
Experience working cross-functionally and building strong stakeholder relationships.
Fluency in English.
Curious about what drives media performance and customer behavior.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity and turning data into clear hypotheses, insights, and recommendations.
Comfortable working with large amounts of performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and business impact.
Structured and detail-oriented, while keeping focus on business outcomes.
A strong communicator who can tailor messages to different audiences.
Motivated by continuous learning, experimentation, and improving ways of working.
Self-driven, proactive, and confident in independently exploring complex questions and driving analyses forward.







WHO WE ARE 



H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 



We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 





WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE   



At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive development opportunities across the globe. You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where your ideas matter.​





JOIN US  



Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.  



This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office in Stockholm. Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.



We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

Title: Credit Risk Analyst
Description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a Credit Risk Analyst with a focus on our credit card products to join our team.

About The Role

In this role, you will play a key part in analyzing and supporting our credit card portfolio within the Credit Domain, helping us bridge the gap between risk data, automated execution, and commercial impact. You will work closely with senior colleagues to monitor, analyze, and optimize underwriting processes, limit adjustments, and portfolio behavior specifically for our business credit card offering. By combining data analysis with a strong interest in card products, you will help us ensure safe, scalable, and customer-centric portfolio growth across Northern Europe.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze and monitor portfolio performance, usage patterns, and risk trends specifically for our business credit card product.
Assist in developing and tuning automated frameworks for credit limit adjustments, risk scoring, and card underwriting.
Build and maintain dashboards using SQL and Python to track credit card metrics, loss performance, and key risk indicators.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to streamline card issuance, credit decisioning, and customer journeys.
Support the evaluation and updating of card-specific credit policies and risk models based on real-world portfolio data.



What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a curious, structured, and analytical problem-solver who is passionate about card products and eager to grow within credit risk analytics. You thrive in a collaborative environment where you can work hands-on with data, learn from experienced peers, and turn practical insights into better risk decisions.

Qualifications


Degree in Finance, Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, or another relevant quantitative/business field (or equivalent practical experience).
A few years of experience working with data analysis or risk analytics, ideally with exposure to credit card products, digital lending, or consumer/SME credit.
Good hands-on skills in SQL and Python for quantitative data analysis.
Familiarity with visualization tools such as Power BI, QlikView, or Amazon QuickSight.
A genuine interest in fintech, credit card mechanics, and digital credit risk management.



Why Qred?

This is the place to be if you’re looking to kickstart or accelerate your career. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest techniques, gain real ownership early on, and learn directly from a team of highly skilled colleagues!

One Last Thing

This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week.

We review applications on a rolling basis, and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.

Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.



Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

Title: Sr. Product Analyst
Description:
Define the metrics. Build the foundation. Make product decisions at Simployer impossible to make without data.

At some point last quarter, someone at Simployer asked how many users actually engage with a feature after the first week. They got an answer. A few weeks later, someone else asked the same question and got a different one. Both were correct. Neither were useful. That's the problem this role fixes.




We are an HR-tech company that helps organisations manage their people better. We're building a proper data foundation right now. Clean events. A modelled layer. Analytics that product teams can actually use. Our lead data engineer joined earlier this year. Now we need the person who makes that foundation useful.




We're looking for someone who gets energised by questions like:

What if every product team agreed on what "active user" actually means?
How do you build a weekly data read that people actually show up to and use?
What would it look like if product decisions at Simployer were grounded in numbers everyone trusted?




As our Senior Product Analyst, you'll own metric definitions, drive product usage analysis, and build the dashboards product teams reach for first. You'll also help shape the modelled data layer alongside our lead data engineer, so it works for people and AI agents alike.




Your mission

You'll partner with product managers and engineers across every product domain not as someone who runs exports on request, but as the person who asks "what are you trying to decide?" before writing a single query. You'll shape those questions into defined metrics, document them so teams speak the same language, and build dashboards that make a weekly product review worth having.




You'll thrive here if..

You have several years of product analytics experience in B2B SaaS and you've actually defined metrics, not just inherited them
You're strong in SQL against a warehouse and you understand what the data can and can't tell you
You've worked hands-on with a product analytics tool aka. Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar and you know how to work with event data, audit what's tracked, and flag what's missing
You're comfortable being the only analyst. High autonomy and high accountability feel like the same thing to you
You know how to say "we don't know yet" clearly, and you know what to do next when that's the honest answer
You help teams answer their own recurring questions instead of becoming the person they always come to
You have hands-on experience with AI coding tools or agentic workflows and you think about what good data looks like from an agent's perspective, not just a person's.




What you bring:

We're not big on long checklists, and if the mission resonates with you we'd love to hear from you. That said, a few things you'll need to succeed: solid SQL, hands-on experience with a product analytics tool, and a track record in B2B SaaS. The role is based in Stockholm and requires professional English.




Message from the hiring manager:

"You're joining while we lay the foundation, not after it's set. We're building a data warehouse designed for AI and for people from day one, and the standards on top of it are still yours to define: how we name an event, what "active user" means, how a product manager gets to an answer without coming to you. Those decisions are open, and you'd make them with us.

That's the trade. Less structure than you'd find on a mature analytics team. More influence than you'd ever get on one. Come build with me!"




-Maciej Górczak - Product Engineering Manager




We can't wait to meet you!

Title: (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Model Analytics
Description:
Job ID: 6180

We are looking for a (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst to join Credit Risk Model Analytics team, recognised for its professionalism, strong expertise, and high delivery standards. We have an ambitious development roadmap for risk models, and together with our colleagues across Nordea, we are shaping the future of banking.

At Nordea, we use internal models to calculate regulatory capital. These models are developed and maintained within the Risk Models organisation and rely on a comprehensive data asset that aggregates information from across Nordea’s data landscape. Data analytics is at the core of statistical modelling, enabling deep understanding of the data used for regulatory and business‑critical purposes.

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Model Analytics team, a part of Risk Models organisation. Our role is to add value to Nordea and our customers by strengthening data quality, enhancing transparency and understanding of our data, and enabling modelling teams to build robust models. Our work supports financial calculations and helps bank advisors make sound credit decisions.

Our team plays a key role in driving complex data deliveries related to IRB modelling datasets. We also coordinate data‑related activities and collaborate closely with other areas within Risk Models as well as with IT and business stakeholders.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Driving complex data deliveries on IRB modelling datasets, including:
Data reconciliation across multiple sources.
Root‑cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues.
Integration of new data sources.
Refining and clarifying business requirements to ensure accurate and efficient implementation.
Providing clear and structured status updates to relevant stakeholders as a subject matter expert.
Preparing analysis, reports, and documentation for senior management and external or regulatory reporting.
Acting, when required, as a bridge between business and IT to ensure a shared understanding and effective collaboration.


Who You Are

This is the right role for you if bring:


Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced environments, adapting priorities while maintaining delivery focus.
Strong structuring and coordination capabilities, with experience managing multiple parallel workstreams and end‑to‑end deliveries.
High level of independence and accountability, combined with the ability to work effectively across teams and senior stakeholder groups.
Advanced analytical skills with the capability to assess complex data, models, and sprocesses, and translate findings into clear insights and recommendations.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence to engage, challenge, and influence stakeholders, and to translate business needs into clear requirements for IT and other technical teams.
A proactive and solution‑oriented mindset, with a genuine drive for continuous improvement, knowledge development, and contributing to the long‑term capability of the team.


Your background and skills include:


Demonstrated experience in data analysis of IRB modeling datasets, acquired through hands-on work in the banking sector or consulting engagements
5+ years of hands‑on experience with data analysis in structured database environments, working with large and complex datasets
Knowledge of IRB-related processes and relevant regulatory requirements would be considered an advantage.
Strong practical experience with SQL and Python, or similar analytical and programming languages, applied in a professional context over multiple years
Model implementation experience in credit risk applications would be considered an advantage.
A Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics, or a closely related quantitative field, or equivalent senior‑level professional experience demonstrating comparable expertise.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 18/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Ismet Tuna Gurbuz at ismet.gurbuz@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We are looking for a (Senior) Quantitative Risk Analyst to join Credit Risk Model Analytics team, recognised for its professionalism, strong expertise, and high delivery standards. We have an ambitious development roadmap for risk models, and together with our colleagues across Nordea, we are shaping the future of banking.

At Nordea, we use internal models to calculate regulatory capital. These models are developed and maintained within the Risk Models organisation and rely on a comprehensive data asset that aggregates information from across Nordea’s data landscape. Data analytics is at the core of statistical modelling, enabling deep understanding of the data used for regulatory and business‑critical purposes.

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Model Analytics team, a part of Risk Models organisation. Our role is to add value to Nordea and our customers by strengthening data quality, enhancing transparency and understanding of our data, and enabling modelling teams to build robust models. Our work supports financial calculations and helps bank advisors make sound credit decisions.

Our team plays a key role in driving complex data deliveries related to IRB modelling datasets. We also coordinate data‑related activities and collaborate closely with other areas within Risk Models as well as with IT and business stakeholders.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:

  • Driving complex data deliveries on IRB modelling datasets, including:
  • Data reconciliation across multiple sources.
  • Root‑cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues.
  • Integration of new data sources.
  • Refining and clarifying business requirements to ensure accurate and efficient implementation.
  • Providing clear and structured status updates to relevant stakeholders as a subject matter expert.
  • Preparing analysis, reports, and documentation for senior management and external or regulatory reporting.
  • Acting, when required, as a bridge between business and IT to ensure a shared understanding and effective collaboration.

  • Proven ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced environments, adapting priorities while maintaining delivery focus.
  • Strong structuring and coordination capabilities, with experience managing multiple parallel workstreams and end‑to‑end deliveries.
  • High level of independence and accountability, combined with the ability to work effectively across teams and senior stakeholder groups.

  • A proactive and solution‑oriented mindset, with a genuine drive for continuous improvement, knowledge development, and contributing to the long‑term capability of the team.

  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience with data analysis in structured database environments, working with large and complex datasets
