Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to join us at Telia.




I’m Kerstin Helldal, leading the Product & Analytics team, and I’m searching for someone ready to grow with us. We’re a supportive, forward-thinking team focused on turning trusted data into smarter decisions for Telia Finance.




Are you passionate about turning data into business impact? At Telia Finance, we are strengthening our Product & Analytics team and are now looking for an Analytics Engineer who enjoys exploring data, finding patterns, and helping the business make smarter decisions.




In this role, you will work closely with both business stakeholders and technical teams to improve data quality, generate actionable insights, and support strategic decision-making across the organization.

This is a great opportunity for someone who combines strong analytical capability with curiosity, business understanding, and a pragmatic mindset.




What you’ll do:




As an Analytics Engineer at Telia Finance, you will work with structured and semi-structured data to identify trends, uncover business opportunities, and improve how we use data across the company.

Support the establishment of a lakehouse architecture and medallion framework, including data modelling standards and semantic layer design.
Develop and maintain data transformation pipelines across bronze, silver, and gold layers to ensure high-quality, trusted, and reusable data assets.
Design and implement scalable data quality, testing, and governance practices to ensure reliable, well-documented, and trusted data products.
Drive data validation, lineage, and observability across the Lakehouse environment, supporting the onboarding of new data sources and the continuous evolution of analytics datasets.
Own the maintenance, continuous development, and adoption of the Qlik Sense analytics platform, designing and delivering dashboards, reports, and semantic models that provide trusted insights and support data-driven decision-making across the business.
Partner with Product Owner Data & Analytics and business stakeholders to translate analytical needs into scalable solutions, support data-driven decision-making, and identify opportunities for new insights, use cases, and improvements.
Support the organization’s journey towards becoming increasingly data-driven by fostering data literacy, promoting best practices, and enabling stakeholders to make better decisions through trusted data and insights.




What will help you thrive in this role:




We believe you combine analytical capability with curiosity, business understanding, and a pragmatic mindset. You enjoy working across business and technology, and you can turn complex data into insights that others can act on.

Proven experience working as a Data Analyst, BI Developer, Analytics Engineer, or similar.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Experience with Qlik Sense, or other BI and visualization tools.
Ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
Experience working with data quality and/or data governance.
Academic background in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or related fields.
Fluency in Swedish and English.




Nice to have




Experience with Python or similar.
Experience from agile development teams.




Tech & tools




We work with modern analytics and BI environments (SQL, Phyton, Qlik Sense, Datalake platforms). Experience with Qlik Sense is highly valued.







Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet




At Telia, we’re a team of nearly 15 000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Leading Telecommunications Operator and Climate Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.

Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.




What we offer




When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.




Ready to make better happen?




We look forward to receiving your application by 27.10.2026. Please note that selection and interviews are ongoing, and the role may be filled or closed before the final application date, so don’t wait too long to apply!




If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.




Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Kerstin Helldal, Head of Product & Analytics, at kerstin.helldal@teliacompany.com.




Equal opportunities




At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.




Join us and let’s make better happen - together!

Title: Analytiker/Data Scientist inom bidragsbrott till Stockholm
Description:
Placeringsort Flera orterDiarienummer FK 2026/026988

Logga in och sök jobbet Öppnas i nytt fönster

Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför sätter vi oss in i varje ärende, följer lagar och regler, informerar och vägleder, bryr oss och visar omtanke. Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar. Välkommen till Försäkringskassan.

Hos oss får du ett varierande och avancerat arbete i en trevlig arbetsmiljö, med goda möjligheter till balans mellan arbete och fritid. Om du också värdesätter ett välfungerande arbete med dina kollegor och vill bli en del av ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag, så kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.

Försäkringskassan har kommit långt i sin tillämpning av analys och AI i syfte att motverka bidragsbrott och felaktiga utbetalningar. Vi arbetar med stora mängder interna och externa data samlat på ett omfattande och strukturerat data warehouse. Vårt datalager är bland de största i Norden.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med riskvärdering och programmering. Främst handlar det om att ta fram urval till kontroll men vi arbetar även med att automatisera och förbättra myndighetens handläggning. Du bör ha arbetslivserfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data samt kombinera data från olika källor.

Arbetsuppgifterna innebär bl.a. att ta fram, vidareutveckla och förvalta urval, expertsystem och utredningsstöd i form av webapplikationer tillsammans med t.ex. verksamhetsspecialister och IT. Du kommer jobba främst i SAS EG (low-code) och SAS Viya. För att kunna ha en hög förvaltningsbarhet på våra produkter är det viktigt att arbetet utförs enligt vår arbetsprocess, där man följer den standard och de arbetsrutiner som vi har tagit fram. Detta inkluderar även dokumentation av produkten. Arbetet är omväxlande och du kommer i kontakt med stora delar av Försäkringskassans verksamhet.

Tjänsten innebär att du hanterar sekretessbelagda uppgifter vilket ställer höga krav på rätt hantering. Därför är det viktigt att du som ska arbeta hos oss har högt säkerhetsmedvetande.

Det är ett jobb för dig som vill vara med och ta ansvar.

Vi söker dig som


har högskolexamen inom matematik, statistik, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, eller annan utbildning som vi bedömer som likvärdig som t.ex. en ingenjörsutbildning
har god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data
har erfarenhet av analysarbete med kvantitativa metoder
har goda kunskaper i relevanta analysmetoder och programmeringsspråk som exempelvis SAS och SQL
agerar på eget initiativ och tar ansvar för att nå goda resultat
har ett systematiskt och noggrant arbetssätt
kan förstå och analysera komplexa frågor
samarbetar effektivt med andra för att nå gemensamma mål
har god kommunikativ förmåga.


Det Är Meriterande Om Du


har erfarenhet av avancerad dataanalys
har erfarenhet från arbete inom socialförsäkringen eller annan myndighet
har mycket god erfarenhet av att hantera, bearbeta och analysera data från Försäkringskassans datalager
har erfarenhet av att använda SAS EG, SAS EM, SAS STP eller motsvarande i SAS Viya.


Övrigt

En tjänst, tillsvidare, heltid, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan bli aktuellt. Vissa anställningar hos oss innebär deltagande i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet. För att bli anställd i en sådan tjänst krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585).

I enlighet med Försäkringskassans riktlinje för säkerhet genomförs bakgrundskontroller i denna rekrytering. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns om arbetet tillåter. I den här rekryteringen kan arbetspsykologiska test och arbetsprov användas som en del i urvalsarbetet. Placeringsort: Stockholm eller Uppsala.

Vill du veta mer om Försäkringskassan som arbetsgivare? Besök fk.se/jobbahososs

Kontaktpersoner

Chef: Pål Wilkens 010-116 22 35 (för frågor om tjänsten). HR-specialist: Fanny Secher, fanny.secher@fk.se (för frågor om rekryteringsprocessen). ST: Henrik Lindholm 010-116 92 35, Saco-S: Annika Linell 010-114 79 54, Seko: Johanna Grundström 010-115 30 44.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 28 september 2026. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar, du får istället besvara ett antal urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Ladda upp dina examensbevis, betyg och intyg i samband med din ansökan.

Har du skyddade personuppgifter eller ingen tillgång till bank-id kontaktar du den HR-specialist som finns namngiven i annonsen via telefon så får du hjälp med att skicka in din ansökan.

Vi ska i allt vi gör, agera med utgångspunkt i principen om alla människors lika värde, rättssäkerhet och med god service.

Title: Konsult inom Power BI
Description:
Heltid - Stockholm




Som konsult hos Exsitec är ditt viktigaste mål att skapa värde åt våra kunder. Vi arbetar med att hjälpa våra kunder att förstå sin verksamhet genom att visualisera den data som finns i kundens verksamhetssystem samt bygga moderna, stabila datalager. På detta sätt hjälper vi våra kunder att fatta beslut baserade på fakta istället för magkänsla – detta kallas Business Intelligence.




Exsitec har på kort tid vuxit fram som en av Sveriges största BI leverantörer och vår tillväxt inom Power BI-området fortsätter att accelerera. Vi är därmed på en spännande tillväxtresa och vi behöver hitta fler kollegor som brinner för att hjälpa våra kunder bli mer framgångsrika med hjälp av Business Intelligence.




Vi söker efter dig som önskar att vara del av ett mindre team med stora ambitioner. Området kommer framåt vara viktigt för Exsitecs erbjudande och därför planerar vi att växa som team i takt med att försäljningen av Power BI och Fabric ökar.




Tillsammans med kunden kommer du att designa och bygga lösningar från datalager och datatransformering i Fabric till färdiga rapporter i Power BI. Lösningarna hjälper organisationen att bättre se, förstå och agera utifrån sina data. Som Business Intelligence-konsult får du jobba nära kravställare/användare och kommer se den nytta dina lösningar skapar för kunderna.




Hos oss blir du en del av vårt växande team där tillsammansheten är något vi brinner starkt för. Du får en härlig onboarding med fokus på teamkänsla, hjälpsamhet och tid till att lära.




Vi söker dig som:

Har 1-3 års erfarenhet och letar efter nya utmaningar
Älskar problemlösning såväl i arbetslivet som på fritiden
Är nyfiken och noggrann
Är driven och självständig
Gillar att utvecklas genom samarbete med andra människor
Är öppen, du säger vad du menar och menar vad du säger




Nödvändiga färdigheter och kvalifikationer

Du har arbetat tidigare i en roll där du på något sätt har kommit i kontakt med dataanalys
Kunskaper inom datamodellering, databaser, SQL

Description:
Our Credit & Analytics department is known for being one of the most forward-thinking in the Nordics, made up of talents from across the globe. About The Role

As our unsecured portfolios grow in size and complexity, you help shape the future of our Danish portfolio. Credit underwriting sits at the core of an unsecured lending bank, and internally we simply call this "running the bank." You coordinate closely with stakeholders across departments.

What You'll Be Doing


Collaborate with business, product and cross-functional teams, bringing credit risk expertise into business decisions
Work with data and data structures to build a strong foundation for monitoring and connect insights to business and risk outcomes

Understand how data flows through our systems to identify opportunities and improve decision-making
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike

You are creative, curious and analytically sharp, someone who enjoys challenging and improving existing methods with data. At least 5 years' experience in credit risk within the Danish market.
Knowledge of credit bureau data, regulatory requirements and market-specific credit risk factors for Denmark.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and present findings clearly.
Strong communication skills, able to explain complex findings in an understandable way.
Experience with analytical tools such as R, Python, SAS or SQL/Databricks.
A degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Finance, Statistics or Data Science.
Fluency in English; Scandinavian language skills are a plus.

Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP).

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 30/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:

  • Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
  • We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
  • Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
  • Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
  • Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
  • Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.

You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:

  • Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
  • Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
  • Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
  • Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
  • Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.

Your background and skills include:

  • Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
  • Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
  • Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
  • A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
  • Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
  • An interest in finance and technology.

What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 30/09/2026.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Business Analyst – Graduate 2027
Description:
Graduating in 2027? Analytical and quick to connect the dots between numbers and what they actually mean, turning insight into new ideas and better ways of doing things? Ambitious, curious and the kind of person people genuinely enjoy working with? And more interested in building a business than spending your first years watching from the sidelines? Keep reading.

We're looking for a few exceptional graduates to join Anyfin in 2027.

We're not hiring you into one narrowly defined analyst box. You could end up working across Growth, Credit, Finance, Product, Operations or somewhere we haven't even decided yet depending on what you're great at and where the biggest opportunities are.

Anyfin exists to make finance actually work for people, not against them. Replacing the fine print and hidden fees of traditional credit with something transparent and fair. We've been building with AI at the core since long before it was trendy, and it's now central to how we design products, make decisions, and move fast. We're building the next generation of consumer finance, and we're only getting started: new products, new markets, and a lot more of Europe to

That means a lot of important questions we don't have the answers to yet.

That's where you come in.

What You Might Actually Do

Your exact scope will depend on where you land, but you could be:


Figuring out why something is growing or why it isn't
Analyzing customer behavior, pricing, profitability, acquisition or credit performance
Building models and forecasts that influence where we invest
Evaluating new products, markets or business opportunities
Turning messy data into a recommendation and then being in the room when the decision gets made


You won't spend your first year producing reports for someone more senior to have an opinion about.

We expect you to develop opinions of your own.

You won't be one of 1000

We're not trying to become a huge company for the sake of becoming a huge company. We hire carefully, and every person we add matters.

So no, you won't be one of 500 graduates joining Anyfin next year.

You'll be one of a small number of people we've deliberately chosen to bet on.

You'll know the people making the decisions. They'll know you. Your work will be visible, your ideas will be heard, and there won't be five layers of organization between you and the interesting problems.

That comes with high expectations. It also comes with a lot of opportunities.

Who We're Looking For

You're probably graduating in 2027 with a degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or something else that has taught you how to think analytically.

But we're less interested in the name of your degree than in how your brain works.

You're very good with numbers. Curious. Quick to learn. Comfortable solving problems that don't come with instructions. You can go deep into data without losing sight of the business and explain complicated things without making them sound complicated.

Excel is expected. SQL is great. Python or other analytical tools are a plus.

Previous full-time experience isn't required. Internships, student jobs, side projects, building something yourself or simply being unusually good at what you do all count.

About Your 15-year Career Plan

We can't put a 15-year career ladder in front of you and tell you exactly which title you'll have at every step.

We're a growing company. Things change. Teams evolve. New problems appear.

What we can promise is that you won't have to wait years to be useful.

You'll work alongside experienced people, get exposure across the business and be trusted with meaningful problems early.

If you're great, your scope will grow. Probably faster than your job title can keep up.

And if, a few years from now, you haven't grown further, learned faster and taken on more responsibility than you thought you would when you joined, we'll consider that a failure on our side too.

There are easier places to start your career. There are probably more predictable ones too.

But if you're looking for somewhere you can learn ridiculously fast, have real impact and look back after a few years thinking “I can't believe they let me do all of that” – this could be for you.

Graduating in 2027? We'd love to hear from you.

Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

Title: Analytics Engineer Stockholm
Description:
Jobbeskrivning

Som Analytics Engineer på Sopra Steria får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande och uppdrag hos ledande företag och organisationer, både inom offentlig och privat sektor. Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor bygger du lösningar som stärker samhällsfunktioner och förbättrar vardagen för tusentals människor. Genom dina goda tekniska kunskaper och din förståelse för verksamheten skapar du stort värde hos våra kunder. Du arbetar med modern dataanalys och BI-utveckling i Power BI samt den bakomliggande dataplattformen, och bidrar till utvecklingen av framtidssäkrade analyslösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att dessa ligger till grund för utveckling av rapporter och den bakomliggande datan. Vidare tillgängliggör du data för verksamheten genom analys, visualisering och strategisk rådgivning.

Uppdragen genomförs oftast i teamleveranser där du får påverka hela analyskedjan – från datainsamling och modellering till visualisering och beslutsstöd. Hos oss finns ett starkt fokus på kunskapsdelning och utveckling, både tekniskt och som team.

Oavsett om du har några års erfarenhet eller är senior och söker nästa stora utmaning, erbjuder vi en miljö där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vi tror att du har:


Några års erfarenhet av att jobba i molnet med dataanalys, BI eller data engineering med fokus på Power BI & semantiska modeller.
Jobbat nära verksamheten med att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till analysfunktionalitet.
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse och/eller Azure Databricks.
God förståelse för DAX, SQL och modellering.
Är van vid att arbeta i både svenska och internationella miljöer – du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift.


Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Python, Qlik, Tableau, Data Engineering, AI och Data Science.

Att jobba på Sopra Steria

Vi växer tillsammans, delar kunskap och har roligt på vägen. Hos oss får du arbeta i spännande projekt på en flexibel arbetsplats med schyssta förmåner. Hos oss är det viktigt att kunna växa i sin roll, och vi avsätter tid för lärande och certifieringar och har ett starkt community för kunskapsdelning. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här!

Ansök nu – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

Vi behandlar ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

Rekryteringsprocessen består av tre intervjuer, personlighet- och logiktest, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Denna kombination av urvalsmetoder ger oss en bredare och mer rättvis bild av dig som kandidat, samtidigt som det säkerställer att både dina tekniska och personliga styrkor kommer till sin rätt. För dig som kandidat innebär det en möjlighet att visa din kompetens och potential från flera perspektiv.

Har du frågor? Hör av dig till:

Svante Larsson, Talent Acquisition Partner: svante.larsson2@soprasteria.com

Joakim Hällgren, Rekryterande chef: joakim.hallgren@soprasteria.com

Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
TL;DR - We are looking for a data scientist to build Lovable's data and analytics muscle. You'll work cross-functionally across all teams to level up our understanding of users, uncover opportunities and empower everyone with the insights they need for data-driven decision making. Must combine analytical rigor with the ability to turn complex data into winning product bets.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We’re Looking For


A business-minded data scientist who's excited to level up our analytics efforts: metrics frameworks, behavioral models, and hypothesis testing
Solid technical foundation (SQL, Python, statistical analysis) - comfortable working with data at scale and translating it into insights
Deep curiosity about user behavior and what actually drives growth and retention
Ability to move between exploratory analysis, building behavioral models, hypothesis testing, and strategic recommendations


What You’ll Do


Work closely with growth, product, and marketing to identify key levers in the customer journey
Analyze funnels, cohorts, and user behaviors to surface insights that drive decisions
Build dashboards, alerts, and automated reporting to keep the team informed and aligned
Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, growth tests) to understand, impact and inform strategy
Monitor data quality and collaborate with engineering to maintain reliability
Leverage AI tools and automation to scale your analysis and focus on high-impact questions
Translate data into clear, actionable narratives that drive product and business decisions


Our tech stack

We're building with tools that both humans and AI love:


Frontend: React
Backend: Golang and Rust
Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, Many LLM providers
DevOps & Tooling: Github Actions, Grafana, OTEL, , infra-as-code (Terraform)


And always on the lookout for what's next!

How We Hire


Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.
Join us for a workshop lasting 1-2 days remote or onsite. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.


About Your Application


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

Title: Senior NRM Specialist, Data and Insight - Stockholm
Description:
Data & Insight Specialist at Arla - Stockholm

Are you passionate about turning data into insights that create real business value? Do you enjoy combining analytical expertise with commercial understanding and working closely with stakeholders to influence decisions?

We are looking for a Data & Insight Specialist to join our team at Arla’s head office in Solna, Stockholm. In this role, you will turn complex data into actionable insights, develop data and reporting solutions, and help our commercial teams make smarter, data-driven decisions.

How You Will Make An Impact

As a Data & Insight Specialist at Arla, you will play a key role in strengthening data-driven decision-making across our commercial organization. You will combine analytical expertise, business understanding and a strong data product mindset to maximize the value of both internal and external data.

You will own and develop a portfolio of commercial data products and solutions and work closely with colleagues across Category Development, Sales and Marketing. An important part of the role is also managing external data providers and ensuring that the data and solutions we invest in create tangible value for the business.

In this role, you will


Own and manage a portfolio of commercial data products, reporting solutions and analytical capabilities.
Integrate and work with data from multiple internal and external sources to deliver reliable and actionable business insights.
Develop and continuously improve dashboards, reporting solutions and analytical tools that support Customer Marketing and the broader commercial organization.
Manage syndicated market and shopper data from external partners and ensure that data deliveries meet Arla’s business requirements and quality standards.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - Consumer Experience
Description:
What We Do At Qliro

At Qliro we deliver safe and simple payments. We are a dedicated partner to our merchants who serve their customers every day. We believe that if our merchants grow, we grow. We are a company of dedicated, friendly and highly competent people that together have redefined what Qliro and payments can be. We are now on a journey of scaling our business both here in Sweden and the Nordics.

What You Will Do

As a Product Analyst, you own the analytical thinking behind how consumers experience Qliro's payment products, not just running the numbers, but setting the standard for how the rest of the organization uses data. You'll work closely with your product teams and PMs, sharing insights and trends in order to improve our products. You'll work closely with tech, product, data and the rest of Qliro to build our consumer experience on data and insights.

In this role you will:


Set product strategy recommendations together with product managers, backed by evidence you've built yourself, with the consumer's experience of paying with Qliro as the throughline
Own measurement, reporting and interpretation of consumer-facing product performance end to end
Lead performance improvement initiatives across teams, including designing and evaluating A/B tests on the consumer journey
Run and shape the analytical forums on consumer product performance, and use them to spread analytical method, not just conclusions
Mentor and upskill less experienced analysts and non-analysts on data tools, encourage AI-assisted analysis, statistical reasoning, and how to ask better questions of the data
Challenge current business performance and practice proactively, without waiting to be asked
Take a full-business view, pulling from whatever database, system or study gets a clear answer, not just the one closest at hand


Who you are:

You're curious by default and don't wait for someone to hand you a question — you notice something off in the data and dig into why. You've reached a point where you don't just do the analysis; you also teach it, and you take real satisfaction in other people getting better at their own thinking because of you.

Your experience:


4-7 years of experience in product or data analytics
Experience with SQL, data preparation/data processing and visualisation tools (QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI, …) are a must.
A decent knowledge for how to perform data extraction and manipulation.
Expereince in designing and evaluating A/B tests end to end
Good at communicating and presenting insights from data analysis to any type of audience.
Bonus if you have experience in owning analytics for a consumer-facing digital product or conversion rate optimisation


Qliro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, sexual orientation or age.

Title: Försäljningsanalytiker
Description:
För En Hållbar Framtid Tillsammans

Coop är Sveriges största kooperation och en ledande aktör inom dagligvaruhandeln, med över 4 miljoner medlemmar. Vi har ett stort fokus på hållbarhet och arbetar för att skapa en mer grön och rättvis framtid genom att erbjuda hållbara produkter och tjänster.

Vi tror på att en mångfald av perspektiv och erfarenheter är nyckeln till att skapa en mer inkluderande och framgångsrik arbetsplats. Därför välkomnar vi alla oavsett kön, ålder, bakgrund och etnisk tillhörighet.

Vill du använda data och analys för att påverka kommersiella beslut och bidra till ökad försäljning och lönsamhet på Coop?

Vi söker nu en Försäljningsanalytiker som vill bidra med faktabaserade insikter och skapa tydliga beslutsunderlag för vår kommersiella verksamhet. Rollen passar dig som trivs i gränslandet mellan försäljning, kategori, kampanj och analys och som vill se ett tydligt samband mellan analys, beslut och resultat.

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta nära affären och bidra till att våra prioriteringar baseras på stabil försäljningsdata, tydliga KPI:er och jämförbar effektmätning.

Om Tjänsten

Som Försäljningsanalytiker ansvarar du för att ta fram försäljningsanalyser som ligger till grund för organisationens förslag, beslut och uppföljning inom bland annat format, erbjudande, kategori och kampanj.

Du arbetar med att identifiera avvikelser, möjligheter och samband i försäljningsdata samt synliggöra vilka initiativ som driver försäljning, volym och marginal. Analysen ska inte bara beskriva vad som har hänt, utan också ge verksamheten tydliga insikter om vilka åtgärder och prioriteringar som kan skapa effekt framåt.

Du Kommer Bland Annat Att


följa och analysera försäljning, volym, marginal och andra relevanta KPI:er
ta fram analyser och beslutsunderlag inom format, erbjudande, kategori och kampanj
utveckla och kvalitetssäkra dashboards, rapporter och löpande resultatuppföljning
genomföra effektanalyser och utvärdera genomförda kampanjer och kommersiella initiativ
identifiera avvikelser, trender och förbättringsmöjligheter i försäljningsdata
synliggöra vilka aktiviteter och initiativ som driver försäljning och lönsamhet
presentera komplexa analyser på ett tydligt, pedagogiskt och handlingsorienterat sätt
kravställa datadefinitioner och bidra till jämförbara och tillförlitliga beslutsunderlag
initiera fördjupade analyser och eskalera databrister när underlaget inte håller tillräcklig kvalitet
samarbeta nära kommersiell samordning, säljstyrning, erbjudandeansvariga samt Kategori & Inköp.


Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är analytisk, strukturerad och nyfiken på vad som ligger bakom siffrorna. Du har ett tydligt kommersiellt perspektiv och förstår hur försäljning, kategori, erbjudande och kampanj hänger ihop.

Du tycker om att fördjupa dig i data, men är samtidigt skicklig på att lyfta blicken och förklara vad analysen faktiskt innebär för verksamheten. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna göra komplex information begriplig och omvandla analys till konkreta rekommendationer som andra kan agera på.

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, vilket gör att du behöver vara kommunikativ, samarbetsorienterad och trygg i att ställa frågor, kravställa underlag och utmana befintliga slutsatser när data visar på andra möjligheter.

Vi Ser Gärna Att Du Har


akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, statistik, dataanalys eller motsvarande
cirka 3–7 års erfarenhet av försäljningsanalys, Business Intelligence eller liknande arbete inom retail
god förståelse för försäljning, kategori, erbjudande och kampanj
mycket god analytisk förmåga och vana att arbeta med stora datamängder
erfarenhet av att utveckla och arbeta med KPI:er, dashboards, rapportering och effektmätning
god förmåga att visualisera data och presentera analyser på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt
förmåga att omsätta data och analys till konkreta affärsinsikter och rekommendationer
god kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika delar av en kommersiell organisation.


Erfarenhet från dagligvaruhandel, retail eller FMCG är meriterande.

Varför Coop?

På Coop får du arbeta i en verksamhet där försäljning, kundbeteenden och kommersiella förutsättningar förändras snabbt. Rätt analys kan göra tydlig skillnad för våra prioriteringar, vårt erbjudande och våra resultat.

Du får en central roll nära verksamheten, med stora möjligheter att bidra till hur vi följer upp och utvecklar affären. Genom stabila dataunderlag, tydliga KPI:er och relevanta analyser hjälper du organisationen att fatta välgrundade beslut och skapa ökad försäljning, lönsamhet och kundnytta.

Så Ansöker Du

Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, senast 23/9, då vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer. För att rättvist matcha kandidater med de krav som rollen ställer kommer vi att använda tester under urvalsarbetet.

Title: Customer Lifecycle Analyst
Description:
We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.


Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex customer and lifecycle data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions and customer growth - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!







We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our lifecycle marketing and personalization capabilities to the next level. We need a proactive Customer Lifecycle Analyst to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our Omnichannel and CRM teams. 



Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is dedicated to driving real commercial value across our customer lifecycle journeys and personalized CRM efforts.






What you will be doing


As our Customer Lifecycle Analyst, your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our customer data, map behavior across lifecycle stages (onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation), and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed. 



A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Omnichannel team – led by Bjørnhild Kjørsvik (Head of Omnichannel) – providing them with the actionable insights, segmentation logic, and experimentation rigor needed to optimize relevance and customer lifetime value.



(We’re not looking for a static dashboard generator, but we do value foundational analytical hygiene. You own your data domain end-to-end: from building the pragmatic dashboards and streamlining monthly reporting that keep us grounded, to telling the commercial story behind the numbers.) 

Dig into the "why" behind customer behavior shifts, lifecycle drop-offs, and retention metrics (LTV, churn). You proactively spot anomalies and trends across our customer journeys and bring these insights to light. 
Streamline our recurring monthly lifecycle reporting and create clean, reliable dashboards/data structures that keep the Omnichannel team self-sufficient and aligned on core KPIs.

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Craft:

Job Description:

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Product Analyst to join the Player Value team on Candy Crush Saga. You will own the analytics and operational support that helps the team understand player behaviour, run better experiments, and make faster, sharper decisions. Your primary focus will most likely be the In-App Purchases (IAP) area, though the role may span other parts of the player journey — early funnel, communication systems, or the in-game economy — as priorities evolve.

This is a role for someone who is genuinely independent and analytically driven: comfortable owning the experimentation lifecycle end to end, partnering closely with Product Managers, translating messy data into clear recommendations, and rolling up their sleeves on operational work at Candy scale without balking at it. You will work cross-functionally every day and gain hands-on exposure to AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex, which the team actively uses to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication.

Your Role Within Our Kingdom


Own the experimentation lifecycle end to end for your area — from problem formulation and hypothesis design through analysis, readout, recommendation and follow-up.
Perform quantitative (and, where useful, qualitative) analysis of player behaviour to identify opportunities to improve monetisation, retention and player experience.
Turn complex data into clear insights, recommendations and narratives that Product Managers, Designers and leadership can quickly act upon.
Support pricing decisions by analysing price points, offers and promotions, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and long-term player value.
Help manage the in-game economy by monitoring balance, sinks and sources, and the health of currency and reward systems while proactively identifying risks and opportunities.
Own tracking specifications by defining the events and metrics needed for new features, writing clear tracking documentation and ensuring instrumentation is implemented correctly so data is trustworthy from day one.
Take ownership of operational work at scale, including reporting, observability, data quality, event integrity and coordination, recognising these as essential parts of delivering value in a live game.
Build and maintain Looker dashboards and reporting frameworks that enable self-service analytics and faster decision-making.
Write robust, performant SQL in BigQuery to answer product questions and power analysis and reporting.
Partner closely with Developers, Product Managers and Data Scientists on end-to-end solution delivery, observability, experimentation and data model improvements.
Use segmentation, funnel analysis and journey mapping to explore complex product questions and uncover meaningful insights.
Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to accelerate analysis, prototyping and communication.
Support the Analytics craft through knowledge sharing, strong data definitions, shared standards and mentoring more junior analysts.


What Success Looks Like


You become a trusted analytical partner to your Product Manager, helping shape product decisions through data, experimentation and commercial insight.
You provide reliable, actionable insights that improve product decisions and deepen the team's understanding of players.
You help the team move quickly by surfacing the right facts, reducing ambiguity and connecting data to product outcomes.
You operate effectively in a fast-paced live-game environment, solving problems that rarely come with predefined solutions or established playbooks.
You build strong, trusted relationships with Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics partners, contributing to high-quality end-to-end delivery.
Operational work at scale is executed reliably and efficiently because you treat it as a core part of delivering value rather than a maintenance task.


Skills to Create Thrills Core


Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of deriving meaningful insights from behavioural or product data.
Strong SQL skills (BigQuery preferred) and confidence working independently with large datasets.
Experience owning or contributing to experimentation and A/B testing, including helping design experiments, interpreting results and translating findings into product recommendations.
Dashboarding experience in Looker (or a comparable BI tool) to build reporting and self-service analytics.
Experience using data to support product, business or operational decisions.
Ability to communicate analysis clearly and concisely through strong data visualisation and evidence-based recommendations.
Comfort working cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering and Data Science.
Genuine independence and initiative — comfortable taking ambiguous product problems and driving them through to actionable outcomes.
Willingness to take ownership of operational work at scale, including tracking, observability and data quality, recognising these as essential parts of delivering product value.


Highly Appreciated


Good understanding of statistics, with confidence interpreting experiment results and supporting A/B test analysis.
Python or R for analysis, automation or modelling.
Curiosity about using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex to accelerate analysis, reporting and communication. Previous experience is welcome but not required.
Experience in games, live-service products or another fast-moving consumer product.


Role Scope

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will typically operate at the product-theme or feature level, providing analytical leadership across end-to-end solution delivery. You will identify data-driven opportunities, support cross-functional teams through analysis and coordination, and tackle problems that rarely have predefined solutions.

The role complements Product Management and Data Science rather than replacing either. The Analytics craft's core contribution is data-driven discovery, experimentation, exploration and recommendation, with a strong emphasis on product understanding, operational excellence, technical independence, stakeholder partnership and the ability to translate data into better product decisions.

About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Title: Analyskonsult – från affärsfråga till insikt
Description:
Söker du en roll där affärsfokus alltid kommer först – och där AI redan är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar analyslösningar?




Vi söker nya kollegor till Stockholm.

Den här rollen handlar om att göra data begriplig och användbar. Oavsett om du skapar dashboards, stöttar beslutsfattande eller hjälper till att definiera vilka visualiseringar som passar bäst för problemet – vi söker någon som ser helheten och inte är rädd för att dyka ner i detaljerna




Vi söker dig som har både öga för design och förståelse för data, och som brinner för att göra information tillgänglig och användbar.




Vad du får göra hos oss

Du kommer att arbeta i uppdrag hos våra kunder och verkligen förstå deras behov på djupet. Du omsätter affärsfrågor till datadrivna analyser, prognoser och beslutsstöd som gör skillnad i vardagen. En viktig del av ditt arbete blir att utforma dashboards och rapporter som inte bara ser bra ut i teorin, utan faktiskt används och skapar värde.

Du kommer att:

Arbeta med moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker m.fl.) och bygga lösningar i SQL, Python eller liknande.
Vara en del av hur AI förstärker analytics – exempelvis i prediktiva modeller och automatiserad analys.
Utveckla dig själv och bidra till kunskapsdelning i vårt starka community av data- och AI-specialister.




Vi är ett team av passionerade experter som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och skapar värde tillsammans. Här får du frihet att påverka och en kultur där nyfikenhet och samarbete står i centrum.




Vi tror att du har med dig

Vi letar efter en erfaren BI- och analysspecialist som vill göra verklig skillnad tillsammans med oss. Du har en stark förståelse för affärsprocesser och vet hur man omvandlar dem till smarta datalösningar som skapar värde. Hos oss får du arbeta med moderna verktyg, utveckla din kompetens och bidra till ett öppet och kunskapsdelande community.

Vi tror att du har:

Flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta med analys/BI, som konsult eller internt
Förmåga att förstå affärsprocesser och översätta dem till datadrivna lösningar
Vana att skapa analyser och visualiseringar som används för beslut
Djup kompetens i moderna BI-verktyg (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) samt SQL
Nyfikenhet på hur AI och nya tekniker kan göra analys ännu mer värdeskapande




Vad du får av oss

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.

Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
30 semesterdagar
Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benify.
Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
After Work och hobbyaktiviteter

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer

Location: Solna, Stockholm, Sweden

Start Date: 1st October 2026

End Date: 31st March 2027

Work Style: Monday - Friday / Hybrid, 40 Hours Weekly




Role Objective

Support the Power Forecasts product team in producing local-grid and regional-grid forecasts for housing, transport electrification, industry, and commercial premises.
Maintain and improve a data-driven, automated forecasting workflow centred on Python scripts.
Produce reliable forecasts and insights for network dimensioning, network-development planning, investment decisions, and customer dialogue.
Enhance the quality, efficiency, and analytical value of forecasting, data-modelling, and reporting processes.




Key Responsibilities

Automate forecasting activities previously completed manually using Python within a Databricks environment.
Analyse customer and time-series data to develop improved forecasting methodologies.
Build new Power BI reports and enhance existing reports through data modelling, calculations, and additional functionality.
Update power forecasts for specific geographical areas and generate quantitative and qualitative insights.
Assess data availability, combine information from multiple sources, and ensure data quality and reliability.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to internal and external stakeholders.




Tasks

Develop clear and efficient Python code to automate forecast preparation and processing.
Conduct both defined analyses and exploratory investigations into customer and time-series data.
Collaborate with colleagues from other disciplines to assess potential changes to forecasting methodology.
Develop Power BI data models, calculations, visualisations, and report functionality.
Gather, validate, process, and quality-assure input data used in power forecasts.
Liaise with municipalities and local-grid customers when updating forecasts for specific areas.
Prepare and present forecast results, insights, and supporting materials to relevant stakeholders.
Contribute to the continuous development of automated and data-driven ways of working within the product team.




Deliverables

Automated and maintainable forecasting workflows within Databricks.
Updated local-grid and regional-grid power forecasts.
Customer-data and time-series analyses supporting methodology development.
Accurate and usable Power BI reports, data models, and calculations.
Quality-assured datasets, analytical insights, and stakeholder presentation materials.




Decision Authority / Responsibility

Own assigned analysis, automation, reporting, and forecast-update activities through to completion.
Recommend improvements to forecasting methodologies, data models, and automated workflows based on evidence and analysis.
Identify and escalate material data-quality, reliability, and methodological risks.
Ensure analytical results and reporting outputs are clear, reliable, and suitable for stakeholder decision-making.




Requirements

Several years of experience analysing large datasets, particularly customer data and time series, including data manipulation, modelling, and presentation of results to stakeholders.
Several years of experience developing efficient, understandable code using Python or a comparable programming language.
Professional experience in the electricity-network sector or other relevant energy-industry experience.
Professional experience with data-visualisation tools such as Power BI.
Strong analytical ability and advanced problem-solving skills.
Able to communicate complex findings and messages clearly to different stakeholders.
Relevant academic degree, such as an MSc in Engineering in Applied Physics, Energy Systems, Electrical Power Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
Previous experience in insight generation and/or forecasting is advantageous.
Experience working in an Agile Scrum team or equivalent environment is advantageous.
Experience with artificial intelligence and machine learning is advantageous.
Experience with SQL or an equivalent query language is advantageous.

Title: CUSTOMER INSIGHTS ANALYST
Description:
Challenges You Will Work On

At SAS, we are strengthening how we work with customer feedback and insight across the organization. We are looking for a CX Analyst to help manage our Voice of the Customer program, support research activities and turn customer feedback and customer data into actionable insights.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who is curious, analytical, technically minded and eager to grow. You'll work closely with researchers, experience specialists and business stakeholders while developing hands-on expertise in modern insight tools, analytics and customer experience practices.

In this role, you will help manage and evolve our Voice of the Customer capabilities, turning customer feedback and data into insights that support better decisions and customer experiences across SAS.

Your Responsibilities Include


Manage and maintain customer feedback programs, primarily in Qualtrics
Support survey design, programming, testing, deployment, and reporting
Analyze customer feedback, customer data and operational data to generate actionable insight
Support reporting across key customer metrics such as NPS and CSAT
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reporting solutions
Help improve and automate insight processes, reporting, and workflows
Work with customer journey data and feedback to support experience improvement initiatives
Partner with your colleagues across the Customer Insight & Customer Experience team and the wider organization to ensure customer insight contributes to decision-making and experience improvements


In your first months, you will build a strong understanding of our customers, feedback programs, tools and ways of working while developing the analytical and technical capabilities needed to grow within the role.

The Team

You will be part of a newly established central Customer Experience & Insights team, helping strengthen how customer feedback and insight are used across SAS to improve customer experience and business performance.

We combine insight and execution, focusing on turning customer understanding into concrete improvements and embedding CX in how teams workday today. We work closely with stakeholders across SAS to make customer experience practical, actionable and consistent.

To be successful we believe you have


A strong interest in analytics, customer insights, research and customer experience
1-3 years of experience in analytics, customer insights, market research, CX or a related field
Experience with SQL, or a strong interest in developing SQL capabilities
Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms
Quantitative and analytical skills, with an interest in turning data into actionable insights
Familiarity with statistics and survey methodologies, dashboarding and reporting tools
A natural curiosity for technology, data and modern ways of working
Strong communication skills and an eagerness to present findings clearly and effectively
Experience working in agile, product or cross-functional teams is an advantage
A proactive mindset, taking ownership of your work and continuously looking for improvements
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field


Why SAS?

Benefits

At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:


Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


Our Culture at SAS

At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work.

Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!

Additional information


Deadline for application: 21/09/26. Please send us your CV as soon as possible, as interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
Position: Fulltime (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period
This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm), and you will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
A background check will be conducted at the final stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. If you are aware of any specific matters that may come up during this background check, we kindly ask you to be transparent about them during the recruitment process.


If you have questions about this position, you are welcome to contact Emma Christofferson, Head of Customer, Title via email: emma.christofferson@sas.se. Please note that we are not able to handle any applications that are sent by email due to the GDPR regulations.

Title: Senior Data Scientist till Swedbank Hypotek
Description:
Har du en passion för bolån?

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:


Fördjupa dina kunskaper om den svenska bolånemarknaden genom samarbete med erfarna kollegor.
Samarbeta med andra specialistteam för att utveckla datadrivna arbetssätt och initiativ.
Proaktivt identifiera affärsmöjligheter och förbättringsområden genom avancerad dataanalys.
Ta fram beslutsunderlag och presentera insikter till management och andra beslutsfattare.
Utveckla och underhålla BI-lösningar för analys, rapportering och uppföljning av resultat.
Vidareutveckla datamodeller som möjliggör bättre uppföljning och styrning av affären.



I denna roll behöver du:

Grundläggande krav:


Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet av att arbeta som Data Scientist eller Data Analyst.
Du är bekväm med att använda Python och SQL.
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med visualiseringsverktyg som PowerBI och Qlik Sense.
Förmåga att driva uppgifter självständigt.
Relevant akademisk utbildning inom statistik, ekonomi, datavetenskap, matematik eller motsvarande.
Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
Bosatt i Sverige, med placering i Stockholm med omnejd.



Meriterande kvalifikationer:


Erfarenhet från arbete inom bank eller andra finansiella tjänster.
Kunskap om bolånemarknaden och fastighetsmarknaden.
Erfarenhet från verktyg som Snowflake och Databricks.
Erfarenhet av språkmodeller.



Hos oss kan du uppleva:


Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.



"Bli en del av vårt team och...

bli en del av ett internationellt team med professionella kollegor, som arbetar tillsammans för att leverera utmanande projekt, maximera kundnöjdheten och bidra till Swedbanks position i samhället.”. Urban Alsholm, din framtida chef
