Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 30/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Konsult inom Power BI
Description:
Heltid - Stockholm




Som konsult hos Exsitec är ditt viktigaste mål att skapa värde åt våra kunder. Vi arbetar med att hjälpa våra kunder att förstå sin verksamhet genom att visualisera den data som finns i kundens verksamhetssystem samt bygga moderna, stabila datalager. På detta sätt hjälper vi våra kunder att fatta beslut baserade på fakta istället för magkänsla – detta kallas Business Intelligence.




Exsitec har på kort tid vuxit fram som en av Sveriges största BI leverantörer och vår tillväxt inom Power BI-området fortsätter att accelerera. Vi är därmed på en spännande tillväxtresa och vi behöver hitta fler kollegor som brinner för att hjälpa våra kunder bli mer framgångsrika med hjälp av Business Intelligence.




Vi söker efter dig som önskar att vara del av ett mindre team med stora ambitioner. Området kommer framåt vara viktigt för Exsitecs erbjudande och därför planerar vi att växa som team i takt med att försäljningen av Power BI och Fabric ökar.




Tillsammans med kunden kommer du att designa och bygga lösningar från datalager och datatransformering i Fabric till färdiga rapporter i Power BI. Lösningarna hjälper organisationen att bättre se, förstå och agera utifrån sina data. Som Business Intelligence-konsult får du jobba nära kravställare/användare och kommer se den nytta dina lösningar skapar för kunderna.




Hos oss blir du en del av vårt växande team där tillsammansheten är något vi brinner starkt för. Du får en härlig onboarding med fokus på teamkänsla, hjälpsamhet och tid till att lära.




Vi söker dig som:

Har 1-3 års erfarenhet och letar efter nya utmaningar
Älskar problemlösning såväl i arbetslivet som på fritiden
Är nyfiken och noggrann
Är driven och självständig
Gillar att utvecklas genom samarbete med andra människor
Är öppen, du säger vad du menar och menar vad du säger




Nödvändiga färdigheter och kvalifikationer

Du har arbetat tidigare i en roll där du på något sätt har kommit i kontakt med dataanalys
Kunskaper inom datamodellering, databaser, SQL
Har erfarenhet av ett BI-system




Meriterande färdigheter

Har arbetat med Azure
Har erfarenhet av att arbete med Power BI eller Fabric




Du gillar:

Att få inblick i och förstå de finansiella drivarna i många olika företag
Att bygga innovativa och användbara lösningar
Att bygga enkla gränssnitt mellan teknik och människa




Ta kontakt med oss så berättar vi mer!

Title: CS Data Operation Manager (1 year temp)
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS Data Operation Manager in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 

(Note that this is a temporary employment for 1 year)

The role 

As a CS Data Operations Manager, you will drive data-informed decision making across the Customer Service organization by managing reporting, forecasting, KPI tracking, and financial follow-up. You will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support operational performance, strategic planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Customer Service and the wider business, providing meaningful analysis and recommendations that drive business outcomes.

What we’re looking for 

Role

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:


You are a curious, analytical, and data-driven person who loves turning numbers into insights and insights into action. You enjoy digging into data, spotting trends, and finding opportunities to improve both performance and ways of working.
You are comfortable working with reporting, forecasting, KPIs, and financial follow-up, and you can translate complex data into clear and useful insights for different stakeholders. You take ownership of your work, are highly organized, and enjoy improving processes, dashboards, and tools along the way.
We believe you are a great communicator and a collaborative team player who is also comfortable working independently. Most importantly, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and always looking for ways to make things better.


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience in Excel and PowerPoint
A good understanding of data visualization
Understanding what metrics are relevant and why
Experience in customer service and working with BPOs
5+ years of experience in a data analyst position


What we offer you

We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Analytics Engineer Stockholm
Description:
Jobbeskrivning

Som Analytics Engineer på Sopra Steria får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande och uppdrag hos ledande företag och organisationer, både inom offentlig och privat sektor. Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor bygger du lösningar som stärker samhällsfunktioner och förbättrar vardagen för tusentals människor. Genom dina goda tekniska kunskaper och din förståelse för verksamheten skapar du stort värde hos våra kunder. Du arbetar med modern dataanalys och BI-utveckling i Power BI samt den bakomliggande dataplattformen, och bidrar till utvecklingen av framtidssäkrade analyslösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att dessa ligger till grund för utveckling av rapporter och den bakomliggande datan. Vidare tillgängliggör du data för verksamheten genom analys, visualisering och strategisk rådgivning.

Uppdragen genomförs oftast i teamleveranser där du får påverka hela analyskedjan – från datainsamling och modellering till visualisering och beslutsstöd. Hos oss finns ett starkt fokus på kunskapsdelning och utveckling, både tekniskt och som team.

Oavsett om du har några års erfarenhet eller är senior och söker nästa stora utmaning, erbjuder vi en miljö där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vi tror att du har:


Några års erfarenhet av att jobba i molnet med dataanalys, BI eller data engineering med fokus på Power BI & semantiska modeller.
Jobbat nära verksamheten med att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till analysfunktionalitet.
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse och/eller Azure Databricks.
God förståelse för DAX, SQL och modellering.
Är van vid att arbeta i både svenska och internationella miljöer – du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift.


Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Python, Qlik, Tableau, Data Engineering, AI och Data Science.

Att jobba på Sopra Steria

Vi växer tillsammans, delar kunskap och har roligt på vägen. Hos oss får du arbeta i spännande projekt på en flexibel arbetsplats med schyssta förmåner. Hos oss är det viktigt att kunna växa i sin roll, och vi avsätter tid för lärande och certifieringar och har ett starkt community för kunskapsdelning. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här!

Ansök nu – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

Title: Business Analyst – Graduate 2027
Description:
Graduating in 2027? Analytical and quick to connect the dots between numbers and what they actually mean, turning insight into new ideas and better ways of doing things? Ambitious, curious and the kind of person people genuinely enjoy working with? And more interested in building a business than spending your first years watching from the sidelines? Keep reading.

We're looking for a few exceptional graduates to join Anyfin in 2027.

We're not hiring you into one narrowly defined analyst box. You could end up working across Growth, Credit, Finance, Product, Operations or somewhere we haven't even decided yet depending on what you're great at and where the biggest opportunities are.

Anyfin exists to make finance actually work for people, not against them. Replacing the fine print and hidden fees of traditional credit with something transparent and fair. We've been building with AI at the core since long before it was trendy, and it's now central to how we design products, make decisions, and move fast. We're building the next generation of consumer finance, and we're only getting started: new products, new markets, and a lot more of Europe to

That means a lot of important questions we don't have the answers to yet.

That's where you come in.

What You Might Actually Do

Your exact scope will depend on where you land, but you could be:


Figuring out why something is growing or why it isn't
Analyzing customer behavior, pricing, profitability, acquisition or credit performance
Building models and forecasts that influence where we invest
Evaluating new products, markets or business opportunities
Turning messy data into a recommendation and then being in the room when the decision gets made


You won't spend your first year producing reports for someone more senior to have an opinion about.

We expect you to develop opinions of your own.

You won't be one of 1000

We're not trying to become a huge company for the sake of becoming a huge company. We hire carefully, and every person we add matters.

So no, you won't be one of 500 graduates joining Anyfin next year.

You'll be one of a small number of people we've deliberately chosen to bet on.

You'll know the people making the decisions. They'll know you. Your work will be visible, your ideas will be heard, and there won't be five layers of organization between you and the interesting problems.

That comes with high expectations. It also comes with a lot of opportunities.

Who We're Looking For

You're probably graduating in 2027 with a degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or something else that has taught you how to think analytically.

But we're less interested in the name of your degree than in how your brain works.

You're very good with numbers. Curious. Quick to learn. Comfortable solving problems that don't come with instructions. You can go deep into data without losing sight of the business and explain complicated things without making them sound complicated.

Excel is expected. SQL is great. Python or other analytical tools are a plus.

Previous full-time experience isn't required. Internships, student jobs, side projects, building something yourself or simply being unusually good at what you do all count.

About Your 15-year Career Plan

We can't put a 15-year career ladder in front of you and tell you exactly which title you'll have at every step.

We're a growing company. Things change. Teams evolve. New problems appear.

What we can promise is that you won't have to wait years to be useful.

You'll work alongside experienced people, get exposure across the business and be trusted with meaningful problems early.

If you're great, your scope will grow. Probably faster than your job title can keep up.

And if, a few years from now, you haven't grown further, learned faster and taken on more responsibility than you thought you would when you joined, we'll consider that a failure on our side too.

There are easier places to start your career. There are probably more predictable ones too.

But if you're looking for somewhere you can learn ridiculously fast, have real impact and look back after a few years thinking “I can't believe they let me do all of that” – this could be for you.

Graduating in 2027? We'd love to hear from you.

Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

Title: BI Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About The Job

We’re looking for an ambitious and curious Analyst with 1–3 years of experience to join our Copenhagen HQ. You’ll be passionate about transforming data into insights and developing high-value analytical solutions that support Flatpay’s continued growth.

As part of our growing Analytics team, you’ll work in a dynamic and collaborative environment where data is central to decision-making. Collaboration, friendliness, and a relaxed atmosphere are important parts of how we work.

In this role, you’ll develop commercial reporting and analysis across different areas of the business. This will include both high-level reporting for senior management and operational reporting that helps teams make better day-to-day decisions.

You’ll become the analytical domain expert for selected areas of the business. This means building a deep understanding of their processes, performance drivers, and data, and taking responsibility for ensuring that stakeholders have the insights they need.

What You’ll Do

As an Analyst at Flatpay, you’ll work across a wide range of analytical and reporting tasks using diverse datasets. Your role will focus on strengthening how we track, understand, and act on commercial and operational performance.

You’ll work closely with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate business questions into clear analysis, reporting, and recommendations. You’ll also review and improve our existing data models and reports to ensure they meet business needs and follow modern analytical practices.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Understanding and exploring business needs related to data, analysis, and reporting
Building and maintaining commercial reports and KPI frameworks
Developing high-level reporting and analysis for senior management
Creating operational reports and dashboards that support day-to-day decision-making
Becoming the analytical domain expert for selected areas of the business
Developing a strong understanding of the processes, KPIs, and performance drivers within your domains
Identifying trends, inefficiencies, risks, and commercial opportunities
Turning complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Developing and maintaining reports and dashboards, primarily in Power BI
Ensuring data quality and accuracy through testing and validation
Optimising existing reports and analyses based on business needs and user feedback
Testing and implementing new AI solutions in dashboard development, analytical workflows, or standalone AI applications.


Who You Are

To succeed in this role, you should be comfortable working with data and have practical experience with Power BI and SQL. You’re naturally curious, eager to understand how a business works, and motivated by turning data into decisions and measurable commercial impact.

You’re independent, results-driven, and adaptable, and you perform well in a fast-paced and agile environment. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders, challenging existing ways of working, and communicating analytical findings clearly to both operational teams and senior management.

Your Skills And Experience


1–3 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role
Experience developing reports and visualisations in Power BI
Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
The ability to explain commercial and analytical concepts clearly and simply
A degree in economics, business, computer science, data analytics, or a related field
A strong business mindset and focus on commercial results


Nice to have


Experience with commercial or operational performance analysis
Experience creating reporting for senior management
Familiarity with data modelling tools such as dbt
Experience working in a fast-growing or international company
Knowledge of the payments or fintech industry


Why Flatpay?


Work from our HQ in Copenhagen and play a key role in shaping how we use data across the business
Take ownership of analytical domains and become a trusted partner to key stakeholders
Work on reporting ranging from senior management insights to operational decision support
Have a high-impact role with visibility across multiple parts of the organisation
Join a fast-paced environment where insights quickly turn into action


Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Title: Dataanalytiker med stærke formidlingsevner til analyseteamet i Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltningen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Søg jobbet

Område

Politik og administration

Ansøgningsfrist

09.10.2026

Arbejdstid

Fuldtid

Jobtype

Fastansættelse

Søg jobbet

Er du skarp til dataanalyse og samtidig dygtig til at formidle komplekse indsigter klart og forståeligt?

Så er du måske vores nye kollega i analyseteamet i Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune.

Vi søger engagerede dataanalytikere, der kan arbejde struktureret med data i Power BI og omsætte data til værdifuld viden for organisationen.

Om stillingen

Som dataanalytiker bliver du en central del af vores analyseteam, hvor du arbejder med at bearbejde, analysere og visualisere data, der understøtter beslutningstagning på tværs af organisationen. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at data ikke blot bliver analyseret – men også forstået og anvendt. Data og analyser spiller en vigtig rolle i mange af forvaltningens sager, og du vil derfor få en bred kontaktflade. Du skal derfor befinde dig godt til rette i et område med stor bevågenhed og betydning for hele forvaltningen.

Dine opgaver vil være en kombination af faste opgaver og ad hoc-bestillinger og vil spænde lige fra analyse, formidling og beslutningsoplæg til koordinering og projektledelse. Du vil desuden udarbejde notater, indstillinger, andre skriftlige oplæg og præsentationer, der understøtter ledelse, direktion og politiske processer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være


Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af rapporter og dashboards i Power BI
Analyse af data med fokus på at identificere mønstre, tendenser og forbedringsmuligheder
Formidling af analyseresultater til både faglige specialister og ikke-tekniske interessenter
Sparring med kolleger og ledelse om datadrevne beslutninger
Bidrag til udvikling af datakvalitet og datastandarder.


Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du


Har erfaring med databehandling, -analyse og -visualisering og er fortrolig med værktøjer som Excel og Power BI
Har en relevant videregående uddannelse med en stærk kvantitativ profil, f.eks. økonomi, statskundskab, statistik, sociologi, social datavidenskab eller lignende
Har en analytisk tilgang og evner at arbejde struktureret med data
Er stærk i skriftlig og mundtlig formidling og kan gøre komplekse analyser let forståelige
Er nysgerrig, proaktiv og trives i samarbejde med forskellige fagligheder
Er opsøgende på samarbejde og ser det som en forudsætning for at lykkedes.


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med datamodellering, f.eks. ved brug af SQL, Python eller lignende værktøjer, og hvis du tidligere har arbejdet i større organisationer med mange interessenter.

Et godt arbejdsmiljø med plads til udvikling og fordybelse

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at omsætte data til analyser og ledelsesinformation, der bidrager til et stærkt beslutningsgrundlag for chefer, direktion og politisk niveau samt til udviklingen af forvaltningens indsatser til gavn for både borgere og virksomheder.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt analyseteam i Danmarks største Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltning, hvor opgaverne er komplekse og samfundsvigtige.

Området er i disse år præget af implementeringen af beskæftigelsesreformen, som giver kommunerne større frihed og ændrer de organisatoriske og styringsmæssige rammer.

Det giver dig en unik mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle, hvordan data anvendes til at understøtte fremtidens indsatser. Det betyder også, at du vil arbejde i en organisation i bevægelse, hvor der er plads til nye idéer og initiativer.

Vi lægger vægt på din faglige og personlige udvikling og tilbyder gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling, sparring med dygtige kolleger og indflydelse på egne opgaver. Samtidig har vi et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med høj grad af samarbejde, fleksible arbejdsforhold og en god balance mellem arbejdsliv og fritid.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Lønnen afhænger af dine kvalifikationer og forhandles indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Kommunernes Landsforening og relevant faglig organisation.

Yderligere oplysninger

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte budget- og analysechef Julie Alsing på 51 63 34 00.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi afholder samtaler den 20. og 21. oktober.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt analyseteam i Danmarks største Beskæftigelses-, Integrations-, og Erhvervsforvaltning, hvor opgaverne er komplekse og samfundsvigtige.

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Lønnen afhænger af dine kvalifikationer og forhandles indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Kommunernes Landsforening og relevant faglig organisation.

Title: Dataanalytiker til Efterretnings- og Analysecentret i National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:

Din nye hverdag

Efterretnings- og Analysecenteret (EAC) er en del af National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK), som samler politiets og anklagemyndighedens specialiserede indsats mod organiseret, økonomisk og digital kriminalitet.

I Sektionen for analyse og projekter udarbejder vi analyser og efterretningsprodukter, som giver NSK bedre grundlag for at træffe taktiske, operative og strategiske beslutninger. Vi følger og kortlægger udviklingen i de kriminelle miljøer og undersøger nye kriminalitetstyper, fremgangsmåder og trusler.

Den viden omsætter vi til kriminalitets- og efterretningsanalyser, som giver ledelsen et oplyst og kvalificeret grundlag for at træffe beslutninger.

Som dataanalytiker har du en specialiseret rolle i den datamæssige del af analysearbejdet. Du samler og bearbejder data fra politiets egne systemer og eksterne datakilder og får forskellige formater og strukturer til at hænge sammen. Du omsætter rå data til et gennemarbejdet og dokumenteret datagrundlag, som sektionens øvrige analytikere kan bruge i deres analyser og vurderinger. Din opgave er dermed ikke primært at skrive de endelige analyseprodukter, men at finde de mønstre og forbindelser, som gør dem mulige og kvalificerer deres konklusioner.

Du Arbejder Blandt Andet Med At


udtrække, rense, strukturere og kvalitetssikre store og komplekse datasæt
koble data fra forskellige kilder og bearbejde data, der gør sammenhænge analyserbare og synlige
Udføre netværksanalyser (SNA) og andre kvantitative analyser, der synliggør relationer, mønstre og afvigelser
bruge eksempelvis Python eller R i dit arbejde med bearbejdning og analyse af store datasæt
udvikle og anvende metoder inden for ex. machine learning, der kan kvalificere eller effektivisere analysearbejdet
dokumentere datagrundlag, metoder og begrænsninger, så kollegerne kan anvende resultaterne sikkert.


Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med analytikere og andre fagligheder om at skabe det bedst mulige datagrundlag for vores analyser. Vi deler viden, udfordrer hinandens perspektiver og hjælper hinanden på tværs af sektionen. Omgangstonen er uformel, og vi lægger vægt på et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi vil være de bedste på vores område og lægger vægt på faglig udvikling og nye idéer. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dine egne kompetencer og bidrage til sektionens fortsatte udvikling. Vores arbejde er vigtigt og meningsfyldt, og vi ved af erfaring, at gode analyser kan få stor betydning for NSK’s arbejde.

Vores nye kollega

Vi søger dig, der har stærke dataanalytiske kompetencer og erfaring med at strukturere, koble og modellere data fra forskellige kilder. Du kan bruge programmering, eksempelvis Python eller R, til at behandle data og løse komplekse problemstillinger. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med machine learning, og det er en særlig fordel, hvis du også kan arbejde med social netværksanalyse, og skabe overblik over relationer mellem personer, grupper og hændelser.

Du har en relevant universitetsuddannelse, fx inden for social data Science eller et andet samfundsvidenskabeligt eller dataanalytisk område. Erfaring fra en lignende stillinger en fordel, herunder gerne i politiet eller andre efterretningsbaserede virksomheder og myndigheder. men det er ikke et krav.

Vi lægger derudover vægt på, at du:


Kan omsætte data, metoder og komplekse resultater til viden, som dine kolleger kan forstå og anvende
har en stærk talforståelse og kan visualisere data klart og forståeligt
arbejder analytisk, selvstændigt og struktureret og følger dine opgaver til dørs
tager initiativ og bringer din faglighed i spil i samarbejdet med andre
kan sætte dig ind i organisationens og analytikernes behov
Kan kommunikere sikkert på engelsk og dansk.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du ansættes på overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Der er til stillingen knyttet en fuldt arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit arbejdssted bliver National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet med adresse på Ejby Industrivej 125-135, 2600 Glostrup.

Din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid er 37 timer inkl. betalt frokostpause. Vores normale åbningstid er mandag-onsdag kl. 8-16, torsdag kl. 8-15 og fredag kl. 8-14, men vi tilbyder flekstid og mulighed for i høj grad selv at tilrettelægge din arbejdstid. Efter en grundig introduktion til stillingen og dine kolleger, tilbyder vi muligheden for hjemmearbejde op til to dage om ugen

Politiet ønsker at understøtte og fremme medarbejdernes fysiske sundhed. Derfor har vi røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid. Vi har en fælles kantine, der tilbyder morgenmad og frokostbuffet med salatbar og et bredt udvalg af sunde retter. Vi har en idrætsforening, vores eget fitnesscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du kan blive sikkerhedsgodkendt og kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele dit ansættelsesforhold.

Den forventede ansættelsesdato er 1. marts 2027 eller så snart du er blevet sikkerhedsgodkendt.

Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler 20. oktober 2026.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du har uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Malte Conrad på 2115-7646. Hvis du har spørgsmål til vores ansættelsesforhold, kan du kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Anne Hansen på 2484-7798.

Du kan følge NSK på LinkedIn og finde information om politiet som arbejdsplads her.

Når du søger en stilling i politiet, opretter du samtidig en profil i vores rekrutteringssystem. Vi beder dig uploade ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis for din relevante grunduddannelse.

Ansøgningen skal være ganske kort og kun indeholde svar på følgende spørgsmål:


Hvorfor vil du gerne arbejde i NSK og for politiet
Hvilke dataanalytiske værktøjer tænker du er mest relevante i arbejdet for NSK og hvorfor?
Beskriv en analyse du er stolt af og hvorfor?


Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge stillingen uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet som arbejdsplads

I National enhed for Særlig Kriminalitet (NSK) bliver du en del af en landsdækkende specialenhed, hvor højt specialiserede fagfolk arbejder tæt sammen med et fælles formål: at beskytte Danmark mod den mest komplekse og samfundsskadelige kriminalitet. Det er en særlig opgave.

Vi efterforsker og strafforfølger komplekse sager inden for organiseret kriminalitet, økonomisk kriminalitet og digital kriminalitet. Derudover understøtter vi også politikredsene i hele Rigsfællesskabet med vores særlige ekspertise i kriminalteknik, it-efterforskning samt analyse- og efterretningsarbejde.

Når du træder ind ad døren i NSK, møder du politifolk, anklagere, analytikere, teknikere, it-specialister, administrative og mange andre fagligheder. Vi er mange – og vi er forskellige. Du får godt 1.200 dedikerede kolleger, der trods forskelligheder har det til fælles, at vi alle bidrager med hver vores særlige styrke og dybe faglighed.

Kriminaliteten udvikler sig hele tiden, og det samme gør kravene til os. Derfor prioriterer vi faglig udvikling, vidensdeling og samarbejde højt.

I NSK finder vi stor mening i vores arbejde, fordi vores opgaver har et klart og vigtigt formål. Det, vi gør, bidrager direkte til at beskytte samfundet og styrke retssikkerheden. Det er et særligt ansvar. Det er derfor, vi arbejder i NSK.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Senior Data Analyst

Posting Start Date: 9/10/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Senior Data Analyst – SAP Reporting & Stakeholder Alignment


Location: Copenhagen, Denmark or Lisbon, Portugal
Working hours: Full-time
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type: Permanent


Are you passionate about turning business questions into meaningful data solutions? Do you enjoy working with stakeholders, solving complex data challenges, and transforming data into insights that drive better decisions? Then you might be the person we are looking for.

As our new Senior Data Analyst, you will join the Data & Insights team and report directly to the Head of Data & Insights. In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and SAP data, ensuring reporting requirements are clearly defined, translated into actionable data solutions, and delivered with accuracy and impact.

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Engineering teams to support data-driven decision-making while improving reporting processes and data quality across the organization. This is a great opportunity to influence business decisions, collaborate across functions, and help shape the future of data and analytics at STG.

What Your Day Will Look Like

In this role, you will typically focus on:


Partner directly with business stakeholders — Finance leadership, Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain/Operations — to understand their reporting and data needs, and translate them into concrete data requirements.
Work closely with data engineers to scope, request, and validate data pulled from SAP, acting as the translation layer between business language and technical/data specifications.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, validate, and consolidate data for recurring and ad hoc reporting.
Build and maintain Excel-based models, trackers, and reports that stakeholders rely on for decision-making.
Consolidate data into stakeholder-ready reporting, and supporting data checks.
Act as the go-to person for scoping ambiguous stakeholder requests — clarifying what's actually needed, managing expectations, and pushing back constructively when a request isn't well-defined or feasible.
Identify data quality issues at the source and work with SAP module owners and data engineers to resolve them.
Document data definitions, sources, and logic so reporting stays consistent and auditable month over month.
Continuously look for ways to streamline the process rather than repeating manual work each cycle.


What You'll Bring


5+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar data-facing role, ideally in a retail or consumer business.
Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing and troubleshooting complex queries independently.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, data modeling; Power Query is a plus).
Familiarity with SAP data structures, particularly FI (Finance) and SD (Sales & Distribution).
Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), or willingness to learn it, is a plus.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Business, Economics, Finance, Data/Statistics, Engineering, or related).
Proven experience gathering requirements from business stakeholders and translating them into technical/data specifications.
Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align multiple stakeholders (including Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, and IT/data engineering) with sometimes competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs clearly.
Comfortable operating with a degree of ambiguity and turning it into a structured plan.


Working At STG & What To Expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

At STG you'll find more than a role. You'll find opportunities to grow, learn from talented colleagues, and contribute to initiatives that help drive business performance across a global organization.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 45.000 to 50.000 DKK/Monthly, corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience, and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger?

Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process

Requirements

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:


Recruiter screen
Interview with the hiring team
Final interview with key stakeholders


Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

"Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs."

Title: Senior Insights Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
A great opportunity to turn data into proper impact in a global retail organization.




In the position as Senior Insights Analyst, you will turn data from our Databricks Lakehouse into trusted insights that shape better decisions across Flying Tiger Copenhagen.




You will own the semantic layer, build powerful self-service datasets, and create reporting and analytics that put meaningful insights in the hands of the people who need them.




You will report to the Enterprise Architect and become a key member of the Architecture & Engineering department at our HQ in the heart of Copenhagen.




Responsibilities include:

Design and deliver insights and reporting solutions across all technology and business initiatives, including semantic layer on Databricks and optimization of Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, reports and dashboards.
Define, document and govern KPI definitions to ensure consistent metrics and a single source of truth across the business.
Implement reporting governance and quality standards, including certified datasets and workspace management.
Enable self-service analytics for business users, including training, documentation and best-practice guidance.
Translate business questions from departments into clear analytical deliverables and deliver demos and handovers to end users.
Act as the senior analytics resource on the team and provide guidance on analytical, data modeling and data visualization best practices.




This is you:

+5 years of experience in data, analytics or business intelligence roles, with progressive responsibility for data modeling and insights delivery.
Hands-on dimensional modeling experience - star/snowflake schema design, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions and aggregation strategies.
Hands-on experience with Power BI (including semantic modeling), and Databricks (including semantic layer design and definition).
Strong SQL capabilities for building robust and maintainable analytical datasets; Python for analytics is a plus.
Experience with KPI and metric frameworks, data governance and self-service analytics enablement. Retail industry experience is a plus.




As a person, you are analytical, solutions-oriented, and skilled at turning data into clear, actionable insights. You have strong data storytelling and visualization skills and communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences.




Finally, you are a natural project manager and collaborative team player who enjoys engaging stakeholders, driving initiatives forward, and delivering presentations and training to empower end users.




Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:

A fantastic central Copenhagen location.
Attractive pension scheme.
Private health insurance (including children).
Flexible working, including the option to work from home.
A fun, social, and dynamic culture.
Events, Friday bars, staff clubs, and more.
An international workplace rooted in Scandinavian values.
Daily restaurant-quality food.
…and much more.




If this sounds like the right professional match for you, we encourage you to apply. Please include a short motivation text in the top of your CV – cover letter is not required.

Title: Lead Data Analyst (Pricing & Monetization)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

About the Role

Data isn’t just a byproduct of our business; it’s the engine that drives our growth. We are looking for a Lead Pricing & Monetization Analyst to join our Go-To-Market (GTM) Analytics team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role designed for a seasoned expert who can bridge the gap between complex statistical modeling and strategic GTM execution in a B2B SaaS environment.

Your mission is to help us answer critical questions about our go-to-market strategy, driving growth across the customer lifecycle. You will lead the charge in analyzing our revenue engine and providing crucial insights into our pricing architecture and monetization strategies to maximize our overall commercial impact.

The GTM Analytics team operates in a semi-embedded model where each analyst serves as a trusted partner and owner for a specific strategic focus area. In this role, you’ll focus on empowering the Pricing & Monetization team while working cross-functionally across our commercial organization, and broader analytics and data teams. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Pricing & Monetization Analytics: Partner with product and commercial leadership to evaluate pricing and packaging strategies, analyzing discount behaviors and tracking the financial performance of new monetization initiatives.
Advanced Statistical Analysis: Design and execute complex analyses, including cohort analysis, customer segmentation (clustering), and predictive modeling to identify growth levers.
Tool & Capability Development: Build and scale our analytics infrastructure. This includes developing proprietary solutions in R/Python and integrating them into our data stack.
Stakeholder Influence: Provide actionable insights to collaborate with, and influence stakeholders in making data informed decisions and drive data literacy around GTM optimization.
Scalable Reporting: Architect intuitive dashboards in Looker that don't just show data, but provide actionable insights for stakeholders ranging from Commercial Ops to executive leadership.
Data Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with our data engineering team using dbt to ensure our GTM data pipelines are robust, efficient, and "analyst-ready."

Who You Are

A Proven Analytical Lead: You bring demonstrated experience successfully driving strategic GTM initiatives, establishing best-in-class analytical standards, and mentoring team members to elevate overall capabilities across the analytics function.
A Technical Expert: You are fluent in SQL and R/Python and have a solid understanding of regression models, clustering, propensity and statistical significance with an ability to apply them to complex commercial and GTM problems.
A Strategic GTM Thinker: You have several years of experience solving go-to-market problems using appropriate analytical techniques. You don't just build models; you understand the "why" behind the numbers. You understand core SaaS metrics and have experience evaluating pricing strategies, monetization models, or commercial packaging structures.
A Trusted Advisor: You possess strong stakeholder management skills knowing how to challenge assumptions and guide leadership toward data-informed decisions.
An Expert Communicator: You can explain complex solutions and models to a non-technical audience and present a compelling case for strategic optimization to executive leadership.
Data Storytelling: You have proven experience with Looker (LookML) or similar BI tools, emphasizing best practices in data storytelling.
A Data Architect: You have a high bar for data quality and have experience working within modern data stacks (e.g BigQuery, dbt, Airflow)

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

LI-MG1

 

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.

Title: Vi søger BI-specialist med stærke kompetencer inden for Power BI, dataanalyse og ledelsesrapportering
Description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle datadrevet ledelsesinformation og skabe Power BI-løsninger, der giver ledelsen et stærkt grundlag for at styre driften? Er du teknisk stærk i Power BI, skarp på data og god til at omsætte komplekse datamængder til overskuelige rapporter så er det måske dig, vi søger.




I Vurderingsstyrelsen står vi over for en stor opgave med vurderingen af landets erhvervs-, land- og skovejendomme. Det stiller krav til stærk og anvendelig ledelsesinformation, der gør os i stand til at følge produktionen, identificere udvikling og tendenser og understøtte ledelsens beslutninger.




I vores kontor, Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring, søger vi derfor en teknisk stærk BI-specialist til vores BI-team. Teamet består i dag af tre kolleger, der udvikler og vedligeholder vores Power BI-løsninger, og sammen skal I videreudvikle vores BI-område og ledelsesrapportering.




Som BI-specialist bliver du en del af et team, hvor I sammen har ansvar for at udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere vores rapportering i Power BI. Du kommer ind i et eksisterende fagligt miljø, hvor der allerede arbejdes med Power BI, men hvor vi ønsker at styrke vores tekniske BI-kompetencer og videreudvikle den måde, vi arbejder med data, rapportering og ledelsesinformation på.




En væsentlig opgave for teamet er at udvikle vores rapporter, så ledelsen får et enkelt, aktuelt og anvendeligt billede af produktion, fremdrift, resultater og relevante styringsparametre.




Sammen med dine kolleger skal du have styr på processen fra data og forretningsbehov til den færdige rapport eller det færdige dashboard. Det kræver, at du både kan gå i dybden med den tekniske BI-løsning og forstå den drift og forretning, som rapporteringen skal understøtte.




Som medarbejder vil dine primære opgaver være fokuseret på arbejdet med at:




omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete løsninger
udvikle, opbygge og optimere Power BI-rapporter og dashboards
udvikle standardiseret ledelsesrapportering
bearbejde, strukturere og analysere data fra forskellige datakilder
udvikle og optimere datamodeller samt arbejde med DAX og Power Query
analysere data og identificere tendenser, afvigelser og sammenhænge, der kan understøtte ledelsens beslutninger
kvalitetssikre data og rapportering og bidrage til ensartede definitioner og datagrundlag
bidrage til udviklingen af vores øvrige digitale værktøjer – gerne med erfaring inden for Power Apps og Power Automate.




Teknisk stærk BI-profil med analytisk blik

Vi søger dig, der har solid praktisk erfaring med Power BI og databearbejdning, og som har lyst til at bringe din specialistviden ind i et team, hvor I udvikler løsningerne sammen.




Du kan gå i dybden med data og tekniske problemstillinger, men samtidig løfte blikket og forstå, hvad data skal bruges til. For os handler god BI ikke alene om at præsentere tal. Rapporteringen skal gøre det lettere at forstå, hvad der sker i driften, hvorfor det sker, og hvor der kan være behov for opmærksomhed eller handling.




Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:




har solid erfaring med udvikling af rapporter og dashboards i Microsoft Power BI
har stærke kompetencer inden for DAX, Power Query, datamodellering og datavisualisering
kan arbejde selvstændigt med komplekse datasæt og omsætte dem til robuste og brugervenlige BI-løsninger
har en stærk analytisk forståelse og kan omsætte data til relevant ledelsesinformation
har erfaring med eller interesse for udvikling af ledelses dashboards og ledelsesrapportering
sparre med ledere og kolleger om, hvordan data bedst kan understøtte produktionsstyring og opfølgning
dele viden og sparre fagligt med de øvrige BI-medarbejdere, så vi sammen udvikler vores løsninger og kompetencer kan afdække forretningens behov og omsætte dem til konkrete BI-løsninger
har blik for datakvalitet, struktur og sammenhænge på tværs af data
kan formidle komplekse data og analyser enkelt og forståeligt
trives i et team, hvor vi lægger vægt på samarbejde, faglig sparring og videndeling
arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og proaktivt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver fra behov til færdig løsning.




Det vil være en fordel, hvis du desuden har erfaring med Power Apps og Power Automate og kan se muligheder for at kombinere BI, automatisering og digitale løsninger til at understøtte forretningen.




Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Det afgørende for os er din tekniske BI-faglighed, dine datakompetencer og din evne til at omsætte data og forretningsbehov til løsninger, der kan anvendes i den daglige styring og ledelse.




Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø

Som BI-specialist i Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring indgår du i et kontor med 18 engagerede og meget kompetente kolleger, hvor vi er fælles om at vedligeholde et stærkt fagligt miljø i en uformel og tillidsfuld atmosfære – med højt til loftet og godt humør.




Jobbet kræver engagement og indsats, og derfor tilbyder vi også rammerne for et godt arbejdsliv for dig som medarbejder, hvor der er god balance mellem arbejde og fritid, og hvor du har høj indflydelse på egne opgaver og udvikling.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansøgning med CV og eksamenspapirer bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 24. september 2026. 1. samtaler til stillingen afholdes løbende. Evt. 2. samtaler med personanalyse forventes afholdt den 9. oktober 2026.




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Maria Schneekloth på telefon 72 38 12 98.




Der vil forud for ansættelse blive indhentet referencer og straffeattest.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.




Din arbejdsplads vil blive en af vores 2 lokationer, Universitetsvej 2, 4000 Roskilde (Trekroner) eller Brovejen 15A, 4930 Maribo.




Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.




Om Vurderingsstyrelsen

’Vi sikrer, at boligejerne får en mere retvisende og gennemskuelig ejendomsvurdering’




Vurderingsstyrelsen varetager alle forhold om ejendomsvurdering og beskatning af ejendomme. Styrelsens opgave er at udarbejde mere retvisende og gennemskuelige offentlige vurderinger af grunde og ejendomme og sikre korrekt betaling af skatten på baggrund af disse. Fremtidens vurderinger bliver baseret på nye og detaljerede data. Det skal sikre, at borgere og virksomheder kan have tillid til, at de bliver beskattet på et korrekt grundlag. Vores værdier er ansvar, udsyn, faglighed og samarbejde.




Vi er en arbejdsplads med mange forskellige fagligheder. De er alle i spil i dagligdagen, hvor vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og en stærk samarbejdskultur, hvor alle trives, tager ansvar og bidrager til den fælles opgave. Vi har et godt kollegaskab med en uformel omgangstone og vi tror på, at en fornuftig balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv giver motiverede og tilfredse medarbejdere.




Vurderingsstyrelsen har ca. 1400 ansatte og er en arbejdsplads i vækst, og vi har derfor løbende brug for nye, engagerede kolleger.




Læs mere om Vurderingsstyrelsen på www.vurdst.dk.




Vurderingsstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Er du teknisk stærk i Power BI, skarp på data og god til at omsætte komplekse datamængder til overskuelige rapporter så er det måske dig, vi søger.


I Vurderingsstyrelsen står vi over for en stor opgave med vurderingen af landets erhvervs-, land- og skovejendomme. Det stiller krav til stærk og anvendelig ledelsesinformation, der gør os i stand til at følge produktionen, identificere udvikling og tendenser og understøtte ledelsens beslutninger.


I vores kontor, Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring, søger vi derfor en teknisk stærk BI-specialist til vores BI-team. Teamet består i dag af tre kolleger, der udvikler og vedligeholder vores Power BI-løsninger, og sammen skal I videreudvikle vores BI-område og ledelsesrapportering.


Som BI-specialist bliver du en del af et team, hvor I sammen har ansvar for at udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere vores rapportering i Power BI. Du kommer ind i et eksisterende fagligt miljø, hvor der allerede arbejdes med Power BI, men hvor vi ønsker at styrke vores tekniske BI-kompetencer og videreudvikle den måde, vi arbejder med data, rapportering og ledelsesinformation på.


En væsentlig opgave for teamet er at udvikle vores rapporter, så ledelsen får et enkelt, aktuelt og anvendeligt billede af produktion, fremdrift, resultater og relevante styringsparametre.


Sammen med dine kolleger skal du have styr på processen fra data og forretningsbehov til den færdige rapport eller det færdige dashboard. Det kræver, at du både kan gå i dybden med den tekniske BI-løsning og forstå den drift og forretning, som rapporteringen skal understøtte.


Som medarbejder vil dine primære opgaver være fokuseret på arbejdet med at:


  • omsætte forretningsbehov til konkrete løsninger
  • udvikle, opbygge og optimere Power BI-rapporter og dashboards
  • udvikle standardiseret ledelsesrapportering
  • bearbejde, strukturere og analysere data fra forskellige datakilder
  • udvikle og optimere datamodeller samt arbejde med DAX og Power Query
  • analysere data og identificere tendenser, afvigelser og sammenhænge, der kan understøtte ledelsens beslutninger
  • kvalitetssikre data og rapportering og bidrage til ensartede definitioner og datagrundlag
  • bidrage til udviklingen af vores øvrige digitale værktøjer – gerne med erfaring inden for Power Apps og Power Automate.


Teknisk stærk BI-profil med analytisk blik

Vi søger dig, der har solid praktisk erfaring med Power BI og databearbejdning, og som har lyst til at bringe din specialistviden ind i et team, hvor I udvikler løsningerne sammen.


Du kan gå i dybden med data og tekniske problemstillinger, men samtidig løfte blikket og forstå, hvad data skal bruges til. For os handler god BI ikke alene om at præsentere tal. Rapporteringen skal gøre det lettere at forstå, hvad der sker i driften, hvorfor det sker, og hvor der kan være behov for opmærksomhed eller handling.


Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:


  • har solid erfaring med udvikling af rapporter og dashboards i Microsoft Power BI
  • har stærke kompetencer inden for DAX, Power Query, datamodellering og datavisualisering
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt med komplekse datasæt og omsætte dem til robuste og brugervenlige BI-løsninger
  • har en stærk analytisk forståelse og kan omsætte data til relevant ledelsesinformation
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for udvikling af ledelses dashboards og ledelsesrapportering
  • sparre med ledere og kolleger om, hvordan data bedst kan understøtte produktionsstyring og opfølgning
  • dele viden og sparre fagligt med de øvrige BI-medarbejdere, så vi sammen udvikler vores løsninger og kompetencer kan afdække forretningens behov og omsætte dem til konkrete BI-løsninger
  • har blik for datakvalitet, struktur og sammenhænge på tværs af data
  • kan formidle komplekse data og analyser enkelt og forståeligt
  • trives i et team, hvor vi lægger vægt på samarbejde, faglig sparring og videndeling
  • arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og proaktivt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver fra behov til færdig løsning.


Det vil være en fordel, hvis du desuden har erfaring med Power Apps og Power Automate og kan se muligheder for at kombinere BI, automatisering og digitale løsninger til at understøtte forretningen.


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Det afgørende for os er din tekniske BI-faglighed, dine datakompetencer og din evne til at omsætte data og forretningsbehov til løsninger, der kan anvendes i den daglige styring og ledelse.


Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø

Som BI-specialist i Produktionsstyring og Faglig Afklaring indgår du i et kontor med 18 engagerede og meget kompetente kolleger, hvor vi er fælles om at vedligeholde et stærkt fagligt miljø i en uformel og tillidsfuld atmosfære – med højt til loftet og godt humør.


Jobbet kræver engagement og indsats, og derfor tilbyder vi også rammerne for et godt arbejdsliv for dig som medarbejder, hvor der er god balance mellem arbejde og fritid, og hvor du har høj indflydelse på egne opgaver og udvikling.


Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansøgning med CV og eksamenspapirer bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 24. september 2026. 1. samtaler til stillingen afholdes løbende. Evt. 2. samtaler med personanalyse forventes afholdt den 9. oktober 2026.


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Maria Schneekloth på telefon 72 38 12 98.


Der vil forud for ansættelse blive indhentet referencer og straffeattest.


Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.


Din arbejdsplads vil blive en af vores 2 lokationer, Universitetsvej 2, 4000 Roskilde (Trekroner) eller Brovejen 15A, 4930 Maribo.


Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.


Om Vurderingsstyrelsen

’Vi sikrer, at boligejerne får en mere retvisende og gennemskuelig ejendomsvurdering’


Vurderingsstyrelsen varetager alle forhold om ejendomsvurdering og beskatning af ejendomme. Styrelsens opgave er at udarbejde mere retvisende og gennemskuelige offentlige vurderinger af grunde og ejendomme og sikre korrekt betaling af skatten på baggrund af disse. Fremtidens vurderinger bliver baseret på nye og detaljerede data. Det skal sikre, at borgere og virksomheder kan have tillid til, at de bliver beskattet på et korrekt grundlag. Vores værdier er ansvar, udsyn, faglighed og samarbejde.


Vi er en arbejdsplads med mange forskellige fagligheder. De er alle i spil i dagligdagen, hvor vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og en stærk samarbejdskultur, hvor alle trives, tager ansvar og bidrager til den fælles opgave. Vi har et godt kollegaskab med en uformel omgangstone og vi tror på, at en fornuftig balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv giver motiverede og tilfredse medarbejdere.


Vurderingsstyrelsen har ca. 1400 ansatte og er en arbejdsplads i vækst, og vi har derfor løbende brug for nye, engagerede kolleger.


Læs mere om Vurderingsstyrelsen på www.vurdst.dk.


Vurderingsstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: Sales Data Analyst
Description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:


Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Be the first dedicated analyst behind n8n's go-to-market motion.

Our commercial motion has two engines running at once: a self-serve product that thousands of developers adopt on their own, and an enterprise sales team closing the accounts that grow out of it. We've moved to usage-based pricing, migrated to Salesforce, and built a serious data foundation. What we don't have yet is someone whose entire job is making sense of the sales side of it.

That's this role. You'll own the analytics behind pipeline, funnel conversion and GTM planning, and partner with RevOps on the forecast - sitting inside the data team, embedded with RevOps and Sales, and in the room when the plan gets made.

Your mission: make our sales org measurably better at forecasting, prioritising and convertingOwn pipeline analytics, support forecasting


Build the models and views that tell us where pipeline actually stands - coverage, stage conversion, velocity, slippage.
Support RevOps on forecasting: supply the analysis and accuracy tracking behind it, and be the person leadership trusts to explain the number when it's uncomfortable.
Run win/loss analysis that goes past "price" and "timing" to something we can act on.


Connect product-led growth to sales


We have thousands of self-serve users and a sales team that can only talk to a fraction of them. Your job is to work out which fraction.
Build account and lead scoring on product usage and firmographic signal, with RevOps and the product/customer analysts.
Sharpen PQL and MQL definitions until reps trust what lands in their queue.


Shape how we plan


Model territories, quota and capacity for annual planning - and make the trade-offs visible.
Segment the base: which accounts, which motions, which segments actually pay back the effort.
Answer the questions that decide where the next euro of GTM spend goes.


Build foundations people trust


Partner with Analytics Engineering on Salesforce and product data models in dbt/BigQuery.
Standardise metric definitions so "win rate" means one thing across sales, marketing and finance.
Ship dashboards GTM managers genuinely run their week on - not decks that get opened once.


Bring a point of view


Sit in pipeline reviews and planning as a peer, not a reporting function.
Push back constructively, including on the numbers people are attached to.
Turn analysis into crisp, written recommendations that move decisions.


Must-haves


Senior GTM analytics chops: 5+ years in sales, revenue or GTM analytics at B2B SaaS, with real ownership of the sales funnel.
Sales metrics fluency: pipeline coverage, stage conversion, velocity, win rate, ACV, quota attainment, ramp, ARR/NRR - you think in these natively.
CRM depth: experience with Salesforce (or equivalent) - its structure, its quirks, and the hygiene problems that quietly ruin analyses.
Forecasting experience: you've built or contributed to forecast models and know what makes them defensible - here you'll support RevOps on the build.
Technical toolkit: expert SQL; comfortable in a modern warehouse stack (BigQuery, dbt, Metabase/Hex or equivalent).
Planning experience: territory, quota or capacity modelling for a real sales org.
Business partner mindset: credible with sales leaders and reps, and able to tell a VP they're reading the data wrong.
Opinionated and high-agency: you spot what's worth analysing, you do it, and you arrive with a recommendation.
Communication that lands: memos and readouts that change what people do next.


Nice-to-haves


PLG experience, especially the self-serve to sales-assisted handoff.
Usage-based or credit-based pricing: you've analysed consumption revenue before.
Scoring and propensity models: lead or account scoring, statistical or ML-based.
Python for analysis: pandas, statsmodels, scikit-learn when SQL isn't enough.
Devtool, open-source or technical product experience.
Wider GTM stack: Gong, Clay, enrichment and intent data, marketing attribution.
dbt modelling: you can ship your own models rather than only file requests.


Why join us?

You'd be the first person here whose whole job is the sales data - which means you get to define the function rather than inherit someone else's version of it. The commercial problem is interesting: a product-led motion and an enterprise motion feeding each other, on usage-based pricing, in a category that's moving very fast.

The foundations are already there. A real data team maintains the stack (BigQuery, dbt, Dagster, Metabase, Salesforce), so you spend your time on analysis rather than firefighting pipelines. And you'll work directly with GTM leadership in a company that values autonomy, directness and impact over process.

Sound like a challenge you're ready to take on? Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits


Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.
Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:
Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
Health & wellness 🩺 –
Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*
US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
Future planning 💰 –
Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*
US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
Financial security 🛡️ –
Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*
US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
Country-specific details are provided in your contract.
