Kan du finde historien i data – og omsætte den til handling, der styrker kommerciel udvikling?

Vi søger en Commercial Insights Manager, der – via data - kan gøre os klogere på vores kunder og styrke grundlaget for vores kommercielle beslutninger. Du bliver en central del af et af OK's mest strategisk prioriterede områder, hvor kundevækst og fastholdelse står højt på agendaen.

Fra data til kommerciel handling

Som Commercial Insights Manager følger du udviklingen, identificerer mønstre og muligheder og sikrer, at vores indsigter bliver omsat til konkrete kommercielle initiativer.

Stillingen er nyoprettet, hvilket giver dig en unik mulighed for at sætte dit præg på rollen. Sammen med dine kolleger bliver du med til at definere rammerne for funktionen, udvikle arbejdsformer og sikre, at data skaber størst mulig værdi for forretningen.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med blandt andre Salg, Partnerskaber, BI, Product Management og Marketing og får en vigtig rolle i at skabe sammenhæng mellem data og forretning.

Dine opgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Analysere udviklingen i salg, churn, leadflow og konvertering og identificere muligheder for vækst og forbedringer
  • Evaluere effekten af kampagner, kanaler og kommercielle indsatser og omsætte resultaterne til konkrete anbefalinger
  • Understøtte arbejdet med vores churn prediction-model i tæt samarbejde med BI og omsætte modellens indsigter til handling
  • Udvikle rapportering og performancevisualisering samt understøtte budgettering, forecasting og performanceopfølgning
  • Deltagelse i kommercielle tværfaglige udviklingsprojekter
  • Sikre et stærkt datagrundlag for partneropfølgning og bidrage med analyser og effektmålinger til tværgående projekter

Herudover vil du også løbende løse ad hoc-opgaver, hvor du selv dykker ned i data, finder svar på konkrete forretningsspørgsmål. Det er en naturlig del af rollen, at du både arbejder strategisk og har hænderne nede i data, når behovet opstår.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har et par års erfaring fra en analytisk og kommerciel rolle i en større og kompleks organisation
  • Er stærk inden for dataforståelse, analyse, visualisering og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte
  • Forstår de mekanismer, der driver salg og fastholdelse - gerne fra en abonnementsforretning og med kendskab til fx CLV og CPA
  • Trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi og kan formidle komplekse sammenhænge klart og enkelt
  • Er nysgerrig på AI og nye teknologier og arbejder proaktivt med at skabe værdi gennem dem

Det vigtigste er ikke, at du kan sætte flueben ved alt. Vi leder efter dig, der kombinerer analytisk styrke med forretningsforståelse og har lyst til at bruge data til at gøre en mærkbar forskel. Du tager ansvar og er god til at skabe resultater i samarbejde med forskellige fagligheder

Vi tilbyder

  • En rolle med indflydelse, hvor dine analyser og anbefalinger bliver brugt til at træffe kommercielle beslutninger
  • Et spændende fagligt miljø, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med både forretningen, BI og andre specialister
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med god energi og en sund kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at lykkes
  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder og attraktive personalegoder, bl.a. sundheds- og tandforsikring, rabataftaler, en aktiv personaleforening og in-house massageordning
  • Fleksibilitet og moderne rammer i Viby, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge godt sammen

Vil du være med til at gøre data til handling?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anne Bay Schimmelmann, Director, Salg & Fastholdelse, på tlf.: 2132 9741.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Title: Group Business Controller & BI Analyst
Description:
Finance meets BI, automation and AI

Do you enjoy working with numbers and technology? Are you curious about how data, automation and AI can make Finance smarter and more effective?

LEMAN is looking for a Group Business Controller & BI Analyst who wants to combine hands-on business controlling with BI development and help shape the future of Finance.

This is a hybrid role with an approximately 50/50 focus on business controlling and BI. You'll work with budgets, forecasts and performance analysis while also building Power BI solutions, improving reporting processes and exploring new ways to use automation and AI.

In other words: you don't just analyse the numbers. You help improve how we work with them.

The role

You'll join our Finance organisation and report to the Head of Controlling. You'll work closely with colleaguesreit in Finance, IT and across the business, giving you a broad network and plenty of opportunity to influence how we use data and technology.

As part of the role, you'll be responsible for controlling activities related to LEMAN Logistics, covering our warehousing operations in Denmark, Norway, the UK and the US. You'll work closely with local logistics directors and lead the monthly performance follow-up.

You'll also support Group back-office functions such as People & Culture, IT and Commercial with financial analysis, reporting and decision support.

Your Main Responsibilities


Prepare and follow up on budgets, forecasts and financial performance
Analyse results, identify deviations and turn data into clear business insights
Lead monthly performance reviews with local logistics directors
Support Group functions with financial analysis and decision-making
Build and develop reports and dashboards in Power BI
Take ownership of the continued development of BI solutions within Finance
Identify opportunities to improve financial analysis, reporting and processes through automation and AI
Act as the link between Finance, IT and the wider business


Who are you?

You have a solid foundation in controlling or finance analytics, but you're also genuinely interested in data, technology and how things can be done better.

You don't need to be an IT specialist. What matters is that you understand Finance, enjoy working with data and are comfortable getting hands-on with technology.

We Imagine That You


Have a relevant degree, such as cand.merc., HD or equivalent
Have around 3–5 years of relevant experience in controlling, finance analytics or BI
Have practical experience with Power BI and SQL
Have an interest in automation, AI and new technology
Understand budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting
Can turn business needs into practical reporting and BI solutions
Communicate confidently with financial, technical and operational stakeholders
Are curious, proactive and comfortable building relationships across the organisation
Enjoy taking ownership and driving things forward
Speak and write Danish fluently and have strong English skills


You don't have to tick every box. If you have a strong Finance background and a real interest in BI, technology and improving the way things work, we'd like to hear from you.

A role with room to make a difference

This isn't a role where you simply maintain existing reports and follow established processes.

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Finance works with data, BI, automation and AI and to see your ideas turn into solutions that are used across the organisation.

You'll be part of an experienced Finance team where you can exchange ideas, learn from colleagues and challenge existing ways of working. At the same time, your role will be highly visible across the organisation, giving you the opportunity to build a broad network and make a real impact.

Why LEMAN?

LEMAN is a global logistics company with an ambition to continuously improve how we use data and technology to make better business decisions.

We believe that good work should leave room for life outside work. That's why we offer:


Flexible working from home by agreement
11% employer-paid pension contribution + 2% employee contribution
Company-paid internet and mobile phone
Canteen and lunch scheme
Insurance coverage
Employee association with regular social activities
Fitness facilities and massage treatment
The opportunity to take 1–2 months of fully paid sabbatical leave
Enjoy a benefits package designed with you in mind: 25 days of annual leave, five additional paid leave days, bank holidays, comprehensive medical coverage, pension and delicious meals. We can’t wait to tell you more in person!
Flexibility: We understand that life is unpredictable, which is why we offer flexible working arrangements, where possible, to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance. You'll have the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits you best – whether that means working from home, adjusting your hours, or taking time off when you need it.
Sabbatical: Need a break from the daily grind? We offer sabbatical opportunities to take extended time off to recharge, explore your passions, and come back to work feeling refreshed and inspired.
Investment in Professional Development: We're committed to helping our people grow and reach their full potential.
Global Travel Opportunities: We're a global organisation with offices around the world, which means that there are plenty of opportunities to travel and experience new cultures.
Social and Company Events: We believe that work should be enjoyable, which is why we organise regular social and company events to bring our people together.


About Us

LEMAN is a global company with deep roots and a modern, people-centric approach. We believe in empowering our colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and inspired to perform at their best.

Every day, we provide customised logistics and transport solutions that make a difference for companies and people around the world. We’re large enough to deliver top-quality global supply chain solutions yet small enough to offer truly personal experience – for both our customers and each other.

Title: Assortment Analyst, IMEA
Description:
Are you passionate about retail, consumer behavior, and using data to drive commercial decisions? Do you thrive in a fast-paced international environment where creativity meets business performance?




Then you might be the Assortment Analyst we're looking for to help grow Flying Tiger Copenhagen across the IMEA (India, Middle East and Africa) region.




About the Role

Based at our HQ office in Central Copenhagen (Christianshavn), you will play a key role in optimizing the product assortment for our growing IMEA region.

Working closely with Commercial, Retail teams and franchise partners, you will use data and market insights to ensure our assortment reflects local customer needs while staying true to the Flying Tiger Copenhagen concept.

Your analysis and recommendations will directly support commercial performance, new store openings, and profitable growth across the region.




What you will do:




Drive assortment performance

Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve assortment relevance, sales, and profitability.
Analyze sales trends, customer behavior, and market insights to support assortment decisions.
Contribute to assortment reviews and recommend commercial actions based on data.




Support commercial planning

Support the planning of seasonal launches, campaigns, and commercial calendars.
Analyze product commitments and inventory plans to maximize commercial performance.
Partner with Demand Planning and Supply Chain to optimize product availability and inventory health.




Support business growth

Develop assortment and space recommendations for new store openings and existing stores.
Collaborate with stores and commercial teams to identify assortment gaps and growth opportunities.
Support continuous improvement of commercial processes and best practices.




Deliver insights

Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business reporting.
Present recommendations to regional leadership and global stakeholders.
Conduct ad hoc analyses supporting strategic initiatives and business development.




Who you are

You have a bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field (master’s degree is a plus).
2-4 years of experience in retail planning, merchandising, category management, commercial planning, business analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Strong commercial mindset and passion for retail and customer behavior.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to transform data into actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with BI and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is an advantage.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across functions and cultures.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Curious, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic, growing organization.




What We Offer

At Flying Tiger Copenhagen, we believe life is richer with fun. You'll join an international retail company where creativity, entrepreneurship, and collaboration are part of everyday life.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence commercial decisions across a growing region, work closely with colleagues in Miami, Copenhagen, and Singapore, and help shape the future of Flying Tiger Copenhagen in IMEA.

You will report to the Head of Commercial, IMEA and become part of a regional team of eight entrepreneurial colleagues with close collaboration across our global organization.




Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:




Probably the best location - in the heart of Copenhagen
Attractive pension plan
Private health insurance - also including children
Flexibility with the opportunity of working from home
Special discounts in our own Flying Tiger Shops
Fun and dynamic culture
A social and informal workplace with parties, Friday bars, staff club etc.
International work environment founded in Scandinavian culture
Delicious restaurant food in our own canteen everyday – including cake on Thursdays
Celebration and many other occasions to eat Cake
And much more…




Did you know?

We take climate change very seriously and work very hard to minimize our carbon footprint. We do this by buying less plastic and more renewable materials (everything which grows) – and we also want to make sure that all stores are run on renewable energy. We walk the talk – and make sure that what we do is validated by external experts, in the Science Based Targets initiative. You can read more about our work with climate action here.

Title: Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Annalect, we help businesses across industries make better decisions — from marketing strategies to business development and sales forecasting. Our approach combines deep industry understanding with advanced, AI-powered analytical methods, enabling us to deliver insights and recommendations that make a real difference for our clients. In Denmark, we are more than 70 specialists based in Copenhagen and Aarhus. As part of Omnicom Media Group, we have over 300 colleagues in Denmark and a global network of more than 5,000 experts with whom we collaborate to create the best possible solutions for our clients.




Consultant for Data Science Consultancy Team

Are you passionate about applying Data Science in real-world scenarios? Do you want to leverage mathematics, statistics, and programming to help our clients make better decisions? Are you driven by data and analysis, and eager to translate insights into actionable recommendations? Join Annalect’s Data Science Consultancy team!




About the Role

We are looking for a new colleague to join Annalect, Omnicom Media Group’s specialist unit for data-driven analytics and decision support systems. Our work includes analyses that quantify the impact of our clients’ marketing activities and provide the foundation for ongoing optimization. Annalect consists of 60 employees, with 20 dedicated to the Data Science Consultancy team. Our team utilizes mathematics, statistics, and econometrics to process large volumes of data, delivering business-oriented decision support. As a Data Science Consultant, you will be involved in the entire project lifecycle for our clients – from data collection and coding, to building and optimizing statistical models in R, and communicating results and recommendations to clients. You will work closely with a project lead and the team, receiving ongoing support and feedback. As you gain experience, you will have the opportunity to conduct analyses independently, manage client communications, and deliver your own projects.




Key Responsibilities:

Collect client data and extract data from media systems
Programming and data processing
Structure, code, and interpret data
Develop statistical models in R
Analyze results and prepare recommendations in close collaboration with a project lead
Prepare deliverables for clients in PowerPoint and dashboards
Maintain ongoing dialogue with clients and media agencies throughout the project
Lead your own projects




Your Profile

We imagine that you:

Hold a relevant academic degree (e.g., Cand.Merc. (MAT), Cand.polit. IMM, AEF, or similar)
Have basic experience with statistical models and methodologies
Possess strong analytical skills
Are proficient in R Studio (or other programming languages such as Python, SAS, VBA, SQL and are eager to further develop your skills in R Studio)
Are experienced in Excel and PowerPoint
Are interested in building an understanding of marketing, digital platforms, and the media landscape




What We Offer

We offer a position in an exciting company with many opportunities. You will be part of a strong professional community and work alongside some of the industry’s most talented specialists. We also have a vibrant social environment, including Friday bars, annual parties, company football team, DHL race, and more. Our culture is relaxed, with room for fun and focus for deep work on projects.




Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions about the position or the company, please contact Analytics Director Anders Mousten at anders.mousten@omc.com.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.


Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Title: Associate Manager, Insights & Analytics
Description:
Job Description

Just imagine turning audience signals into smarter LEGO® brand stories and clearer reputational decisions. Then make it real.

Are you the person who always asks “so what” and “why”? We’re looking for a curious, analytical individual who loves joining the dots to turn information into action to power the next chapter of corporate storytelling at the LEGO Group.

About The Role

As our Content Insights and Analytics Associate Manager, you'll lead corporate digital channel performance and content analysis for the LEGO Group. You'll connect monitoring data through useful dashboards and translate complex information into actionable communications insight. Using social listening, audience intelligence and emerging artificial intelligence signals, you'll improve planning, content development and reputational decision-making in this permanent role.

Required Qualifications



Delivered content, social or audience performance analysis that informed communications or channel decisions.
Applied social listening and audience intelligence to identify trends, opportunities and reputational insights.
Built reporting dashboards that turned complex data from multiple sources into clear recommendations.
Used analytics and monitoring platforms such as Sprinklr, Brandwatch, Hootsuite, Adobe Analytics, Semrush or similar tools.
Influenced content, channel or communications decisions through evidence-based insights and recommendations.


Preferred Qualifications



Explored artificial intelligence-powered communications tools, prompts, copilots, workflows or agents.
Analysed search and digital discovery behaviours to understand how audiences find information.


What You'll Build



Develop dashboards and reporting formats that bring fragmented monitoring data together.
Track digital channel and content performance against clear objectives.
Turn reporting from a record of activity into a source of learning and action.
Bring social listening and external audience signals into communications planning.
Monitor how artificial intelligence-powered systems represent the LEGO Group.
Create a consistent rhythm of recommendations that improve content and reputational decisions.


If you've worked in a role where you turned complex content, social or audience data into focused recommendations, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your curiosity, analytical thinking and ability to communicate insight clearly.

Life on the team

You'll join the Corporate Content & Channels team within Corporate Brand and Communications. We're shifting from traditional broadcasting towards communications shaped by audiences and evidence. The team values thoughtful experimentation, sound judgement and continuous learning. Your collaboration, relationship-building and storytelling instinct will help colleagues connect planning, performance and audience intelligence.

What Success Looks Like

You'll establish reporting that stakeholders can confidently use while finding the meaningful signals behind the numbers. Over the next 12 to 18 months, you'll strengthen measurement, expand audience intelligence and explore changing discovery behaviours. You'll work closely with content, social media and communications planning colleagues to support stories that build understanding, connection and trust.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

Title: Danmarks Statistik søger dygtige kollegaer med interesse for prisstatistik
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at udarbejde prisindeksstatistik, som belyser centrale dele af den danske økonomi? Trives du i et miljø med ansvar, faglighed og fleksibilitet, hvor du selv får mulighed for at påvirke og udvikle dit arbejdsområde? Så har Danmarks Statistik et spændende job til dig.

I kontoret Priser og Forbrug søger vi dygtige kollegaer, der skal være med til at udvikle og producere statistikker, der skal afspejle prisudviklingen på en række centrale områder. Du vil blive en del af et team af engagerede kollegaer, som står klar med hjælp og sparring, men du har samtidig dine egne ansvarsområder, hvor du kan være med til at sætte en retning.

Jobindhold

Du kommer til at indgå i den daglige drift af statistikkerne samt arbejde med flere større omlægningsprojekter. Det kan f.eks. være omlægning af de statistiske produktionssystemer til ny teknologi eller mere fagligt orienterede omlægninger, eksempelvis opdatering af klassifikationer. I din hverdag vil du derfor få mulighed for at bruge både din makroøkonomiske viden om de statistiske produkter samt dine analytiske evner og it-kompetencer i forbindelse med udviklings- og omlægningsopgaver. Du vil indgå i et team præget af højt fagligt engagement og stærkt samarbejde, og du vil samtidig få en bred kontaktflade både internt i Danmarks Statistik og eksternt til vores samarbejdspartnere.

Du vil indgå i et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og respekt for forskellige perspektiver. Du vil arbejde med spændende og samfundsrelevante opgaver, hvor du hurtigt vil opleve, at du gør en forskel. Du vil få gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på arbejdet.

Det forventes at du selv kan drive omlægningerne, samtidig med at du forstår at indgå konstruktivt i de relevante samarbejder.

Kvalifikationer

Vi søger personer med en akademisk uddannelse som fx cand.polit., cand.oecon., cand.merc. eller lignende. Derudover:


Har evner og lyst til at arbejde med tal og store datamængder
Er kvalitetsbevidst, struktureret og har gode kommunikationsevner, både skriftligt og mundtligt
Trives med både udviklingsopgaver og det mere driftsorienterede rugbrødsarbejde, der er med til at sikre høj kvalitet i statistikken
Selvstændigt kan drive en omlægningsproces, samtidig med at indgå konstruktivt i de relevante samarbejder
Kender dine styrker og ved hvornår du skal spørge om hjælp


It-kompetencer er en vigtig del af jobbet. Har du erfaring med Python, R eller SAS, er det en fordel.

Løn og ansættelse

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter kvalifikationer i henhold til den relevante overenskomst. Der kan evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg til stillingen.

Ansættelsen finder som udgangspunkt sted som fuldmægtig efter den gældende overenskomst for akademikere indgået mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer. Ansættelsen vil være på fuld tid og med ansættelse snarest muligt.

Kort om Danmarks Statistik

Danmarks Statistik er en fagligt uafhængig institution og den nationale myndighed for officiel statistik i Danmark. Vi indsamler, bearbejder og offentliggør statistik og data om samfundsforhold. Danmarks Statistik har cirka 600 ansatte og er en spændende arbejdsplads med gode udviklingsmuligheder.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.




We are seeking a passionate Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in being the trusted partner to business stakeholders to enable data-driven decision-making across Drug Development Domain. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborating with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the Drug Development Data Domain (4D) team consisting of 3 colleagues, and report directly to People Leader in Global IT, Babak Bajelan and Global Head of Digitalization, Ivanna Rosendal who are based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Understand business needs and translate them into data solutions
Design & develop data products that drive business value and decisions
Explore and transform complex data into insights with fit-for-purpose analytics
Collaborate across teams to build end-to-end solutions
Ensure data products align with data governance, compliance, and quality standards

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a Master's Degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science or related field - and 5+years of experience within Data & Analytics.




Furthermore, you have:

Proven experience in gathering and transforming business requirements into data products
3+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps, Databricks, dbt, Python and T-SQL
Experience in designing & delivering solutions using Power BI or similar BI platforms
Understanding of data governance, data quality, and compliance
Ability to understand business data & processes and create rapid prototypes




Pharma domain knowledge is a plus.




Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.




To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be

proactive, collaborative and results oriented
driving initiatives from idea to adoption
curious and open minded




Travel: 10-20 days per year.




Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Title: Performance & Reporting Coordinator/Manager
Description:
As Eurowind Energy grows into the next generation's "Power Major," operational performance visibility becomes a strategic asset. Today, our performance reporting is built market by market. We are bringing it together into one standard, and this role is a vital part to get there. We need someone who can centralize it, standardize it, and transform it through digitalization and AI. If you thrive on building trusted systems that cut through complexity and connect people across a matrix, this is your role.




Who We Are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!




We are looking for an experienced Performance & Reporting Coordinator/Manager to join our Global Operations organization. The position can be based either at our head office in Hobro, Denmark, or at our office in Hamburg, Germany. You will report directly to our Global Operations Director and work closely with the Operations leadership team across countries.Together you will establish a single, trusted approach to operational performance reporting across markets, technologies, and functions globally.




Your Role

As Performance & Reporting Coordinator/Manager, you will sit at the center of operational intelligence, coordinating standardized performance data flows across Technical, Commercial Management, HSE and OT, together with Finance, IT and Business Intelligence. This is not an ownership role — you won’t own operational or commercial performance, define KPIs or financial settlement. You will own the consistency, quality and evolution of how performance is reported. You’ll be the central coordinator ensuring agreed definitions are applied consistently, data is validated and trusted, and reporting becomes increasingly automated and AI-enabled. The framework — KPI definitions, reporting standards and governance — is owned by the Global Operations Lead. You own how it is delivered: the data model, quality, automation and reliability.




This is a staff function reporting directly to the Global Operations Director. You’ll work independently while collaborating across many teams, with a high-impact role in a growing, maturing global organization. As a new role, you’ll also have the opportunity to help shape the role and set the future standard for performance reporting.




Main Responsibilities

Performance Reporting & Data

Coordinate the delivery of standardized operational KPI reporting across markets and technologies
Ensure consistent definitions, data structures and reporting processes are applied globally
Coordinate, in corporation with our Technical and Commercial Management teams, validation of production data and ensure accurate, timely delivery to Finance for settlement
Coordinate validation of technical performance data with Technical Department, so availability and production rest on the same definitions in every market
Maintain and continuously improve the operational reporting model, within the reporting framework owned by Global Operations Lead
Support data quality and data governance across relevant systems and data sources




Digitalization, Automation & AI

Identify opportunities to automate and simplify reporting processes, significantly reducing manual work
Coordinate the implementation of digital reporting solutions in collaboration with IT, Finance and Business Intelligence
Identify and facilitate relevant AI use cases within reporting, data validation, anomaly detection and performance insights
Continuously assess how new digital and AI capabilities can improve the quality, speed and efficiency of reporting




Performance Follow-up & Coordination

Surface performance gaps and ask the accountable owner for an explanation. Where it is not resolved, escalate it to the quarterly Global Operations Review
Coordinate reporting inputs and timelines across Technical, Commercial, HSE, OT, Finance and the countries
Act as the central point of coordination for internal and external requests related to operational performance data
Support management reporting and the quarterly Global Operations Review with reliable, consistent data. The agenda for that review is owned by the Global Operations Lead




What We Offer

You'll join Global Operations at a pivotal moment. The team is growing, evolving toward greater globalization, standardization and digital capability.

This role offers you:

Make an impact — Your work directly influences the performance visibility of real renewable-energy assets across our global business, enabling better decision-making at every level
Build the future — Shape how Operations operate through digitalization, AI, automation, and standardization — not just maintain today's processes
Think globally, act locally — Work across countries, technologies and cultures while creating tangible local impact
Own your work — Take responsibility, make decisions and drive change. You'll have direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how we report, automate and raise data quality
Learn and grow — Work across technical, commercial, digital and operational disciplines with genuine opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the function grows




Renewable energy is our future. And so are our people!

At Eurowind Energy we do our best to create a culture where everyone is valued and feels at home. You will notice this in your everyday work life, where you have the freedom to speak up and where your voice means something to us. We know that when you grow, we grow. Therefore, we strive to support you in what you believe is right and in your personal and professional development. We offer you an exciting job in an energetic and international environment. And we promise you: the wind is never standing still.




Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.




We manage our own portfolio of projects and at the same time, we perform technical and financial management of projects. We have throughout many years experienced sustained economic growth in the number of developed projects and companies in management. And we continue to expect this. Simply because it is in our nature to keep developing – projects, companies and our people.




Read more about Eurowind Energy A/S on our website or LinkedIn.




Your Profile

Professional Background

Minimum 3 years' experience in operations reporting, data coordination, business intelligence, or management reporting
Experience working with AI, automation and digital solutions is essential, not optional
Experience or knowledge with ERP systems, BI platforms, or data tools (Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar). You will work on the group’s existing BI platform together with Business Intelligence, rather than building a reporting stack alongside it
Ability and willingness to develop technical knowledge and translate technical insights into standardized performance reporting.
Background in a global, matrix-based organization is an advantage
Fluent in English; other languages an asset




Personal Qualities

We need someone who is:

Solution-oriented and pragmatic — You identify problems and collaborate across teams to solve them, rather than waiting for perfect information
Outgoing and collaborative — You thrive in a matrix, building trust and finding common ground across Technical, Commercial Management, Finance, IT and the countries
Detail-focused yet strategic — You care deeply about data quality and consistency, but also see the bigger picture of how reporting enables better decisions
Comfortable with ambiguity and change — You're navigating a growth phase; you're energized by building systems and processes that didn't exist before, not just perfecting existing ones
Self-driven and proactive — You take initiative, own your outcomes, and don't wait to be told what to do next




Did we capture your attention?

Great! If you see yourself in this role, do not hesitate to apply for the position. Please use the link below. As we continuously review incoming applications, please send us your CV as soon as possible.




Should you have any questions before applying, please feel free to contact Michael Pedersen, Global Operations Director, at mipe@ewe.dk.

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Company: DEDIKATION - Hire for attitude, train for skills!

Description:
VIL DU KOMBINERE CONTROLLING, ANALYSE OG FORRETNING I EN INTERNATIONAL VIRKSOMHED?




Er du skarp på tal, data og systemer og motiveres du af en bred økonomi rolle med ansvar og tæt kontakt til forretningen?

ZF Danmark søger en Business Analyst, der kan skabe overblik, tage ejerskab og blive en central del af den lokale finansfunktion i Taastrup.




Du bliver bindeleddet mellem regnskab, data og den operationelle forretning og får en bred kontaktflade både i Danmark og internationalt.




OM VIRKSOMHEDEN

ZF Danmark ApS er en del af den globale ZF-koncern, som arbejder med drivlinje-, sikkerheds- og chassisteknologi.




Den danske organisation består af ca. 30-33 medarbejdere med hovedkontor i Taastrup og en mindre afdeling i Aalborg. Her kombineres en uformel dansk kultur med strukturen og mulighederne i en stor international koncern.

Medarbejderancienniteten er høj, og kulturen er præget af korte beslutningsveje, tæt samarbejde og høj grad af selvstændighed.




DINE OPGAVER / DIN ROLLE

Som Business Analyst bliver du en vigtig del af den lokale finansfunktion og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med Finance Directoren.




Du får blandt andet ansvar for at:

Analysere regnskabsdata og bidrage til månedsrapportering
Udarbejde materiale til ledelses- og koncernrapportering
Supportere salgsorganisationen med økonomiske og datamæssige problemstillinger
Samarbejde med Shared Service Center i Polen
Foretage og understøtte kreditvurderinger
Udvikle og vedligeholde BI-rapporter og KPI'er
Håndtere myndigheds-, miljø- og statistikrapportering
Levere materiale til ekstern revision
Håndtere relevante ad hoc økonomi- og bogføringsopgaver
Bidrage til optimering af processer, systemer og arbejdsgange




Rollen er bred og giver dig mulighed for gradvist at tage større ansvar i økonomifunktionen.




OM DIG / DIN PROFIL

Du har nogle års praktisk erfaring inden for økonomi, regnskab, controlling eller analyse og er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt med data og rapportering.




Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har erfaring med ERP-systemer – gerne Microsoft Navision/Dynamics NAV
Er stærk i Excel og har god system- og dataforståelse
Har erfaring med månedsrapportering og regnskabsanalyse
Behersker dansk på højt niveau og engelsk mundtligt og skriftligt
Arbejder struktureret og tager naturligt ejerskab
Har drive, initiativ og er god til at skabe overblik
Er serviceminded og samarbejdsorienteret




Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Power BI, SAP, kreditvurdering, myndighedsrapportering, ESG-data eller procesoptimering.




Brancheerfaring er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du trives i en bred økonomirolle og motiveres af ansvar og tæt kontakt til forretningen.




ZF TILBYDER

Hos ZF Danmark får du:

En central og bred rolle i den danske finansfunktion
Tæt samarbejde med den lokale ledelse
International kontakt gennem ZF-koncernen
Stor selvstændighed og mulighed for udvikling
Et stabilt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø
Privat sundhedsforsikring




INTERESSERET?

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med arbejdssted på Taastrupgårdsvej 8-10, 2630 Taastrup, og opstart ønskes hurtigst muligt.




ER DU KLAR TIL NÆSTE SKRIDT?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Eliza Kloster på tlf. 71 74 74 78. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match.




DEDIKATION – ”Hire for attitude, train for skills!”

Title: S&OP Specialist
Place: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you a data-driven professional with a passion for Supply Chain, driving local reviews, optimizing processes, and developing data insights? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!




About the job

Join our Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) team at Orifarm as a Specialist for Local Reviews & Data Analysis and play a key role in shaping the operational direction in Orifarm. This position involves collaborating closely with various teams to support and elevate our S&OP processes, ensuring alignment and operational growth across multiple areas.




We are looking for an S&OP Specialist with a strategic supply chain mindset and strong analytical skills who values and understands the importance of stakeholder management. As an S&OP Specialist, you will prepare, facilitate, and drive several monthly reviews while engaging with our local sales markets and operational supply teams. Additionally, you will analyze, identify, implement, and streamline data improvement opportunities to ensure efficiency and effectiveness across our Orifarm Strategic Business Areas.




Your key responsibilities will be to:

Prepare, facilitate, and drive monthly S&OP reviews, ensuring structured dialogue, strong stakeholder involvement, and effective follow-up
Coordinate with various stakeholders to gather relevant data, analyze trends, and present insights
Develop and increase the level of content and interaction during local S&OP Reviews
Support S&OP and local teams in understanding demand and supply priorities and translating them into actionable plans
Utilize strong analytical skills to drive process improvements and strategic insights
Analyze data from various sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to management
Drive the implementation and maintenance of various Power BI reports and dashboards, focusing on optimizing workflows and ensuring trusted data-driven decision-making at all levels




Who are you?

To succeed in this role, you should bring hands-on experience with S&OP processes, including the preparation and facilitation of cross-functional reviews. You are able to translate data and insights into actionable business impact and use your communication skills to support transparent and informed decision-making across functions.




We imagine that you have a solid understanding of supply chain management, S&OP, data analysis, and process optimization. Experience with demand planning is an advantage, but most importantly, you are analytically strong, structured, and motivated by improving processes and creating clear insights.




You have excellent stakeholder management, engagement, and communication skills. Furthermore, you have a degree in Supply Chain Operations, Management or Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Business, or a related field.




Who are we?

You will be part of our S&OP team reporting to the Head of S&OP & Analytics. The team consists of 6 colleagues all based in Odense, Denmark. Our team plays a key role in balancing Supply & Demand by acting as trusted advisors and process optimization identifiers. The S&OP team is also responsible for front-end data development, maintenance, and transparency, assisting the Orifarm business in creating various data insights and analysis by implementing Power BI reports and dashboards, focusing on optimizing workflows and ensuring trusted data-driven decision-making at all levels.




As a team, we foster a collaborative and informal work culture, where open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are at the heart of what we do.




Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.




We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.




When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.




We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.




We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.


We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Title: Sales Analyst - Nordics & Benelux
Description:
📍ZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyze change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.

📍 Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5,000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.

About Zuru Edge 🚀

ZURU Edge is the FMCG arm of ZURU Group - a founder-led, vertically integrated business that designs, manufactures and sells its own consumer brands. We do not acquire heritage brands and manage their decline; we build new ones and put them into retail at a speed most consumer goods companies cannot match. Rascals, Millie Moon, Monday Haircare, Daise, Gumi Yum Surprise and Bonkers all compete in categories where execution and pace decide the winner.

📊 Your Role

This is a commercial role with an analytical core. You will start as the person who understands the numbers behind the business - sell-in, sell-out, distribution, promotional performance, forecast - and you will move steadily towards owning customer relationships and the revenue that comes with them.

This is deliberately not a back-office analyst role. If you want to build a career in data or finance, this is the wrong job. If you want to be a Key Account Manager and understand that the best ones are the ones who know their numbers cold, this is a good place to start.

You will work in close and cross-functional collaboration with our global teams.

In this role, you will directly report to the Head of Sales Benelux and Nordics.

📌 Core Roles And Responsibilities


Territory analytics & insight (≈50%)
Own weekly and monthly sell-in and sell-out reporting for the territory — by market, customer, brand and SKU — and be able to explain why every meaningful movement happened.
Track retail sell-through, distribution (stores ranged, TDPs), in-stock rates and units-per-store velocity across retail and distributor partners; flag stock and availability risks before they turn into lost sales or returns.
Build and maintain the promotional calendar, and run post-promotion evaluations: what the uplift was, what it cost, and whether we would do it again.
Support the monthly demand forecast and the regional P&L review — variance to budget, forecast accuracy, and the mix and margin drivers behind the result.
Turn analysis into customer-ready material: category stories, range review arguments, and the fact base behind a listing proposal.
Commercial execution & account ownership (≈30%)
Own a defined set of smaller retail accounts and distributor partners — order flow, range, pricing within agreed guardrails, promotional plan and quarterly business reviews. This starts in your first year, not at the end of it.
Support the sales team on the region's largest customers: prepare the negotiation fact base, build the range and promotional proposal, join the meetings, and follow up on what was agreed.
Prepare for and take part in customer meetings, category and range reviews, and joint business planning.
Drive new listings and distribution gains — in under-developed markets, in growing channels, and for brands not yet ranged with an existing customer.
Work with Brand and Marketing on launch plans, in-store activation and sampling, and make sure product is on shelf when the campaign goes live.
Sales operations & coordination (≈20%)
Own customer masterdata, pricing and article set-up for the territory.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and Customer Service on the order book, allocations, delivery windows and open orders.
Manage new line forms, retailer portals and listing documentation across Benelux and Nordics.
Track trade spend and rebates for the territory together with Finance.


💡 Skills & Experience Required


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
1-2 years experience as a sales or category analyst ideally within FMCG.
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced: PivotTables, XLOOKUP, modelling) and ability to build clean, insight-led slides in PowerPoint. Experience in Power BI is a plus.
Attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data streams and deadlines simultaneously.
Confident communicator who can distil complex data into clear, concise insights for non-analytical audiences.
Structured and analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to travel within Europe as needed.


⭐ What We Offer


Competitive salary.
Regions with room to grow. You will not be maintaining someone else's account base. There is measurable whitespace across eight markets and help closing it will be visibly your work.
Unusual breadth, early. Direct exposure to senior commercial leadership, and visibility across analytics, negotiation, brand and supply chain in one role.
Brands people notice. A portfolio in fast-moving categories, launched and scaled at a pace few FMCG businesses can match


LIFE@ZURU

At ZURU, we have cultivated a high-performing culture that encourages excellence. Our team works towards ambitious goals, learning, performing, and improving together, all while having fun. We empower talented individuals to do their best work every day.

At ZURU, you get out what you put in. You are responsible for driving your own career and we provide the platform to achieve it. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, there are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else.

We recognise that ZURU’s success stems from our people and you can only be at your best when you are looking after yourself. ZURU encourages all our team members to invest in their wellbeing by providing an array of benefits and tools.

🌱 Culture for Growth – a high-performance environment with opportunities to stretch and succeed

🌎 Global Opportunities – work with colleagues and partners across Europe, Asia and the US

💡 A-Player Team – collaborate with some of the best talent in the industry

⚡ ZURU – Tomorrow Reimagined

Title: Retail Performance Manager
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
ARE YOU PASSIONATE ABOUT TURNING DATA INTO ACTION AND DRIVING COMMERCIAL SUCCESS ACROSS AN INTERNATIONAL RETAIL BUSINESS? JOIN GANNI AND HELP SHAPE THE PERFORMANCE OF OUR GLOBAL RETAIL NETWORK.

Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

As Retail Performance Manager, you will play a key role in driving commercial performance and supporting the continued development of GANNI's global retail network. Working closely with Retail, Finance, Merchandising, Client Development, Retail Operations, and other key stakeholders, you will combine commercial analysis with cross-functional project management to support business growth.

You will monitor retail performance across the store network, identify opportunities to improve commercial results, and translate business insights into actionable initiatives. In addition, you will support retail expansion projects, including new store openings, relocations, franchise developments, and commercial business cases, ensuring projects are delivered in alignment with business priorities.

This is a highly collaborative role that combines analytical thinking, commercial understanding, and strong project management skills.

Responsibilities ahead of you:

Retail Performance & Business Analysis


Monitor and analyse retail performance across the global store network, identifying opportunities, risks, and commercial trends.
Track key performance indicators including sales, traffic, conversion, average transaction value, units per transaction, productivity, profitability, and client metrics.
Develop performance reporting, dashboards, business reviews, and presentations to support commercial decision-making.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and target-setting processes together with Retail and Finance.
Translate business insights into actionable recommendations that improve store performance.


Commercial Performance


Partner with Retail leadership to develop and follow up on commercial action plans.
Support stores and regional teams in improving sales performance, productivity, and operational efficiency.
Identify best practices and help implement initiatives that strengthen commercial performance across the retail network.
Work closely with Merchandising, Finance, Client Development, and Retail Operations to align commercial priorities.


Retail Expansion & Business Projects


Support retail expansion initiatives, including new store openings, relocations, outlet developments, and franchise projects.
Coordinate project timelines, stakeholders, and operational readiness across multiple functions.
Build business cases and commercial analyses to support investment decisions.
Support lease negotiations, CAPEX planning, and commercial presentations where relevant.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Partner closely with Retail, Finance, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Visual Merchandising, Client Development, and other HQ functions.
Present business insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Contribute to strategic retail projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.


Must Have Requirements


4-6 years of experience within retail performance, commercial planning, retail operations, business analysis, or a similar commercial role.
Experience working within an international, multi-store retail environment.
Experience from the fashion, lifestyle, premium, or luxury industry is an advantage.
Strong commercial mindset with excellent analytical and financial understanding.
Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.
Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with business intelligence and reporting tools.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Fluent in English.


THE GANNI WAY

You are someone who is commercially curious, analytical, and proactive. You enjoy solving business challenges, collaborating across functions, and turning insights into actions that create measurable impact. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are motivated by continuously improving both business performance and ways of working.

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing Retail team!

WHAT ELSE?

You will be based at our Copenhagen HQ and will work closely with teams across Retail, Finance, Merchandising, Client Development, Retail Operations, and Visual Merchandising. Occasional travel may be required to support retail projects.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

MORE GANNI GOODIES

You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

Title: Nordic Data & Analytics Manager
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
A Day In The Role

Reporting directly to the Head of Data, you will act as a strategic business partner, playing a pivotal role in accelerating L’Oréal's ongoing business transformation across the Nordics Hub (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland). You won't just build technical solutions; you will translate complex data into compelling business narratives, guiding commercial decisions and shape our strategy.

Strategic Insight & Value Creation: Translate ambiguous business challenges into high-impact data solutions and front-end dashboards (PowerBI) that directly drive commercial growth and operational efficiency.

Business Transformation & Technical Execution: Leverage SQL and Python to build robust pipelines and automations, bridging the gap between technical back-end capabilities and commercial business needs.

Stakeholder Influence & Change Management: Partner closely with cross-functional leaders (Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Finance) to manage data initiatives, champion data-driven decision-making, and drive change across the organization.

We Are Looking For


An educational background in a technical or analytical field such as Mathematics, Economics, or Engineering.
Fluency in English.
Commercial Acumen & Influence: Proven ability to understand business drivers, translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and influence senior decision-makers to adopt data-led strategies.
Technical Expertise: Strong foundation in SQL and front-end dashboard development, combined with structured problem-solving skills and entrepreneurial initiative.
5 Core Skills: Data Analytics, Data Governance, Project Management, Stakeholder Engagement, and Change Management.


What’s In It For You


A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal
An environment where people of every ethnicity, social background, age, religion, gender and sexual orientation as well as people with disabilities are accepted, can speak up, will thrive and are celebrated!
A place where you can contribute to something bigger! Many of our brands have societal /environmental causes to make concrete difference

L’Oréal is present in 150 markets. Together, we solve complex challenges at scale, while staying committed to making the world a more inclusive and better place. Today, L’Oréal includes over 9k experts in beauty tech, digital, data and e-comm.

Title: BI & Data Consultant
Description:
Join Our Digital Transformation Journey

At Palsgaard, we are continuing our digital transformation by strengthening the applications, data platforms, and integrations that support our global business processes.

To support this journey, we are looking for a BI & Data Consultant who will play a key role in developing and improving our data platform, BI solutions, integrations, and business application landscape. The role combines hands-on technical development with close collaboration across IT and the business to turn data, BI, digital opportunities, and AI into scalable solutions.

In this role, you will work across a focused portfolio of BI, data platform, integration, and business-critical application technologies, including:


Our central data platform, which consolidates business data for reporting, analytics, and integrations between applications.
Power BI, Fabric, semantic models, and Microsoft Copilot, helping strengthen reporting, AI adoption, and value creation across the organization.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) and related integrations.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Work Point, and other business applications that support our global processes.


Our solutions are largely cloud-based and built on Microsoft Azure technologies. You will play an active role in maintaining, enhancing, and future-proofing our data platform, BI solutions, and related application landscape while ensuring strong collaboration between business stakeholders, IT, and external partners.

Your responsibilities:

As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be an important part of Palsgaard’s Global BI and Data Platform team in our global IT department in Juelsminde. You will contribute to strengthening the digital and data foundation that supports Palsgaard’s strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:


Develop, maintain, and further modernize our central data warehouse/data platform, including data ingestion, transformation, data modelling, and preparation of reliable data for reporting and analytics.
Develop Power BI reports from our backlog in close collaboration with global business stakeholders and the BI team, ensuring high-quality, scalable data models and clear analytical storytelling.
Contribute to improving how Palsgaard uses AI across the organization and how AI can support the development, documentation, automation, and quality of BI solutions created by the team.
Support daily operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of BI, data platform, and integration solutions.
Develop an understanding of Palsgaard’s broader IT application landscape and contribute to projects across global IT.


What we are looking for:

You bring a strong existing skill set, a relevant educational background, and solid hands-on experience within BI, data engineering, ETL processes, data warehousing/data platforms, and data modelling. You have the technical foundation to contribute actively from the start, while also bringing the curiosity and ambition needed to understand our business processes and help raise the capability, quality, and performance of our Global BI and Data Platform team.

Ideally, you bring a combination of:


A strong existing skill set within BI, ETL, data warehousing/data platforms, and semantic data modelling, supported by solid hands-on experience.
A good understanding of Microsoft-based technologies, preferably including Azure-based data warehouse development, Power BI/Fabric and Microsoft Dynamics AX or Finance and Operations (D365F&O).
The ability to understand existing business processes and translate business needs into sustainable data and application solutions.
An interest in working where business processes, technology, and data meet, combined with curiosity about new digital opportunities.
Experience with AI tools, combined with an understanding of relevant use cases and governance considerations, will be considered an advantage.
