Title: Analytikere med flair for databehandling til PET's kontraspionageindsats mod Rusland
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du vilje, evne og mod til at tage ansvar for Danmarks sikkerhed?

Vi står for din, Danmarks og Rigsfællesskabets sikkerhed. Vi arbejder med loven i hånden – også i samfundets skyggesider. Det er vores pligt at identificere, undersøge og stoppe dem, der truer vores samfund og demokrati, og dem, som vil os det ondt. Vi er Politiets Efterretningstjeneste – Danmarks nationale efterretnings- og sikkerhedstjeneste. Vi arbejder for dig – vil du arbejde for os?

Bliv en del af indsatsen rettet mod russisk spionage

Du tilbydes en central rolle i at bidrage til PET’s efterretningsindsats rettet mod spionagetruslen mod Danmark og danske interesser – specifikt på ruslandsområdet.

Som analytiker på ruslandsområdet i PET’s Afdeling for Kontraspionage vil du indgå på et operationshold, som varetager en række fremadrettede og bagudrettede efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer rettet mod grupper, netværk og enkeltpersoner, der mistænkes for at udgøre en spionagetrussel mod Danmark og/eller danske interesser.

Efterforskningsmæssig dybde og dataforståelse

I denne rolle vil du have et særligt fokus på analyse og behandling af informationer fra en bred vifte af datakilder – herunder teledata, telefoner og computere samt data fra andre af PET’s avancerede digitale indhentningsmuligheder. Du vil bidrage til at identificere mønstre, forbindelser og trusler ved hjælp af dine analytiske evner og tekniske kompetencer inden for databehandling.

En spændende og udfordrende hverdag

Du vil indgå på et operationshold, som primært beskæftiger sig med truslen fra de russiske efterretningstjenester. Et operationshold i på ruslandsområdet i Afdelingen for Kontraspionage består af medarbejdere med enten politimæssig eller anden relevant baggrund. Du vil som en integreret del af holdet skulle bidrage med dine kompetencer inden for databehandling og sammen med holdet træffe beslutninger om, hvilken retning efterforskningen skal tage for at imødegå spionagetruslen.

Hverdagen på et operationshold foregår med en høj grad af tværfagligt samarbejde i opgaveløsningen og på tværs af forskellige centre i PET. Vi anvender hele PET og politiets værktøjskasse til at løse opgaven og sikre Danmarks sikkerhed.

Du vil som udgangspunkt have almindelig dagstjeneste. Vi tilbyder stor fleksibilitet i forhold til mødetider. Samtidig forventer vi det samme af dig - stor indsats og fleksibilitet, når det i særlige situationer er nødvendigt, at vi rykker sammen og løser opgaver på alle tidspunkter af døgnet i kortere eller længere perioder. Hos os får du rig mulighed for at arbejde med hele PET´s værktøjskasse og bidrage med input til udvikling af nye værktøjer og metoder. Vi er et fagligt nysgerrigt center, der ønsker at skubbe til de grænser, der var gældende i går. Som en del af arbejdet hos os kan der desuden være mulighed for tjenesterejser af kortere eller længere varighed til både ind- og udland.

I PET vægter vi desuden visse personlige kompetencer højt. Det er kompetencer, som vi mener, er essentielle for alle PET-ansatte uanset faglig baggrund. Det gør vi, fordi det er vigtigt for os, at vi finder det rette match. Du kan læse om kompetencerne her www.pet.dk/job.

Om dig

Vi søger en kandidat med passion for og ekspertise i databaseret analyse og databehandling, der kan bidrage til vores efterforskning. Du er nysgerrig på data og besidder evnen til at tænke kreativt, ud af boksen og udvikle løsninger til komplekse dataudfordringer for derigennem at støtte vores efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer. Du er også i stand til at sætte dig ind i og anvende data i skiftende størrelser og formater i efterforskninger, der altid kan angribes fra en ny vinkel.

De Vigtigste Opgaver i Stillingen


Strukturering og systematisering af data fra PET’s indhentning
Kvalitativ og kvantitativ analyse med formålet af afdække operative muligheder
Udvikling af nye operative tiltag på grundlag af det analytiske output
Understøttelse af teamets løbende drift af igangværende sager
Koordinering med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke væsentlig for os. Selvfølgelig sætter vi pris på en specialiseret og muligvis videregående uddannelse, men vi tror på, at også den autodidakte kan være den bedste. Hvis du har erfaring med analyse og behandling af informationer fra en bred vifte af datakilder – herunder teledata, telefoner, computere og lignende – så vil det blive set som et plus.

Som person er du en holdspiller, positiv og åben for nye udfordringer. Du motiveres af at bidrage til kampen mod spionage og mindske truslen herfra i Danmark. Vi arbejder ofte i samarbejde med internationale partnere. Hvis du har særlige sprogkundskaber, må du derfor gerne gøre opmærksom på dette i din ansøgning.

Vi værdsætter din dedikation, idérigdom og gode samarbejdsevner. Du skal være robust og have god dømmekraft og kunne holde hovedet koldt i pressede situationer. Som en del af PET er du en aktiv del af samfundet, og din nysgerrighed og engagement i nye opgaver er vigtige for din succes.

Ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelsesstart pr. 01-11-2026. Du kan læse mere om hele PET’s ansættelsesproces på www.pet.dk/job.

Et ansættelsesforhold i PET skal behandles med diskretion, hvilket du som ansøger skal være opmærksom på. Det betyder, at du som udgangspunkt godt kan fortælle tætte og fortrolige relationer, som du har tillid til, at du har søgt en stilling i PET, men ikke hvad jobbet indebærer. Af hensyn til ansøgningsdiskretion bør du ligeledes være påpasselig med, hvilke informationer om dig selv og PET du evt. behandler i AI-systemer.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse i PET, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til yderst hemmelig, ligesom du skal kunne opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse. Som sikkerhedsgodkendt forventes det, at du er særlig opmærksom på din tavshedspligt i forhold til klassificeret information.

Har du en akademisk baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til de til enhver tid gældende aftaler mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation.

Har du en anden uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer i staten mellem Finansministeriet og HK/STAT samt OAO-S-fællesoverenskomst.

Dit arbejdssted bliver på Klausdalsbrovej 1 i Søborg, lige ved siden af Buddinge station, hvor både S-tog og bus kører lige til døren. I PET arbejder vi på interne systemer og med fortrolige opgaver, og derfor møder vi også på arbejde hver dag for at løse vores opgaver.

Yderligere information

Du kan lære meget mere om PET som arbejdsplads på www.pet.dk/job, hvor du bl.a. kan læse mere om alle de fagligheder, der arbejder i PET og deres hverdag. Du kan også lytte til vores podcastserie ’Tjenesten og truslerne’.

Du er også altid meget velkommen til at kontakte os på hverdage på mail hr-rekruttering@politi.dk eller på telefon +45 24 62 18 45, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, PET som arbejdsplads eller lignende.

Når du søger en stilling hos PET, giver du lov til, at vi må indhente dit CPR-nummer via CPR-registeret med henblik på identifikation af dig i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen. Vi indhenter dit CPR-nummer, så vi sikkert kan fremsende relevante og nødvendige dokumenter til dig via Digital Post.

Det er vigtigt for os, at PET afspejler den mangfoldighed, som vi arbejder for. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede, uanset køn, alder, religion, seksualitet og etniske tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Træd ind i en lukket verden, der åbner nye døre, hvor vi udvikler os, træner og bygger videre på det, vi kan. Om vi udvikler nye systemer, analyserer data eller finjusterer fodstillingen til skydetræning, så er vi altid på tæerne. Det skaber gode muligheder for, at du kan rykke dig med os, vokse med opgaverne og åbne nye døre i dit arbejdsliv.

Title: BI Consultant
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in its Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. As part of this journey, we are modernizing how data is managed, governed, and leveraged across our global organization.

We are looking for a BI Consultant to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing expertise with a passion for partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful business value through data and analytics.

The role

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team


Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring


Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus


Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

As a BI Consultant, you will work closely with business stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to understand business challenges, define analytical requirements, and deliver reporting and analytics solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

You will play a key role in ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of our enterprise data and reporting landscape while contributing to the continued development of our BI and analytics capabilities built on Microsoft Azure and Power BI.

This role requires a consultative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Partnering with business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify opportunities to create value through data and analytics
  • Designing, developing, and maintaining reporting and analytics solutions using Power BI
  • Translating business requirements into scalable data models, dashboards, and analytical solutions
  • Contributing to the development and evolution of our Enterprise Data Platform and Data Warehouse
  • Ensuring the quality, consistency, and integrity of enterprise data and reporting solutions
  • Supporting data governance, data quality, and master data management initiative
  • Driving adoption of self-service analytics and promoting best practices across the organization
  • Collaborating closely with Data Engineers, Architects, and other members of the Data & Analytics team

Suggested candidate profile

Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a relevant educational background within Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience delivering Business Intelligence and analytics solutions in a modern data environment.

You are someone who enjoys solving business challenges through data and turning complex requirements into meaningful insights. You are equally comfortable discussing business objectives with stakeholders and diving into the technical details of data models, reporting solutions, and analytics.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, and collaborative. You take ownership, build strong relationships across the organization, and maintain high standards for quality, professionalism, and data integrity.

More Specifically, You Bring

  • Around 5 years of experience within Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Data Warehousing, preferably from an international business environment
  • Strong experience with Power BI, including semantic modelling, DAX, and dashboard development
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with enterprise data warehouses
  • Experience gathering and translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Strong understanding of dimensional modelling and data warehousing principles
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or Azure Data Lake) is considered an advantage
  • Understanding of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Master Data Management principles is beneficial
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working is a plus

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Financial Data Management Consultant, Datadriven Banking, Netcompany Banking Services
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping the financial sector turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.



Netcompany Banking Services 

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.



Responsibilities & technologies



You will become part of a team that enables our customers to develop and manage their businesses through data and insights, working at the intersection of technology and finance. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data. To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in financial data management.



Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.



Your responsibilites will typically include:



Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.



Structuring and collection of data from various sources.



Implementation of financial business logic on data for use in reporting.



Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.



Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.



About you



You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within finance and data management, probably from a bank, an asset manager or similar. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex financial data and challenges. You thrive in an environment focused on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.



To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:



ETL and Database technologies.



Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.



Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.



Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.



The financial sector, including regulatory reporting in the banking sector.



Join an inclusive community 



At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring. 



As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being. 



As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career. 



Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.



All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.



We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: Analytikere med flair for databehandling til PET's kontraspionageindsats mod Rusland
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du vilje, evne og mod til at tage ansvar for Danmarks sikkerhed?

Vi står for din, Danmarks og Rigsfællesskabets sikkerhed. Vi arbejder med loven i hånden – også i samfundets skyggesider. Det er vores pligt at identificere, undersøge og stoppe dem, der truer vores samfund og demokrati, og dem, som vil os det ondt. Vi er Politiets Efterretningstjeneste – Danmarks nationale efterretnings- og sikkerhedstjeneste. Vi arbejder for dig – vil du arbejde for os?

Bliv en del af indsatsen rettet mod russisk spionage

Du tilbydes en central rolle i at bidrage til PET’s efterretningsindsats rettet mod spionagetruslen mod Danmark og danske interesser – specifikt på ruslandsområdet.

Som analytiker på ruslandsområdet i PET’s Afdeling for Kontraspionage vil du indgå på et operationshold, som varetager en række fremadrettede og bagudrettede efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer rettet mod grupper, netværk og enkeltpersoner, der mistænkes for at udgøre en spionagetrussel mod Danmark og/eller danske interesser.

Efterforskningsmæssig dybde og dataforståelse

I denne rolle vil du have et særligt fokus på analyse og behandling af informationer fra en bred vifte af datakilder – herunder teledata, telefoner og computere samt data fra andre af PET’s avancerede digitale indhentningsmuligheder. Du vil bidrage til at identificere mønstre, forbindelser og trusler ved hjælp af dine analytiske evner og tekniske kompetencer inden for databehandling.

En spændende og udfordrende hverdag

Du vil indgå på et operationshold, som primært beskæftiger sig med truslen fra de russiske efterretningstjenester. Et operationshold i på ruslandsområdet i Afdelingen for Kontraspionage består af medarbejdere med enten politimæssig eller anden relevant baggrund. Du vil som en integreret del af holdet skulle bidrage med dine kompetencer inden for databehandling og sammen med holdet træffe beslutninger om, hvilken retning efterforskningen skal tage for at imødegå spionagetruslen.

Hverdagen på et operationshold foregår med en høj grad af tværfagligt samarbejde i opgaveløsningen og på tværs af forskellige centre i PET. Vi anvender hele PET og politiets værktøjskasse til at løse opgaven og sikre Danmarks sikkerhed.

Du vil som udgangspunkt have almindelig dagstjeneste. Vi tilbyder stor fleksibilitet i forhold til mødetider. Samtidig forventer vi det samme af dig - stor indsats og fleksibilitet, når det i særlige situationer er nødvendigt, at vi rykker sammen og løser opgaver på alle tidspunkter af døgnet i kortere eller længere perioder. Hos os får du rig mulighed for at arbejde med hele PET´s værktøjskasse og bidrage med input til udvikling af nye værktøjer og metoder. Vi er et fagligt nysgerrigt center, der ønsker at skubbe til de grænser, der var gældende i går. Som en del af arbejdet hos os kan der desuden være mulighed for tjenesterejser af kortere eller længere varighed til både ind- og udland.

I PET vægter vi desuden visse personlige kompetencer højt. Det er kompetencer, som vi mener, er essentielle for alle PET-ansatte uanset faglig baggrund. Det gør vi, fordi det er vigtigt for os, at vi finder det rette match. Du kan læse om kompetencerne her www.pet.dk/job.

Om dig

Vi søger en kandidat med passion for og ekspertise i databaseret analyse og databehandling, der kan bidrage til vores efterforskning. Du er nysgerrig på data og besidder evnen til at tænke kreativt, ud af boksen og udvikle løsninger til komplekse dataudfordringer for derigennem at støtte vores efterforskninger og efterretningsoperationer. Du er også i stand til at sætte dig ind i og anvende data i skiftende størrelser og formater i efterforskninger, der altid kan angribes fra en ny vinkel.

De Vigtigste Opgaver i Stillingen


Strukturering og systematisering af data fra PET’s indhentning
Kvalitativ og kvantitativ analyse med formålet af afdække operative muligheder
Udvikling af nye operative tiltag på grundlag af det analytiske output
Understøttelse af teamets løbende drift af igangværende sager
Koordinering med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere


Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke væsentlig for os. Selvfølgelig sætter vi pris på en specialiseret og muligvis videregående uddannelse, men vi tror på, at også den autodidakte kan være den bedste. Hvis du har erfaring med analyse og behandling af informationer fra en bred vifte af datakilder – herunder teledata, telefoner, computere og lignende – så vil det blive set som et plus.

Som person er du en holdspiller, positiv og åben for nye udfordringer. Du motiveres af at bidrage til kampen mod spionage og mindske truslen herfra i Danmark. Vi arbejder ofte i samarbejde med internationale partnere. Hvis du har særlige sprogkundskaber, må du derfor gerne gøre opmærksom på dette i din ansøgning.

Vi værdsætter din dedikation, idérigdom og gode samarbejdsevner. Du skal være robust og have god dømmekraft og kunne holde hovedet koldt i pressede situationer. Som en del af PET er du en aktiv del af samfundet, og din nysgerrighed og engagement i nye opgaver er vigtige for din succes.

Ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelsesstart pr. 01-11-2026. Du kan læse mere om hele PET’s ansættelsesproces på www.pet.dk/job.

Et ansættelsesforhold i PET skal behandles med diskretion, hvilket du som ansøger skal være opmærksom på. Det betyder, at du som udgangspunkt godt kan fortælle tætte og fortrolige relationer, som du har tillid til, at du har søgt en stilling i PET, men ikke hvad jobbet indebærer. Af hensyn til ansøgningsdiskretion bør du ligeledes være påpasselig med, hvilke informationer om dig selv og PET du evt. behandler i AI-systemer.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse i PET, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til yderst hemmelig, ligesom du skal kunne opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse. Som sikkerhedsgodkendt forventes det, at du er særlig opmærksom på din tavshedspligt i forhold til klassificeret information.

Har du en akademisk baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til de til enhver tid gældende aftaler mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation.

Har du en anden uddannelsesmæssig baggrund, bliver du ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer i staten mellem Finansministeriet og HK/STAT samt OAO-S-fællesoverenskomst.

Dit arbejdssted bliver på Klausdalsbrovej 1 i Søborg, lige ved siden af Buddinge station, hvor både S-tog og bus kører lige til døren. I PET arbejder vi på interne systemer og med fortrolige opgaver, og derfor møder vi også på arbejde hver dag for at løse vores opgaver.

Yderligere information

Du kan lære meget mere om PET som arbejdsplads på www.pet.dk/job, hvor du bl.a. kan læse mere om alle de fagligheder, der arbejder i PET og deres hverdag. Du kan også lytte til vores podcastserie ’Tjenesten og truslerne’.

Du er også altid meget velkommen til at kontakte os på hverdage på mail hr-rekruttering@politi.dk eller på telefon +45 24 62 18 45, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, PET som arbejdsplads eller lignende.

Når du søger en stilling hos PET, giver du lov til, at vi må indhente dit CPR-nummer via CPR-registeret med henblik på identifikation af dig i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen. Vi indhenter dit CPR-nummer, så vi sikkert kan fremsende relevante og nødvendige dokumenter til dig via Digital Post.

Det er vigtigt for os, at PET afspejler den mangfoldighed, som vi arbejder for. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede, uanset køn, alder, religion, seksualitet og etniske tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Træd ind i en lukket verden, der åbner nye døre, hvor vi udvikler os, træner og bygger videre på det, vi kan. Om vi udvikler nye systemer, analyserer data eller finjusterer fodstillingen til skydetræning, så er vi altid på tæerne. Det skaber gode muligheder for, at du kan rykke dig med os, vokse med opgaverne og åbne nye døre i dit arbejdsliv.

Title: Bliv Specialist i Quality Assurance Data med fokus på datadrevne kontroller og risikostyring
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at opbygge en ny Quality Assurance-funktion, der gennem databaserede indsigter udvikler Nykredits risikokultur og understøtter en mere risikobaseret tilgang på tværs af organisationen? Så er dette måske din næste udfordring.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor data er en central drivkraft for at øge kvalitet, transparens og risikoforståelse i Nykredit. Funktionen udspringer af kreditområdet, men med en plan om gradvist at udvide sit fokus til at dække flere risikoområder som ejendomsvurdering, FinCrime og markedsmisbrugsovervågning.

Vi søger en profil med solide datakompetencer, som trives i krydsfeltet mellem data, kontrol og forretning. Du skal være med til at udvikle datadrevne kontrolprocesser og omsætte resultater til dashboards, rapportering og beslutningsrelevante indsigter.

Samtidig får du mulighed for at sætte dit aftryk på en ny funktion i vækst. Du bliver en central sparringspartner i arbejdet med at forme arbejdsmetoder, datagrundlag og løsninger i tæt samarbejde med forretningen og ledelsen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver

Du kommer til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, kontrol og forretningsudvikling med fokus på at skabe værdi gennem indsigt og forbedringer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:


opbygge og vedligeholde datagrundlag, datasæt og dataprocesser til kontroller, analyser og rapportering,
designe og videreudvikle datadrevne kontrolprocesser baseret på data, forretningslogik og AI,
udvikle dashboards og BI-løsninger, der understøtter læring og beslutningstagning
være med til at identificere muligheder for at arbejde smartere, reducere manuelle processer og øge kvaliteten i vores leverancer – eksempelvis gennem bedre brug af værktøjer, standarder, automatisering og AI-understøttelse,
omsætte kontrolresultater og analyser til klare og handlingsorienterede indsigter for forretningen, ledelsen, direktionen og bestyrelsen.



Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du motiveres af at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, forretning og risikostyring. Du er nysgerrig på data i hele værdikæden og trives med at skabe struktur, udvikle løsninger og omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til anvendelige indsigter og forbedringer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:


har erfaring med, hvordan data indsamles, struktureres og anvendes på tværs af systemer og processer,
har erfaring med at udvikle visualiseringer, der kan omsætte komplekse resultater til forståelige indsigter og konkrete forbedringstiltag,
arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt med stor motivation,
har gode samarbejdsevner og trives med en bred kontaktflade i organisationen,
er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og muligheder inden for data, automatisering og AI.



Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med værktøjer som:


SAS
R
Power BI
Power Apps
Andre tilsvarende værktøjer til dataanalyse, visualisering og rapportering



Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

Dit nye team

Du indgår i et fagligt dygtigt miljø med engagerede kolleger og stor mulighed for at præge både opgaver og løsninger. Vi er et mindre team, som arbejder tæt sammen og hjælper hinanden på tværs af opgaver og projekter. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem sparring, nysgerrighed og forskellige perspektiver.

Vi lægger samtidig stor vægt på fællesskabet. Tonen er uformel, samarbejdet er tæt, og der er plads til både faglige diskussioner og godt humør i hverdagen. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og har tillid til, at den enkelte tager initiativ og driver sine opgaver fremad.

Som en del af teamet får du mulighed for at være med til at opbygge og videreudvikle en funktion i vækst, hvor du kan sætte dit præg på både arbejdsmetoder og løsninger.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller Nykredit som arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Louise Chua på LCHU@nykredit.dk

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Title: Business Intelligence Consultant
Company: SameSystem - Retail WFM | Part of ECIT
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
BI Consultant




Please note that fluency in Danish is a requirement for this position.

Due to the summer holidays, please expect a longer processing time.




SameSystem

Are you ready to turn data into real commercial value for some of Europe's largest retail and hospitality brands? At SameSystem, we empower companies like Bestseller, Nike, Normal, and Matas to optimize their operations daily with our cutting-edge AI-driven Workforce Management Solution. We're looking for a BI Consultant who is as comfortable building a clean dashboard as sitting across the table from a customer explaining what it means for their business.

This is a full-time role, and you'll join our Customer Success team in Copenhagen. You'll own the business intelligence and reporting side of our platform: building and maintaining reports in our BI tool, Sisense, and being the person our customers and colleagues turn to when a number needs to make sense. We've deliberately placed this role in Customer Success rather than in a back-office data team, because the reporting is only worth as much as the commercial insight it drives. This role suits someone who is happy behind the screen building things properly, but who does not want to only sit behind the screen.

This is a new role, so the right person will have real influence over how we build, package, and deliver the analytics side of our platform.




Key responsibilities

Building the reports

Design, build, and maintain BI reports and dashboards in Sisense, with strong attention to data integrity, performance, and usability
Translate customer and internal requirements into robust data models and reporting logic
Own reporting quality across accounts, including validation, troubleshooting, and iterative improvement
Develop new reporting capabilities and scope custom development work as our customers' needs grow




Working with customers

Join customer meetings and represent the BI and analytics part of the SameSystem platform
Talk specific development and scoping with customers, and translate their business questions into what we can actually build
Help customers see the value in their data, and support Customer Success and Sales in retention, upselling, and expansion through analytics
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support to feed customer needs back into the platform




What we're looking for

Proven experience building reports and dashboards in a BI tool. Experience with Sisense is a strong plus; solid experience with a comparable tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik) is very welcome
Enough experience under your belt to own your work end to end
Strong SQL and data modelling skills, and the instinct to build things properly rather than just quickly
Commercial acumen. You understand that a report exists to drive a decision, and you're comfortable talking value and scope with customers
Confidence in client-facing settings, presenting clearly to both operational and managerial stakeholders
The balance we keep coming back to: someone who can do focused, hands-on build work and also step into a customer meeting and hold their own
A self-starter who takes ownership and isn't afraid to share ideas. Execution matters
Nice to have: comfort scoping and pricing development work. If pricing is new to you, that's fine, we can teach it
Fluency in Danish and English; additional European languages are a plus
Familiarity with retail operations or workforce management is a plus




What you'll get

At SameSystem, we are committed to transforming retail and hospitality through cutting-edge technology. Joining our team means:

Working in a dynamic environment where innovation drives success.
Contributing to the success of over 185,000 employees across 12,500+ stores in 24 countries.
Access to professional growth opportunities in a company that values expertise and collaboration.
Being part of a supportive culture that prioritizes work-life balance and employee satisfaction.
Lots of social activities and fun parties as well as "clubs" run by employees where SameSystem sponsors going to a sauna, playing badminton, drinking port wine, or whatever else the team can think of.
Lunch and as much coffee, soda or energy drink as you can muster.




If you have any questions about this position, please reach out to Nikolai May Yde at nikolai.yde@samesystem.com.

Title: Analytikere til strategisk planlægning i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi og teknik
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du med på et hold af dygtige kollegaer, der arbejder med strategiske og økonomiske analyser med henblik på investering, optimering og udvikling af jernbanen?

I Banedanmark søger vi en til to analytikere med lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi og teknik. Her kan du både komme til at arbejde med drift, analyser og udvikling af vores prognosemodeller til reinvesteringer i jernbanen, prissætninger i forbindelse med de store infrastrukturprojekter, strategiske og økonomiske analyser med henblik på udvikling af jernbanen samt analyser af klima- og risikoforhold, der kan påvirke jernbanens infrastruktur og behovet for investeringer og vedligehold.

Banedanmark er en af statens største styrelser, hvor mere end 2.500 medarbejdere hver dag sikrer, at Danmarks jernbane udvikles, driftes og vedligeholdes. På hovedkontoret ved Dybbølsbro i København sidder din nye sektion Strategisk Planlægning i hjertet af Banedanmark.

Alt efter dine kvalifikationer, motivation og ønsker til udvikling vil vi sammensætte din opgaveportefølje inden for vores brede portefølje af projekter og analyser.

Optimering og udvikling af jernbanen gennem dataunderstøttet planlægning

Din arbejdsdag vil blive sammensat af forskelligartede opgaver, primært indenfor:


Databearbejdning og analyser med vores prognosemodeller til reinvesteringer i jernbanen
Databaserede analyser bl.a. i form af cost-analyser, der indebærer at opstille scenarier, foretage beregninger og omsætte analyseresultater til beslutningsstøtte
Analyser af klimarelaterede risici og deres mulige konsekvenser for jernbaneinfrastrukturen, herunder arbejde med klimascenarier, data og beslutningsstøtte
Prissætning af anlægs- og fornyelsesprojekter ud fra principperne i Ny Anlægsbudgettering (NAB), der er gældende på Transportministeriets område
Strategiske analyser med henblik på at optimere Banedanmarks forvaltning af infrastrukturen


Analytikere med fokus på samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder

Vi forestiller os, at du har en videregående uddannelse med fokus på kvantitative metoder f.eks. økonom, ingeniør eller lignende, men du kan også have erhvervet den nødvendige viden gennem erhvervserfaring. Hvis du har nogle års erfaring, f.eks. fra en lignende stilling i centraladministrationen eller fra en rådgiver- eller entreprenørvirksomhed vil det være gavnligt, men du kan også godt være nyuddannet. Det vigtigste er, at vi finder den rigtige profil, der bidrager til gruppen, og som har evnerne og interessen for at arbejde i en teknisk, økonomisk og politisk verden.

Det Er Vigtigt, At Du


Har gode analytiske og metodiske evner og trives med data og tal
Kan arbejde på egen hånd og samtidig indgå i samarbejde på tværs af fagområder
Kan dykke ned i detaljer uden at miste det strategiske overblik
Er god til at formidle komplekse problemstillinger enkelt og klart
Kan tage ejerskab over opgaver, styre processer og overholde deadlines


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med Excel og gerne programmering, fx Python.

Din nye arbejdsplads

Du vil blive en del af sektionen Strategisk Planlægning, hvor du får 20 dygtige og engagerede kollegaer, der arbejder med planlægningen af de projekter, der bliver til konkret jernbane i Danmark. Vi sætter pris på alles input og supplerer hinandens viden i hverdagen. Sektionen er uformel, og du vil opleve en oprigtig interesse i at føre dig godt ind i fællesskabet og opgaverne. Sektionen er en del af området Strategisk Asset Management, der består af omkring 40 specialiserede medarbejdere fordelt på tre sektioner.

Du vil opleve en arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for at vokse og udvikle dig fagligt. Du vil blive kastet hurtigt ud i opgaverne, hvor der vil blive krævet noget af dig, men der vil altid være rum og mulighed for sparring hos din leder og dine kollegaer.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Hvis du er akademiker, ansættes du efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten. Du indplaceres på baggrund af akademisk anciennitet og erfaring som fuldmægtig på basistrin eller som specialkonsulent. Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er tilknyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning på 18,07 %.

Arbejdssted er Carsten Niebuhrs Gade 43, 1577 København V, tæt på Dybbølsbro St. Her får du bl.a. betalt frokostpause, fælles kantine, frugtordning, café og motionsrum.

Title: (Senior) Consultant – Financial Services Advisory
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you motivated by working with data, analytics, and quantitative problem-solving in the financial services sector? Do you have 1–4 years of experience from banking, consultancy, or a similar data-driven environment, and would you like to help clients turn complex data into clear insights and practical solutions? Welcome to KPMG.

We are looking for a curious and structured data and analytical profile to join our Financial Services Advisory team. Title: Assortment Analyst, IMEA
Description:
Are you passionate about retail, consumer behavior, and using data to drive commercial decisions? Do you thrive in a fast-paced international environment where creativity meets business performance?




Then you might be the Assortment Analyst we're looking for to help grow Flying Tiger Copenhagen across the IMEA (India, Middle East and Africa) region.




About the Role

Based at our HQ office in Central Copenhagen (Christianshavn), you will play a key role in optimizing the product assortment for our growing IMEA region.

Working closely with Commercial, Retail teams and franchise partners, you will use data and market insights to ensure our assortment reflects local customer needs while staying true to the Flying Tiger Copenhagen concept.

Your analysis and recommendations will directly support commercial performance, new store openings, and profitable growth across the region.




What you will do:




Drive assortment performance

Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve assortment relevance, sales, and profitability.
Analyze sales trends, customer behavior, and market insights to support assortment decisions.
Contribute to assortment reviews and recommend commercial actions based on data.




Support commercial planning

Support the planning of seasonal launches, campaigns, and commercial calendars.
Analyze product commitments and inventory plans to maximize commercial performance.
Partner with Demand Planning and Supply Chain to optimize product availability and inventory health.




Support business growth

Develop assortment and space recommendations for new store openings and existing stores.
Collaborate with stores and commercial teams to identify assortment gaps and growth opportunities.
Support continuous improvement of commercial processes and best practices.




Deliver insights

Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business reporting.
Present recommendations to regional leadership and global stakeholders.
Conduct ad hoc analyses supporting strategic initiatives and business development.




Who you are

You have a bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field (master’s degree is a plus).
2-4 years of experience in retail planning, merchandising, category management, commercial planning, business analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Strong commercial mindset and passion for retail and customer behavior.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to transform data into actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with BI and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is an advantage.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across functions and cultures.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Curious, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic, growing organization.




What We Offer

At Flying Tiger Copenhagen, we believe life is richer with fun. You'll join an international retail company where creativity, entrepreneurship, and collaboration are part of everyday life.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence commercial decisions across a growing region, work closely with colleagues in Miami, Copenhagen, and Singapore, and help shape the future of Flying Tiger Copenhagen in IMEA.

You will report to the Head of Commercial, IMEA and become part of a regional team of eight entrepreneurial colleagues with close collaboration across our global organization.




Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:




Probably the best location - in the heart of Copenhagen
Attractive pension plan
Private health insurance - also including children
Flexibility with the opportunity of working from home
Special discounts in our own Flying Tiger Shops
Fun and dynamic culture
A social and informal workplace with parties, Friday bars, staff club etc.
International work environment founded in Scandinavian culture
Delicious restaurant food in our own canteen everyday – including cake on Thursdays
Celebration and many other occasions to eat Cake
And much more…




Did you know?

We take climate change very seriously and work very hard to minimize our carbon footprint. We do this by buying less plastic and more renewable materials (everything which grows) – and we also want to make sure that all stores are run on renewable energy. We walk the talk – and make sure that what we do is validated by external experts, in the Science Based Targets initiative. You can read more about our work with climate action here.

Title: FP&A Analyst
Description:
Nobia - a leading European kitchen specialist listed on Nasdaq Stockholm - is looking for a Business Analyst / Business Controller to join our Finance function in Aarhus. This is not a traditional controlling role. We are building the finance function of the future: one where data, AI and sharp business insight come together to drive real value across our Nordic brands.

You will work closely with the Finance leadership and across the wider business to elevate our performance management agenda, automate how we work with data, and bring AI-powered solutions into the heart of finance. You will be part of a function in transformation, with significant room to shape both the way we work and your own development path.

What You’ll Do

Your work will sit at the intersection of business partnering, analytics and AI-driven automation. Concretely, you will:


Build and drive our monthly performance management cycle - from data to insight to decision - in close collaboration with business and finance leaders.
Lead deep-dive analyses on margin, customer and product profitability, and cost drivers, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.
Identify and implement AI pilot projects within finance processes - from automating reporting flows to building intelligent analytical workflows.
Act as a trusted business partner, asking the right questions and challenging assumptions with a calm, data-driven perspective.
Contribute to building the analytical foundation and tooling that our finance function will rely on for years to come.


Who You Are

We are looking for a sharp analytical profile, with strong ambitions and the right mindset. Most importantly, you are genuinely curious - constantly looking for ways to do things better and create greater value. You want to be part of shaping the future finance function, where we drive impact for the business by keeping a cool, clear overview of what really matters.

We expect that you bring:


2 - 4 years of relevant experience from a controlling, FP&A, business analyst or consulting role - ideally in a multi-brand, multi-country or retail/consumer goods context.
A strong analytical toolkit: solid command of Python and/or SQL for data analysis and automation.
Hands-on experience with modern AI tools (Copilot, Claude or similar) - and an active interest in how AI changes the way finance works.
A relevant academic background (e.g. cand.merc., cand.oecon., cand.polit., or similar).
Strong business acumen - you see numbers as a means to better decisions, not an end in themselves.


The mindset we’re looking for

More than any specific skill, we care about how you think. You are curious by default, and you ask “how could we do this better?” before you ask “how have we always done it?” You see AI and automation not as buzzwords, but as practical levers to free up time for the analyses that actually move the business. You are comfortable challenging stakeholders constructively, and you keep a cool head when complexity rises.

What we offer


A pivotal role in building the next chapter of finance at Nobia Denmark.
Direct exposure to senior business and finance leadership, with real influence on the agenda.
A workplace based in Tilst with strong flexibility around how and where you work.
Competitive compensation and the opportunity to grow alongside a finance function in transformation.
A culture where curiosity, ownership and continuous improvement are genuinely valued.


Curious for more?

Get a glimpse of what life is like at Nobia right here!

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to reach out to our CFO Nobia Denmark, Rasmus Sylvester Nørgreen on rsl@nobia.dk.

A cover letter is not necessary, but please include a short motivation in your CV. We process applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your CV as soon as possible.

Start date: As soon as possible — we are ready when you are.

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Title: KMD - Legal Operations Analyst
Description:
RESOLVA bistår KMD med rekrutteringen af en Legal Operations Analyst




ROLLEBESKRIVELSE

KMD søger en analytisk og nysgerrig Legal Operations Analyst, der vil være med til at opbygge arbejdet med Legal Operations, Business Intelligence og Legal AI. Du kommer ind tidligt i udviklingen af en ny funktion og får mulighed for at præge, hvordan data, teknologi og procesforbedringer fremover skal understøtte den juridiske organisation, og du vil arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, teknologi, processer og forretning.




En central del af rollen bliver at styrke anvendelsen af data på tværs af den juridiske funktion og skabe et bedre datagrundlag for blandt andet beslutninger og ledelsesrapportering. Det indebærer blandt andet at strukturere og analysere data om f.eks. kontrakter (herunder i forbindelse med udløb eller genforhandling), juridiske complianceopgaver og andre relevante aktiviteter samt omsætte data til klare indsigter, forbedrede processer og anvendelig rapportering.




KMD har allerede implementeret nye systemer og løsninger, som danner et godt fundament for den videre udvikling af området. En del af rollen bliver i den forbindelse blandt andet at arbejde med KMD's Contract Lifecycle Management-system og bidrage til den videre udvikling af processer inden for contract management og claims management samt til, hvordan data og digitale løsninger bedst struktureres og anvendes i praksis.




Rollen rummer samtidig et væsentligt udviklings- og transformationsspor. Du vil bl.a. være med til at designe workflows og operating models, etablere fælles processer for modtagelse, prioritering og opfølgning på juridiske opgaver samt identificere muligheder for automatisering og relevant anvendelse af AI. Herudover vil du være involveret i de strategiske overvejelser om, hvor der er størst behov og potentiale for udvikling og optimering. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med alle medarbejdere i Group Legal i forbindelse med optimering af processer på tværs af den juridiske funktion.




Du får samtidig en bred kontaktflade til tekniske specialister, ledere og den øvrige forretning. En vigtig del af rollen bliver at komme tæt på forretningen og forstå, hvordan der arbejdes i dag, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og omsætte konkrete behov til brugbare løsninger. Vi forestiller os derfor, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan mennesker og processer fungerer i praksis, tør stille spørgsmål og kan følge løsninger hele vejen fra idé og design til implementering og anvendelse.




Rollen har større vægt på data, procesoptimering, change management og teknologi end på juridisk specialistviden. Det er derfor ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med jura og juridiske processer. Til gengæld får du mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer i spil i en juridisk kontekst og være med til at sætte retningen for et område i markant udvikling.




TEAMET

Som Legal Operations Analyst bliver du en del af et nyt Legal Operations-team i Group Legal & Compliance. Teamet er under opbygning, og du får mulighed for at være med til at udvikle KMD's juridiske afdeling og gøre arbejdet med kontrakter og juridiske processer mere effektivt, datadrevet og teknologisk understøttet. KMD søger en kandidat, der kan supplere teamets juridiske kompetencer, og som har erfaring med og interesse for data, processer og digitale løsninger.




Legal Operations er forankret i Corporate Secretariatet og består i dag af Director Natalie Benard, som du vil rapportere til, en Compliance Officer og en student. Ambitionen er, at teamet over tid skal vokse med flere medarbejdere.




Du vil arbejde fra KMD's hovedkontor i Ballerup.




ANSVARSOMRÅDER

Som Legal Operations Analyst hos KMD vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver bl.a. bestå af følgende:




Indsamle, strukturere og analysere data om juridiske opgaver, herunder kontrakter, governance, compliance og øvrige relevante aktiviteter og sikre et solidt datagrundlag for rapportering og beslutningsstøtte.




Bidrage til at kortlægge og skabe overblik over opgaver, processer og udviklingsbehov på tværs af Group Legal samt understøtte prioriteringen af, hvor der er størst behov og potentiale for udvikling og optimering.




Udvikle rapporteringsredskaber, eksempelvis dashboards i Power BI, og på anden vis omsætte data til klare og anvendelige indsigter til brug for blandt andet ledelsesrapportering.




Designe workflows og operating models, identificere muligheder for procesforbedring og automatisering samt bidrage til at etablere fælles processer for modtagelse, prioritering og opfølgning på juridiske opgaver på tværs af Group Legal.




Identificere og afprøve relevante anvendelsesmuligheder for AI og andre digitale løsninger i den juridiske funktion.




Arbejde med KMD’s Contract Lifecycle Management-system og bidrage til den videre udvikling af processer inden for contract management og claims management.




Arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen og relevante stakeholders for at forstå eksisterende arbejdsgange, identificere behov og omsætte dem til brugbare løsninger samt understøtte implementering, change management og løbende opfølgning på løsninger og processers anvendelse og effekt.




RAPPORTERING OG TITEL

Rapportering til: Natalie Benard, Director, Legal Business Partners.




Titel: Legal Operations Analyst.




IDEELLE KOMPETENCER

Uddannelse: Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund inden for Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Data Science, Digital Business, Information Systems, Digital Innovation & Management, IT-ledelse og digitalisering, Operations Management eller Industrial Engineering.




Andre uddannelsesmæssige baggrunde med fokus på eksempelvis proces- og organisationsudvikling, automatisering eller datadrevet forretningsudvikling kan også være relevante. Det væsentlige er, at du kan kombinere data, teknologi og procesforståelse og omsætte det til konkrete forbedringer i organisationen.




En juridisk baggrund kan også være relevant, hvis den kombineres med en tydelig interesse for og forståelse af data, teknologi, procesoptimering og digital udvikling.




Erfaring & faglige kompetencer: Du har op til 3-4 års relevant erfaring og kan også være nyuddannet. Din erfaring kan eksempelvis være fra konsulentbranchen, en IT-virksomhed eller en anden virksomhed, hvor du har arbejdet med data, processer, digitalisering eller forretningsudvikling. Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med juridiske processer.




Du har en stærk analytisk sans og interesse for databehandling, rapportering, procesdesign og digitalisering. Erfaring med eksempelvis Power BI, udvikling af rapporteringsværktøjer, workflow-design, procesautomatisering, AI eller change management er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Forretningsforståelse: Du er nysgerrig på, hvordan forretningen og de enkelte arbejdsgange fungerer i praksis, og du formår at omsætte behov og udfordringer til konkrete og brugbare løsninger. Du motiveres af at identificere forbedringsmuligheder og udvikle processer og løsninger, der gør arbejdet enklere og mere effektivt.




PERSONLIGE KOMPETENCER

Analytisk & struktureret: Du arbejder analytisk og struktureret og har evnen til at skabe overblik over komplekse problemstillinger. Samtidig formår du at omsætte data til klare konklusioner og konkrete anbefalinger, der kan anvendes i praksis.




Nysgerrig & åbent mindset: Du er nysgerrig på mennesker, processer og teknologi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at udfordre eksisterende arbejdsgange konstruktivt. Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og motiveres af at designe og optimere processer.




Stakeholder management: Du trives med at være tæt på forretningen, stille spørgsmål og sætte dig ind i forskellige behov og arbejdsgange. Du samarbejder naturligt på tværs af fagligheder og kan skabe gode relationer til både jurister, ledere, tekniske specialister og øvrige stakeholders.




Hands-on tilgang: Du tager ansvar og driver opgaver fremad fra idé til implementering og anvendelse. Du har en hands-on tilgang og trives med selv at være involveret i at udvikle, teste og løbende forbedre løsninger.




ANSÆTTELSESVILKÅR

KMD tilbyder dig en spændende mulighed for at være med fra begyndelsen, når en ny Legal Operations-funktion opbygges, og brugen af data, teknologi og AI i Group Legal & Compliance udvikles. Du får reel mulighed for at præge både løsningerne, prioriteringerne og din egen rolle i takt med, at området vokser.




Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med jurister, ledere, tekniske specialister og forretningen i en kultur med frihed under ansvar og højt til loftet. KMD tilbyder attraktive ansættelsesvilkår, en hybrid arbejdsplads med stor fleksibilitet og fokus på work-life-balance.




OM KMD

KMD er en af Danmarks største IT-virksomheder og udvikler samt leverer software, IT-løsninger og digitale services til den offentlige og private sektor. Virksomheden har gennem mere end 50 år været en central del af digitaliseringen af det danske samfund og leverer løsninger, der understøtter en række samfundskritiske funktioner, herunder inden for administration af velfærdsydelser, beskæftigelsesindsatser, sundhedsrelaterede processer, uddannelsesområdet samt digital selvbetjening for borgere og virksomheder.




KMD har hovedsæde i Ballerup og beskæftiger ca. 2200 medarbejdere.




Hvis du vil vide mere om KMD, kan du besøge deres hjemmeside her: https://www.kmd.dk/.




KONTAKT OG ANSØGNING

Hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vedlæg venligst dit CV samt anden relevant dokumentation. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Camilla Krogh på tlf. (+45 51261264) eller Mikkel Falkenberg på tlf. (+45 29993065) fra RESOLVA.

Title: S&OP Specialist
Place: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you a data-driven professional with a passion for Supply Chain, driving local reviews, optimizing processes, and developing data insights? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!




About the job

Join our Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) team at Orifarm as a Specialist for Local Reviews & Data Analysis and play a key role in shaping the operational direction in Orifarm. This position involves collaborating closely with various teams to support and elevate our S&OP processes, ensuring alignment and operational growth across multiple areas.




We are looking for an S&OP Specialist with a strategic supply chain mindset and strong analytical skills who values and understands the importance of stakeholder management. As an S&OP Specialist, you will prepare, facilitate, and drive several monthly reviews while engaging with our local sales markets and operational supply teams. Additionally, you will analyze, identify, implement, and streamline data improvement opportunities to ensure efficiency and effectiveness across our Orifarm Strategic Business Areas.




Your key responsibilities will be to:

Prepare, facilitate, and drive monthly S&OP reviews, ensuring structured dialogue, strong stakeholder involvement, and effective follow-up
Coordinate with various stakeholders to gather relevant data, analyze trends, and present insights
Develop and increase the level of content and interaction during local S&OP Reviews
Support S&OP and local teams in understanding demand and supply priorities and translating them into actionable plans
Utilize strong analytical skills to drive process improvements and strategic insights
Analyze data from various sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and present findings to management
Drive the implementation and maintenance of various Power BI reports and dashboards, focusing on optimizing workflows and ensuring trusted data-driven decision-making at all levels




Who are you?

To succeed in this role, you should bring hands-on experience with S&OP processes, including the preparation and facilitation of cross-functional reviews. You are able to translate data and insights into actionable business impact and use your communication skills to support transparent and informed decision-making across functions.




We imagine that you have a solid understanding of supply chain management, S&OP, data analysis, and process optimization. Experience with demand planning is an advantage, but most importantly, you are analytically strong, structured, and motivated by improving processes and creating clear insights.




You have excellent stakeholder management, engagement, and communication skills. Furthermore, you have a degree in Supply Chain Operations, Management or Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Business, or a related field.




Who are we?

You will be part of our S&OP team reporting to the Head of S&OP & Analytics. The team consists of 6 colleagues all based in Odense, Denmark. Our team plays a key role in balancing Supply & Demand by acting as trusted advisors and process optimization identifiers. The S&OP team is also responsible for front-end data development, maintenance, and transparency, assisting the Orifarm business in creating various data insights and analysis by implementing Power BI reports and dashboards, focusing on optimizing workflows and ensuring trusted data-driven decision-making at all levels.




As a team, we foster a collaborative and informal work culture, where open communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork are at the heart of what we do.




Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.




We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.




When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.




We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.




We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Title: Sales Analyst - Nordics & Benelux
Description:
📍ZURU is on a mission to disrupt industries, challenge the status quo, and catalyze change through radical innovation and advances in automation. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; and ZURU Edge is pioneering new-generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.

📍 Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5,000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.

About Zuru Edge 🚀

ZURU Edge is the FMCG arm of ZURU Group - a founder-led, vertically integrated business that designs, manufactures and sells its own consumer brands. We do not acquire heritage brands and manage their decline; we build new ones and put them into retail at a speed most consumer goods companies cannot match. Rascals, Millie Moon, Monday Haircare, Daise, Gumi Yum Surprise and Bonkers all compete in categories where execution and pace decide the winner.

📊 Your Role

This is a commercial role with an analytical core. You will start as the person who understands the numbers behind the business - sell-in, sell-out, distribution, promotional performance, forecast - and you will move steadily towards owning customer relationships and the revenue that comes with them.

This is deliberately not a back-office analyst role. If you want to build a career in data or finance, this is the wrong job. If you want to be a Key Account Manager and understand that the best ones are the ones who know their numbers cold, this is a good place to start.

You will work in close and cross-functional collaboration with our global teams.

In this role, you will directly report to the Head of Sales Benelux and Nordics.

📌 Core Roles And Responsibilities


Territory analytics & insight (≈50%)
Own weekly and monthly sell-in and sell-out reporting for the territory — by market, customer, brand and SKU — and be able to explain why every meaningful movement happened.
Track retail sell-through, distribution (stores ranged, TDPs), in-stock rates and units-per-store velocity across retail and distributor partners; flag stock and availability risks before they turn into lost sales or returns.
Build and maintain the promotional calendar, and run post-promotion evaluations: what the uplift was, what it cost, and whether we would do it again.
Support the monthly demand forecast and the regional P&L review — variance to budget, forecast accuracy, and the mix and margin drivers behind the result.
Turn analysis into customer-ready material: category stories, range review arguments, and the fact base behind a listing proposal.
Commercial execution & account ownership (≈30%)
Own a defined set of smaller retail accounts and distributor partners — order flow, range, pricing within agreed guardrails, promotional plan and quarterly business reviews. This starts in your first year, not at the end of it.
Support the sales team on the region's largest customers: prepare the negotiation fact base, build the range and promotional proposal, join the meetings, and follow up on what was agreed.
Prepare for and take part in customer meetings, category and range reviews, and joint business planning.
Drive new listings and distribution gains — in under-developed markets, in growing channels, and for brands not yet ranged with an existing customer.
Work with Brand and Marketing on launch plans, in-store activation and sampling, and make sure product is on shelf when the campaign goes live.
Sales operations & coordination (≈20%)
Own customer masterdata, pricing and article set-up for the territory.
Coordinate with Supply Chain and Customer Service on the order book, allocations, delivery windows and open orders.
Manage new line forms, retailer portals and listing documentation across Benelux and Nordics.
Track trade spend and rebates for the territory together with Finance.


💡 Skills & Experience Required


Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
1-2 years experience as a sales or category analyst ideally within FMCG.
Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced: PivotTables, XLOOKUP, modelling) and ability to build clean, insight-led slides in PowerPoint. Experience in Power BI is a plus.
Attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple data streams and deadlines simultaneously.
Confident communicator who can distil complex data into clear, concise insights for non-analytical audiences.
Structured and analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to travel within Europe as needed.


⭐ What We Offer


Competitive salary.
Regions with room to grow. You will not be maintaining someone else's account base. There is measurable whitespace across eight markets and help closing it will be visibly your work.
Unusual breadth, early. Direct exposure to senior commercial leadership, and visibility across analytics, negotiation, brand and supply chain in one role.
Brands people notice. A portfolio in fast-moving categories, launched and scaled at a pace few FMCG businesses can match


LIFE@ZURU

At ZURU, we have cultivated a high-performing culture that encourages excellence. Our team works towards ambitious goals, learning, performing, and improving together, all while having fun. We empower talented individuals to do their best work every day.

At ZURU, you get out what you put in. You are responsible for driving your own career and we provide the platform to achieve it. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, there are opportunities here that you won’t find anywhere else.

We recognise that ZURU’s success stems from our people and you can only be at your best when you are looking after yourself. ZURU encourages all our team members to invest in their wellbeing by providing an array of benefits and tools.

🌱 Culture for Growth – a high-performance environment with opportunities to stretch and succeed

🌎 Global Opportunities – work with colleagues and partners across Europe, Asia and the US

💡 A-Player Team – collaborate with some of the best talent in the industry

⚡ ZURU – Tomorrow Reimagined
