Title: Procurement Analyst
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Vil du kombinere indkøb, dataanalyse og forretningsoptimering i en global industrivirksomhed?

Hos Johnson Controls søger vi en analytisk stærk indkøber, der kan omsætte data til konkrete forbedringer på tværs af vores supply chain. Du får en central rolle mellem indkøb, produktion, planlægning samt Master Data teamet, hvor du bidrager til både den daglige drift og datadrevne beslutninger.

Du bliver en del af en global virksomhed, som udvikler og producerer energieffektive køle- og varmepumpeløsninger til industrien og dermed understøtter den grønne omstilling. Du vil som procurement analyst primært supportere vores lokale fabrik i Højbjerg, Århus.

Dine opgaver


Analyse af indkøbs-, lager- og leverandørdata
Vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af masterdata i SAP
Identificering af optimeringsmuligheder inden for lagerstyring, forecast og lead times (PFEP-koncept)
Support af forretningen med analyser og beslutningsgrundlag
Deltagelse i proces- og systemforbedringer på tværs af supply chain
Udarbejdelse af KPI'er, rapporter og dashboards
Indkøb af varer og ydelser til lokal produktion
Leverandøropfølgning og analyse af performance


Hvem er du

Du har erfaring inden for indkøb, supply chain eller dataanalyse og motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og indsigt.

Vi Ser Gerne, At Du Har


Erfaring med SAP inden for indkøb, lager eller produktion, PTP
Erfaring og arbejde med LEAN processer
Stærke analytiske kompetencer og erfaring med rapportering
Avancerede Excel-kompetencer og gerne erfaring med Power BI
Forståelse for supply chain-processer og masterdata
Kommerciel forståelse og evnen til at omsætte data til handling
Gode kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SAP S/4HANA, LEAN, forecast- og lageroptimering eller SQL.

Som person

Du er struktureret, nysgerrig og datadrevet. Du trives med at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen, tager initiativ og formår at omsætte komplekse analyser til praktiske løsninger.

Hvad tilbyder vi


En nøglerolle med stor indflydelse på forbedringer i supply chain
Mulighed for at kombinere dataanalyse, indkøb og procesoptimering
Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger
Gode udviklingsmuligheder i en global organisation
Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår, sundhedsforsikring og pensionsordning
Mulighed for at bidrage til den grønne omstilling

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi opfordrer derfor til, at du søger hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.

We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.




Overview :




The Data Analyst will be responsible for analysing data, developing insightful dashboards, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making.




Key Responsibilities & Skills

Report Design & Delivery

Advanced experience translating stakeholder requirements into intuitive, accessible dashboards and reports that enable self-service data exploration.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, DAX and Excel to develop data models and create efficient, optimised and scalable reports and visualisations.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Firm

 

Established in 2020, KP Law (previously Keller Postman) is a specialist litigation boutique, focussing on collective redress.   

 

The firm has over 100 employees across offices in London, Manchester, Birmingham, and Liverpool, representing over 250,000 individual clients across a range of cases in areas such as product liability, competition, worker rights, data breach and privacy and financial services. 

 

Our ethos is to combine the best legal talent with a strong operational and technological platform to enable its clients to pursue cases that could not otherwise be brought against large corporates as a result of their wrongdoing. 

 

Uniquely, KP Law is owned and fully financed by a recognised UK litigation funder (Legatus Holdings), this allows us to take on larger, headline making cases with greater efficiency and confidence.  All of our cases are for claimants and carried out under contingent fee agreements at no cost or risk to its clients.

 

KP Law was ranked Tier 1 for Group Litigation: Claimant in The Legal 500 UK Guide 2026, and Band 2 for Group Litigation: Claimant in Chambers and Partners 2026.

 

The Role

 

Role Summary

As a Data Analyst you will play a pivotal role in providing valuable insights and analysis to internal and external customers. Working in a small team, you will collaborate with Legal teams, data engineers and developers to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organisation.  By delivering high quality analytical solutions across reporting solutions such as Power BI, the Data Analyst enables teams to make informed decisions, identify performance drivers, and continuously improve operational outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Reporting & Data Visualisation

Design, build, and maintain reports and dashboards that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
Apply data visualisation best practices to effectively communicate findings to varied audiences
Automate routine and recurring reports to improve efficiency and consistency.

Data Analysis & Insight

Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities aligned to business objectives
Provide analytical support to inform key business initiatives and decision making
Generate meaningful insights to support both operational and strategic outcomes

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with business teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Provide guidance and training to end‑users on accessing, interpreting, and leveraging reports and dashboards effectively.
Present insights and recommendations that influence operational and strategic decision‑making.

Data Quality, Governance & Integrity

Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across all reports and analytical outputs
Carry out regular data cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities
Support the implementation and adherence to data governance policies and standards




Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

Document methodologies, processes, and outputs to promote transparency, repeatability, and knowledge sharing




Continuous Improvement

Monitor the performance of existing reports and dashboards, implementing improvements where needed.
Contribute to the development of reporting standards, documentation, data definitions, and governance practices.

 

 

Essential Skills & Experience:

·Degree in a STEM subject or experience in data analysis or business intelligence.

·Proficiency in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and visualisation best practices.

·Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.

·Solid SQL skills for querying and preparing data.

·Experience working with stakeholders to understand needs and present findings.

·High attention to detail and strong data quality mindset.


 

Desirable Skills & Attributes:

·Experience working with Databricks for data transformation or analytics workflows.

·Experience developing Salesforce reports and dashboards.

·Foundational knowledge of Python for data manipulation, automation, or analysis.

·Experience with cloud data environments such as Azure or AWS.

·Familiarity with ETL tools, or similar data‑integration technologies.

·Understanding of data modelling concepts.

·Familiarity with legal industry data and metrics.


 

Equal Opportunities

Our approach to our people is underpinned by our commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion and well-being. Our ambition is to build a richly diverse workforce made up of the best talent in our industry. With a workplace that is supportive and inclusive, recognises and nurtures talent, and has a strong sense of community between colleagues.

 

This means that everyone who either applies to or works for KP Law is treated equally, regardless of their gender, age, ethnic origin, nationality, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, or religious beliefs.

 

 

Our Values

At KP Law, we pride ourselves on being a values-led law firm.


Excellence in Everything

Together We Achieve More

There’s Always a Way


 

Our Benefits

We strive to offer a rounded benefits package, that employees value, no matter what stage of their career they are in. Current benefits include:

Annual discretionary bonus scheme
Company contributory pension scheme
Hybrid working
Life assurance
Cash-back healthcare scheme
Enhanced family friendly polices
Employee Assistance Programme
Subsidised gym membership
Cycle to Work scheme
Staff referral scheme

Title: Senior Data Analyst – Central London (Hybrid) - £60,000
Description:
Senior Data Analyst – Central London (Hybrid) - £60,000




Python/Tableau/Snowflake/Dbt/SQL | 3dpw on-site | Bonus Scheme | Private Medical | Growth Opportunity




Ada Meher is proud to be engaged on a search for a Senior Data Analyst on behalf of a rapidly-scaling SaaS business as they continue to grow the team following continued client success. You’d be working alongside Senior Analytics Engineers & Data Engineers, working on client requirements, SaaS platforms and dashboards using Tableau, Snowflake, SQL & dbt. You’d be largely hands on in focus, directed by client requirements working with complex Financial and Property Management data.




The client delivers robust, reliable technology-driven transformations for enterprise-scale clients but does so with a well-worked process to ensure they don't create internal burn-out or compromise quality for speed. They are looking for a candidate working with modern technologies such as Tableau, Snowflake, Data Build Tool (DBT) & SQL to create dashboards that report actionable insights for their clients.




As part of their commitment to work/life balance, the company work on a hybrid basis with employees spending 2-3 days a week in office and the rest working remotely. They also offer a very flexible environment – as long as clients’ needs are met it's up to you to manage your workload the way that works best for you!




As a Senior Data Analyst you would work closely with the technical and client teams, to ensure dashboards and visualisation briefs are delivered successfully. The ideal candidate should have experience in data visualisation technology, such as Tableau, as well as strong SQL and Snowflake knowledge but most importantly a great attitude and drive to succeed.




To be considered:

Strong experience in a Data or BI Analyst role with Python
Considerable experience working with Tableau, SQL and Snowflake
Exposure to dbt
Experience with Azure and related tooling (Eg Azure Data Factory)
Experience creating complex queries




Our client offers various opportunities to learn and develop whether through professional qualifications, exposure to business projects or informal lunch and learns, hosted by your colleagues. It is the ideal opportunity for a candidate seeking progression and growth in the workplace.




The company in question is highly regarded not only in the solutions they provide their clients but the working environment they create with many fantastic perks such as 25 days leave, annual away days and performance related bonuses, flexible working days and remote working days. They offer a competitive salary and have great workplace pension and private healthcare scheme.




This role is attracting a high volume of applicants so be sure to get into contact ASAP to avoid missing out on this opportunity. Please send a CV in confidence to matthew.coney@adameher.com.

Title: Audience Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience
Full time; 40 hours per week
Permanent position
Based in: Covent Garden, London.


The Royal Ballet and Opera, situated in our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.

The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.

We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.

The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate


Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.


An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have


Experience with ticketing or CRM data
Experience working across multiple data sets
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.

Title: Data Analyst (Power BI)
Description:
About The Role...

Are you an experienced Data Analyst with strong Power BI skills?

Do you want to play a key role in fueling our ambition to become the number one mid-market tech and data-led accountancy firm, redefining technology standards across our industry?

About The Team…

Cooper Parry's growth is booming, and we're looking for a new Data Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how data is used across the business, delivering meaningful insights that support strategic decision-making and enhance our customer value proposition.

About The Day To Day…

As a Data Analyst, you'll work closely with stakeholders across the business, helping teams understand their data, identify opportunities, and make informed decisions. You'll combine analytical thinking with Power BI development expertise to transform data into actionable insights.

You'll be getting stuck into a diverse range of tasks and responsibilities, including;


Developing, maintaining and enhancing Power BI dashboards
Working closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, business objectives and key performance indicators.
Analysing data to identify trends, opportunities, risks and actionable insights.
Translating complex datasets into clear, engaging and easy-to-understand visualisations and reporting.
Supporting data-driven decision making across operational, commercial and strategic initiatives.
Extracting, transforming and validating data from multiple sources.
Optimising data models, Power Query transformations and reporting performance.
Ensuring data accuracy, consistency and adherence to reporting standards.
Presenting findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Supporting the development of a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in reporting.


If you're passionate about turning data into meaningful business outcomes and enjoy working with stakeholders to solve real business challenges, this could be the role for you.

About You...

At Cooper Parry, we’re in it together. All we ask of our people is that they play all in. You’ll continuously strive to keep learning – whether you’re a trainee or a Partner – and you’ll be brave, stepping out of your comfort zone to tackle new challenges. Above all, be nice. A simple notion, but an irreplaceable part of what makes CP, CP.

In addition to those core values, as a Data Analyst you should;


At least 2 years of proven experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Reporting Analyst or similar analytics-focused role.
Strong Power BI development experience, including data modelling, DAX, Power Query and report design.
Experience working with integrating data from multiple systems.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Understanding of ETL processes and data transformation techniques.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, data warehousing technologies, or similar modern data platforms.
Strong understanding of data visualisation principles and best practices.
Ability to analyse complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and compelling way.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outputs.


The Following Skills And Experience Would Be Advantageous


Experience within a professional services, financial services or accountancy environment.
Experience building semantic models and supporting self-service reporting initiatives.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality and reporting standards.
Experience using Salesforce.


About Us...

We’ve been dubbed ‘the rebels of accountancy’. We’re straight-talking. Never afraid to share our opinions. We put people and relationships before products and services, and deliver a streamlined, client-focused service – free from unnecessary red tape.

Check Out Our Recent Achievements


Best Companies’ No.1 Accountancy Firm & No.30 Best Large Company to Work For in the UK
Became B Corp Certified in 2023 and we’re still the UK’s largest accountancy B Corp, measuring and improving our impact beyond business for a brighter tomorrow
Achieved 5 awards at the Inspiring Workplace Awards in 2025: winner in the Large Business category and best in class for inspiring People & Culture, Wellbeing, Inclusion and Employee Experience


What's in it for you?

Our people are the beating heart of our culture. We know that if you love working here, and you’re given the trust and autonomy to work in a way that best suits you, you’ll produce amazing results.

That’s Why We Offer Things Like


A flexible approach to work - balancing working from home, in office or with clients
A generous holiday entitlement
An enhanced parental leave policy
An enhanced pension scheme
No dress code – just “wear something!”
A multi-award-winning wellbeing offering to support your physical, mental, spiritual, and financial health
Volunteering opportunities to work closer with local communities and charities
Cooper Parry social/sports clubs


Feeling supported and welcomed is such a big part of bringing your whole self to work. As an equal opportunities employer, we’ll work with you to ensure you have everything you need to develop your skills and achieve your best.

Get in touch if you have any questions about our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion or about accessibility/accommodations during your application process.

For the attention of agencies - unsolicited CVs will not be honoured. We will only accept CV submissions for roles briefed to you by our Talent Acquisition team.

Description:
Help transform the future of British Army training through the power of data.

We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can turn data into decisions, working closely with stakeholders to solve meaningful business and operational challenges. Technical skills matter, but we're equally interested in how you think, collaborate and communicate insights. We're particularly interested in candidates who enjoy engaging with stakeholders, understanding operational challenges and using data to influence decisions and outcomes.

Job Title

Senior Data Analyst (Army Collective Training)

Job Description

🕒 Permanent role - 37.5 hours a week

📍 Hybrid role with 2 or 3 days a week in Warminster

🔐 Due to the nature of this role, you must be eligible for UK Security Clearance at BPSS level.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work directly with stakeholders to understand challenges, ask the right questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
Analyse training, safety and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and actionable insights.
Develop dashboards, reports and visualisations that support effective decision-making.
Turn data into compelling stories that help leaders understand performance and make evidence-based decisions.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, standardisation and improved reporting.
Present findings confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams while retaining the freedom to investigate issues in depth.
Operate confidently in environments where requirements evolve and answers are not always obvious.
Champion evidence-based decision-making and continuous improvement across the organisation.


What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who:


Is naturally curious and enjoys understanding how people, processes and organisations work.
Has experience working with complex, large-scale data in operational or mission-critical environments.
Wants to understand the story behind the numbers, not just the metrics themselves.
Has experience using data and analytics to solve genuine business or operational problems.
Can build trusted relationships with stakeholders and communicate complex ideas simply.
Is comfortable working independently, taking ownership and navigating ambiguity.
Enjoys collaborating with others and contributing to a supportive, high-performing team.
Can move comfortably between stakeholder conversations and detailed analytical investigation.
Is motivated by helping people make better decisions through evidence and insight.
Can confidently explain findings in plain English whilst being able to defend the analysis behind them.


Essential Skills/Experience/Qualifications


Strong practical experience in data analysis, business intelligence or advanced analytics.
Experience using Power BI, Excel and modern analytical tools to create meaningful insight products.
Good understanding of data modelling, databases and data quality principles.
A track record of translating data into actionable recommendations and measurable outcomes


Desirable Skills/Experience/Qualifications


Knowledge and experience of collective training
Knowledge of the military/Army


About ACTS (Army Collective Training Service)

The OMNIA® Training consortium brings together five leading UK defence training organisations: Capita, Raytheon, Rheinmetall, Cervus and Skyral. As the British Army’s Strategic Training Partner (STP), OMNIA has a clear mission: to transform collective training over the next 15 years and deliver world-class training for the British Army.

Working with the Land Warfare Centre (LWC), OMNIA will schedule, plan, design, deliver and assure collective training across the Army’s Collective Training System (ACTS), while also delivering the Collective Training Transformation Programme (CTTP). This generational opportunity will enable more relevant, challenging and safe training, helping the British Army to fight and win. Central to this mission is the ability to set and measure training performance against requirements, assure operational readiness, and capture associated training and safety risks.

Salary up to £50,000 depending on skills and experience
Enjoy flexible benefits including extra leave purchase, paid volunteering days, enhanced family leave, lifestyle discounts, and access to inclusive employee networks — all designed to support your wellbeing and personal growth.
Onsite, secure parking
Rewarding role making a real difference to those joining and progressing within the British Army
Flexible working

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About You.

Are you an experienced Data Analyst?
Are you a self-starter with an analytical mindset, focussed on getting teams what they need to get the work done?
Does the idea of joining a company who are undergoing a genuinely exciting period of change and growth appeal?




About The Role.

We're looking for an experienced Data Analyst to join us. Working within our Data Analytics team, you will play a crucial role, providing actionable insights to guide strategic decisions and operational processes. You will work autonomously to interrogate data, write / fix codes, create dashboard as well as further progress automation and timely insights.




What You'll Do.

Leverage knowledge of data structures to prepare data for analysis, assembling information from disparate data sources for the creation of insights
Optimise processes to ensure metrics, reports and insights are delivered consistently to stakeholders with minimal manual intervention
Apply coding best practices and sound techniques to ensure efficient execution of code against large datasets, ensuring code is repeatable and scalable
Maintain and govern codes for analytical outputs using GitHub
Dive into anomalies in trends and collaborate with key stakeholders to pinpoint root causes to drive change
Communicate impact and importance of findings on the business and recommend appropriate course of action
Ensure data quality and governance practices are upheld, particularly in transformed data environments
Present findings and recommendations clearly and confidently to across the business
Apply coding best practices and sound techniques to ensure efficient execution of code against large datasets, ensuring code is repeatable and scalable
Contribute to and maintain clear documentation and metric definitions to support team knowledge-sharing and onboarding




Your Background and Experience

You're a self-starter with a strong understanding of databases and data governance principles. You'll have experience in the full data lifecycle of collecting, cleansing, analysing, communicating and presenting actionable insights.




You're able to carry out data extraction, manipulation, and visualisation from large datasets , can communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and have strong problem-solving skills and excellent attention to detail.




Experience of using SQL, MS Excel / Google Sheets, and Power BI / Looker Studio.




When an issue arises, you get involved and use your initiative to prioritise your work effectively under pressure and you have the ability to take a step back and analyse/understand the issue to ensure the correct next step is taken.

About Billing Finance

We are a privately-run family owned vehicle financing Company based on the outskirts of Northampton. We focus on customers with non-standard credit profiles that may not fit the automated underwriting processes of other lenders. Our mission is to help get all our people, including customers and staff “where they need to be” by “putting them at the heart of everything we do”. We are entering an exciting phase of transformation and as a small company, this role will offer the successful candidate the opportunity to work across the whole customer journey cycle, and to directly see the impacts that they made.

Our values are:

We are responsible – We are conscious of our impact on people and planet
We care about you – We are kind and compassionate with our customers and with each other
We work with you – We support financial wellbeing for our customers and the wider community




The successful candidate will not only have a successful and fulfilling career with us but will also receive a fantastic range of benefits:




Discretionary bonus scheme
Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme
Pension salary sacrifice scheme
Private Medical
Income Protection
Hybrid working
Employee Assistance Programme
Annual £200 personal growth fund
Paid volunteering days

Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Billing Finance we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate.




The Recruitment Process and How We Will Use Your Data

The recruitment process will involve obtaining information and/or exchanging it with the following organisations to assist with our pre-employment checks prior to interview.




Credit Reference Agencies – to complete a soft credit check to understand your financial history
CIFAS – to check both National and Internal databases for fraudulent activity. The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found here https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn.




To complete these checks, you will be asked to provide your address history for the past six years, along with your full name and date of birth.

The successful candidate will be required to undergo a Basic DBS check to comply with our FCA compliance framework. A satisfactory Basic Disclosure showing no unspent convictions is a prerequisite for this position.




We may also ask for proof of your right to work status or evidence of any qualification or experience prior to being offered employment. Further information on how we collect and use your data during the recruitment process can be found in our Privacy Policy here https://billingfinance.co.uk/privacy-policy/




Billing Finance is an equal opportunities employer, and we understand that for some candidates to perform their best they may need some reasonable adjustments. If we can make your application journey with us more suitable for you, please do let us know and we will endeavour to help.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

This role will work closely with stakeholders across the bank to deliver data-driven insights, support strategic decision-making, and help drive the organisation's cloud-based data transformation initiatives.

Strong Python programming skills for data analysis and automation.
Experience with business intelligence and visualisation tools, including:
Looker

Excellent SQL and data modelling expertise.
Strong stakeholder engagement and business analysis skills.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise environments

Title: Data Analyst

Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

⭐ Why So Energy?

So Energy was created in 2015 because we knew energy suppliers could be better. Since then, we’ve grown rapidly but sustainably, with 300,000 customers and over 450 Energists (what we call our people). But we’re not done! We’re on the road to a net-zero future, and thanks to our partnership with ESB, we’re well on the way. We’re customer-centric, tech-led, and passionate about sustainability.

We’re driven to do our best for our customers, for each other, and for our planet. That’s why we’ve built a workplace culture that’s supportive, empowering, inclusive, and full of opportunities to grow and make an impact.

At So Energy, we take pride in our values-driven culture. We live and breathe by our six core values that guide everything we do:


Clear
Honest
Ambitious
Inquisitive
Caring
Sustainable

Line manage 2 direct reports (mid/junior Analysts), working collaboratively with the Data Team Lead.
Utilize advanced SQL skills to extract, clean, and analyse complex datasets, providing meaningful insights.
Lead data-driven projects, from defining objectives and methodologies to presenting findings and recommendations.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, develop analytical solutions, and drive data-driven decision-making.
Design and document curated Data Warehouse tables to be handed to our Data Engineering team for implementation.
Define metrics that are suited to business monitoring at various levels.
Create clear and compelling data visualizations and reports to communicate insights to stakeholders at all levels.
Support the business in ad-hoc data analysis and data supply covering auditing, marketing campaigns and customer segmentation.

Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analysis and data science.
Contribute as part of an agile team with sprint planning sessions and daily stand ups.
Communicate status, blockers, and progress in a clear and concise manner.


You’re a great match if:


You have a Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering) or equivalent work experience; Master's degree preferred.

Data Warehouse design experience using industry methodologies will be highly favourable.

Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI)
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work with large, messy datasets to extract valuable insights.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to drive projects from inception to completion.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities with a keen attention to detail.
A proactive and collaborative attitude, with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

Hybrid Working – Every team has its own SPARK Working Charter. Ask your Talent Partner for more details.

Educational Sponsorships – Supporting professional development through initiatives such as Code First Girls.

Up to 10% Performance Bonus – Based on both company and personal performance.
Annual Salary Reviews – Helping ensure we remain competitive in the market.
Real Living Wage Employer – Proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer.


Time Off That Matters


Your Birthday Off – Because birthdays should be celebrated.
Three So Giving Days – Paid time to support a cause that's important to you.
Enhanced Family Leave – Supporting you through every stage of family life.


Health & Wellbeing


Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – Confidential support available 24/7, 365 days a year, including access to professional guidance and structured counselling support.

Inclusion isn’t just an initiative at So Energy. We strive to embed it throughout our entire culture.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

The Data Analyst will support different departments by transforming raw information into clear reports, useful insights and practical recommendations.

The role will involve working with business data from multiple sources, checking its accuracy and identifying trends, patterns and potential areas for improvement. The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of reporting processes and dashboards used by management and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities Include


Collecting and consolidating data from internal systems and business sources.
Reviewing datasets to identify inconsistencies, missing information and data quality issues.
Preparing recurring reports and performance summaries for internal stakeholders.
Analysing operational, commercial and customer-related data.
Identifying trends, patterns and potential areas for business improvement.
Supporting the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools.
Tracking key performance indicators and highlighting significant variations.
Working with different departments to understand reporting requirements.
Documenting data sources, reporting processes and analytical methodologies.
Presenting findings and recommendations in a clear and accessible format.


The position is suited to a structured and curious professional who enjoys working with numbers and solving business problems through data. The successful candidate should be able to manage several analytical tasks while communicating findings effectively to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Requirements


Previous experience in data analysis, business reporting, operations analysis or a related area is preferred
Strong numerical reasoning and ability to identify relevant information within large datasets
Good knowledge of Excel, including formulas, pivot tables and data validation
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases is considered an advantage
Experience with reporting or visualisation platforms such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker is desirable
Ability to clean, organise and structure data from different sources
Good understanding of business KPIs and performance reporting
Ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Ability to manage deadlines and work on multiple projects
A degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business, Computer Science or a related discipline is desirable
Excellent written and spoken English

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst


Bristol | Hybrid | Up to £35,000

We're working with an established organisation in Bristol that is looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join their growing data team.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their data career with a strong foundation in SQL, who wants to develop their experience across data retrieval, data modelling, Power BI and business reporting.

The Role


You'll work with business data to produce accurate, reliable reporting and analysis. A key part of the role will be using SQL to retrieve, manipulate and model data from relational databases, ensuring data is structured correctly and ready for reporting and analysis.

You'll also work closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements and translate these into practical data solutions, including Power BI reports and dashboards.

Key Responsibilities






Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate and analyse data from relational databases.




Build and maintain data models to support reporting and analytics.




Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, using DAX where required.




Work with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements.




Validate, cleanse and reconcile data to ensure accuracy and consistency.




Investigate data issues and resolve reporting discrepancies.




Test reports and datasets against source data.




Maintain documentation around data sources, definitions and transformations.




Support wider data quality, governance and reporting initiatives.


What We're Looking For


The key requirement is strong SQL knowledge and an understanding of how data is structured and modelled.

You'll ideally have:






Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregation, subqueries and data manipulation.




An understanding of relational databases and data modelling.




Some practical experience with Power BI, including reports and dashboards.




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.




Good communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.




A curious and proactive approach to learning and developing your technical skills.


This will be a 2 stage interview process and for the right candidate my client can interview next week!


If you're interested in this role, or know someone who would be, then please apply to this advert and reach out to a. methula@ioassociates.co.uk

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

About The Role

Join our dynamic Ecommerce team at Matalan as an Ecommerce Data Analyst! In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in driving our online success by leveraging your technical expertise in data collection, tracking and analysis. You will transform complex web data into clear, compelling stories with actionable recommendations that directly influence business decisions.

A vital role within the Analytics and Ecommerce teams, you will deliver critical web data insights to the Ecommerce team. This involves transforming business questions into analytical problems, analysing intricate datasets, and presenting concise, persuasive, and actionable insights that drive informed decisions and optimize online performance.

Key Responsibilities -


Delivery of actionable insight: utilise a variety of analytical techniques to deliver valuable actionable insight that address diverse business challenges
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Comfortable building strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their analytical needs, identify challenges, opportunities and contribute to their strategic roadmaps
Commercial Impact Analysis: Able to evaluate the commercial viability of insights, quantify the impact of data driven decisions and prioritise future work that maximise value delivery.
Analytical Tool and Process Development: Develop and implement tools, reports, and processes that enhance the analytical capabilities of the team and wider business, with a focus on data democratisation and self serve analytics for the key teams.
Insight Democratisation: Create and maintain automated BI that promote data awareness and enhance the business knowledge of our online performance and customer behaviours.
Active member of the Analytics team: Sharing insight, analytical process and underlying data changes in the ecomm area with the wider analytics and data science team as part of our regular knowledge sharing.


About You


Educated to a degree level or with demonstrable relevant experience
Extensive experience of at least 4 years working with BigQuery is essential including a solid understanding of SQL coding
Strong Experience of Google analytics (GA4).
Extensive Experience of visualisation software essential (e.g. Power BI/ Looker).
Understanding of analysis methodologies essential (statistical techniques a plus). 
Awareness of ETL processes and database automation.
Experience working with AI tools to generate automated insights advantageous
Confident in Microsoft Excel and full Microsoft Suite. (Or cloud based equivalents)


Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we also offer the below core benefits:


20% staff discount, which increases with length of service
Thrive Recognition Scheme
Wellbeing support provided by the Retail Trust
Life Assurance
Retail Rewards platform offering discounts for other retailers
Pension Scheme
Access to a wide range of career development
Additional benefits may apply depending on your role and area of the business

Draw actionable insights from multiple, large sources of data and communicate these effectively through reports, dashboards and presentations.

Apply tools and techniques for data analysis and visualisation using business intelligence tools.

Promote Hippo’s Herd internally and externally through blogs, case studies, and workshops.

Mentoring and coaching skills with a passion for up-skilling junior analysts.

Experience with automated data pipeline tools (e.g., dbt, Airflow).

Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Up to 90K/Remote

The Overview

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst to join a fast-growing digital business where data plays a central role in shaping commercial, product, and customer decisions. You'll have the chance to influence business strategy, build impactful self-serve analytics solutions, and work on high-visibility projects that directly support growth.

The Company

They are a high-growth consumer-focused business that places data at the heart of decision-making. With a modern data stack and a strong commitment to analytical innovation, they are continuing to invest in their analytics capability as they scale. The business promotes a collaborative culture where insights drive meaningful action and where analysts are empowered to make a measurable impact. This is an environment where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

The Role

You will:

Partner with stakeholders across Product, Commercial, Growth, and other business functions to solve complex business challenges through data.
Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, actionable insights, and clear recommendations.
Develop and enhance BI reporting, dashboards, and self-serve analytics capabilities.
Build scalable reporting solutions that improve data accessibility and support confident decision-making.
Deliver customer, product, and commercial analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and risks.
Support experimentation initiatives, including A/B testing analysis and performance measurement.
Communicate insights effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Contribute to raising analytical standards and improving data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

Your Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience in data analytics within a fast-paced environment.
Advanced SQL skills and a proven ability to solve complex analytical problems.
Experience developing BI reporting, dashboards, and self-serve analytics solutions.
Strong experience with Looker, Omni, or similar modern BI platforms.
Understanding of experimentation methodologies and A/B testing analysis.
Experience translating stakeholder requirements into scalable analytical outputs.
Exposure to dbt or analytics engineering principles is beneficial.
Python experience is advantageous but not essential.
Excellent stakeholder management and data storytelling skills.
Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a dynamic, evolving environment.

What They Offer

Salary up to £90,000.
Remote-first working across the UK.
Private healthcare package.
Income protection benefits.
Flexible working arrangements.
Enhanced holiday entitlement linked to tenure.
Home office support.
Access to employee discount and salary sacrifice schemes.
Clear progression opportunities into leadership and broader strategic analytics roles.
Exposure to innovative analytics projects, including customer intelligence, experimentation, and advanced analytics initiatives.

How to Apply

If you're a commercially minded Senior Data Analyst looking to make a significant impact in a growing, data-driven business, apply today to learn more about this opportunity.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Analyst reporting into the Head of Data in our Nottingham office. You will manage the delivery of high-quality data solutions that support client, operational, and business objectives. Working within the Data Delivery team, you will combine technical capability with stakeholder engagement to ensure data products are delivered accurately, efficiently.

You can analyse, transform, and validate complex datasets using SQL or SAS, while identifying opportunities to improve processes, mitigate risks, and enhance existing data products. Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other modern data tooling would be advantageous.

As a key member of the team, the Data Analyst acts as a trusted partner to stakeholders. You will translate business requirements into data solutions, managing delivery expectations, and ensuring a high standard of customer service throughout the delivery lifecycle.

You will also play an important part in developing team capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of junior analysts.

Key Responsibilities


You will build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, developing a clear understanding of their business requirements and objectives.
Translate stakeholder requirements into effective data deliverables and solutions.
Manage client expectations and proactively address queries, issues, and risks.
Deliver excellent customer outcomes by ensuring solutions are accurate, valuable, and fit for purpose.


Data Delivery & Analysis


Own and deliver data extracts, reports, and analytical outputs to agreed quality, scope, and timelines.
Use SQL, SAS, and other analytical tools to interrogate, manipulate, and validate complex datasets.
Apply robust validation and quality assurance processes to all deliverables.
Investigate data-related issues and client queries, conducting root cause analysis and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support the delivery of proof-of-concepts, new products, and data-driven solutions.


Operational Excellence


Plan, prioritise, and manage workload across multiple deliveries and projects.
Provide accurate effort estimates and delivery timescales.
Monitor progress against commitments and escalate risks or issues.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, increase efficiency, and reduce operational risk.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of team practices, documentation, and standards.


Governance, Risk & Compliance


Ensure all deliveries comply with regulatory, contractual, and internal governance requirements.
Maintain awareness of data protection, security, and compliance obligations.
Identify, assess, and help mitigate operational and delivery risks.
Support audit, governance, and control activities where required.


Collaboration & Leadership


Support and coach junior team members, sharing technical expertise and best practice.
Lead or actively contribute to delivery reviews, project discussions, and problem-solving sessions.
Champion knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.


Qualifications


Strong SQL and/or SAS programming skills.
Experience working with complex datasets and data transformation processes.
Strong analytical skills.
You can engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience investigating and resolving data-related issues.


Desirable


Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other data technologies.
Experience delivering data solutions in a client-facing environment.
Knowledge of data governance, quality management, and regulatory requirements.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.
Experience working within project or change delivery environments.


Additional Information

Benefits package includes:


Hybrid working - 40% office based
Great compensation package and uncapped commission
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.


Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
