Title: Enterprise Data Analyst
Description:
About Salary Finance

Working with employers, we provide a financial wellbeing platform as an employee benefit, helping employees to understand their money better, get out of debt faster and save for their future. We already have a reach of over 4,000,000 employees through our relationships with over 600 of the biggest companies in the UK.




By improving employee financial wellbeing, we have a very real and meaningful impact on people’s lives. We remove the stress and worry associated with financial difficulties by dramatically reducing the interest rates employees pay on their personal debt, and provide them with the tools needed to start saving sooner and be more financially secure. We are backed by some of the biggest brands, including investments from Blenheim Chalcot (the UK’s leading venture builder), Legal and General (the FTSE 100 insurer and asset manager), Experian and funding partnerships with JP Morgan and Blue Owl.




Launched in 2015, we have made excellent progress, and are scaling fast. We are named BITC’s Responsible Business of Year 2018, included in KPMG’s Global Fintech 100, listed top of the Forbes' list of socially-responsible startups, and profiled by the Financial Times, the Times, the Wall Street Journal, the Guardian, the Telegraph, CityAM and the Institute of Directors.




Your role in our mission

We are looking for a talented Enterprise Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Hub. Reporting to the Lead Enterprise Data Analyst, you will help translate business questions into trusted data products and Power BI dashboards, supporting Salary Finance's mission to help our customers get out of debt faster and save for their future. You'll work alongside senior analysts, engineers and stakeholders across the business building the datasets, reports, and insights that inform decisions and enable safe growth of our loan book. This is a role where you'll grow your craft, contribute to team standards, and see the impact of your work reach real customers.




What you’ll do

Build High-Impact Dashboarding:

You will liaise with stakeholders of all data literacy levels to develop robust dashboard requirements
You will build, design, develop and maintain best-in-class Power BI dashboards which serve a purpose and deliver value to the business

Drive Operational Efficiency

You will help the automation of manual reporting processes and end-to-end operational workflows, ensuring high uptime and seamless maintenance of production reports.
You will regularly audit existing report performance and SQL scripts to reduce technical debt and improve processing speeds as data demand scales.

Support Data Integrity:

You will follow the team's data governance standards and contribute to documentation across your analytical outputs

Engineer Data Foundations:

You will build optimised scalable data products and robust data marts, creating a structured environment for self-service analytics.
You will collaborate with Enterprise Data Engineers to refine ETL/ELT pipelines, ensuring the upstream data architecture supports downstream analytical requirements.




About you

Essential:

Proven Track Record: At least 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or similar roles, with a demonstrable history of progressing from technical execution to strategic delivery.
SQL Mastery: Advance level proficiency in writing, optimising, and debugging complex queries. You should be comfortable handling large-scale datasets and understanding relational database architecture.
Power BI & DAX Specialist: Advanced command of the Power BI ecosystem. You don't just build reports; you create sophisticated DAX measures and perform complex data modeling to solve intricate business logic.
Strategic Stakeholder Management: A proven ability to act as a bridge between technical data and business needs. You can translate "vague requests" into concrete technical requirements and present findings to executives with confidence.
Insight Delivery & Storytelling: You possess a "so what?" mindset. You have a track record of moving beyond descriptive reporting to deliver predictive insights that drive measurable commercial value.
LLM Literate: You are comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) to accelerate your workflow, whether for logic verification, documentation, or streamlining code development.




Nice to have:

Experience in financial services or a similar regulated industry (e.g., FinTech, banking).
Prompt Engineering for Data: You are well-versed in prompt engineering techniques to optimise data cleaning, generate SQL scripts, or automate metadata documentation.
Python for Analytics: Ability to use Python for data manipulation (Pandas/NumPy), automation scripts, or basic statistical modeling to augment standard BI toolsets.
Data Governance Frameworks: Practical experience establishing data dictionaries, lineage, and quality protocols to ensure a "single source of truth."
Forecasting & Predictive Modeling: Experience building time-series forecasts or predictive models to help the business anticipate trends, demand, or churn.
Technical Mentorship: Experience in peer-reviewing code (SQL/DAX) and coaching junior analysts to uphold high standards of accuracy, performance, and design.




Who you are

While we embrace diverse backgrounds and perspectives, we’re united by a shared mindset. We look for team members who live these values every day:

Take Ownership: We own the entire journey and see outcomes through from start to finish
Dig Deeper :We ask why, investigate root causes, and build solutions that last
Stronger Together :We choose collaboration, share knowledge freely, and lift each other up
Momentum Matters :We act with purpose, remove blockers, and default to action
Make a Lasting Impact :We think long-term, put people before numbers, and change the system for good




What do you get for all your hard work?

Company bonus scheme 💰
25 days holiday with an additional day off for every year of service up to 30 days and an extra day off on your birthday 🎂
Hybrid working arrangements so you can work from the office and from home with a budget to help you get set up 🏠
Generous company benefits to include pension and life assurance and an annual allowance to spend on medical insurance, health cash plan, denplan, gym memberships 🤸
Enhanced policies that are family and pet friendly, to include company sick pay and peternity leave 🐶
Great career development in a fast paced environment 🚀
Volunteer days as part of our CSR program 🤝
Regular company socials & more great perks to include weekly snacks, tuckshop, cycle to work, help to save and much more! 🍭




The typical interview process

Introductory call with our Talent Manager (phone call - 20 mins)
1st Stage: Technical interview (PowerBI exercise) with Hiring Manager and team (video call - 60 mins)
2nd Stage: Past work experience and culture interview with Hiring Manager and team (in person - 60 mins)




We’re looking for people that will get stuck in and make a difference. We have a great collaborative, entrepreneurial team and are passionate about what we do. If you want to join a team that is changing people’s lives for the better then we’d love to hear from you.

Learn more at salaryfinance.com




Salary Finance is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where all employees and applicants can flourish.




If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A brief summary




Based within our global Media Services function, this role sits in the Assets & Data team and reports to the Head of Assets & Data. The Data Analyst helps the business make better use of its data, with a particular focus on S&OP, asset management and resource planning across the Group.




Using SQL, Power BI and Excel, the role will turn data from our Group systems into useful reporting and insight. A key part of the role is helping people understand what the data is telling us how our assets are being used, where demand is changing and where there may be opportunities to improve utilisation, reduce cost or make better investment decisions.




What you’ll be responsible for

Write and maintain SQL queries to bring together and prepare data from Group business systems for analysis and reporting.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that help the business understand asset utilisation, demand, availability and performance.
Analyse asset, resource and demand planning data to spot trends, capacity issues, under utilisation and opportunities to improve efficiency or reduce cost.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and teams across the business to understand the questions they are trying to answer and turn these into useful analysis and reporting.
Check and reconcile data before it is used in reporting, investigate anything that does not look right and work with the relevant data owners to resolve issues.
Support good data governance by helping to keep definitions, standards and quality checks consistent across asset and master data.
Keep clear, practical documentation for key reports, dashboards, calculations and recurring analysis so that others can understand how they work and pick them up when needed.
Work with IT where reporting depends on changes to systems, data access or integrations. The role will help define what the business needs from its data, with IT retaining responsibility for system architecture, security, access controls and technical infrastructure.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and business teams to improve the information held in operational systems, including highlighting gaps, inconsistencies or unclear data ownership.
Provide regular and ad hoc analysis to support S&OP, asset planning, investment decisions, business cases and improvement activity across the Group.
Look for sensible ways to make reporting and analysis quicker and easier, including automation and appropriate use of AI tools, while making sure outputs are checked and company data is handled appropriately.

Requirements

Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience, together with at least two years' experience in a data analyst, BI analyst or similar role.
Strong working knowledge of SQL and confidence using it to query, combine and manipulate data.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with a good understanding of data modelling, measures and how to present information clearly.
Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and working with larger datasets.
Experience of cleaning and checking data, including dealing with duplicates, missing information and inconsistencies.
A good understanding of databases and data structures, with enough technical knowledge to work confidently with IT and system specialists.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills. You should be interested in what sits behind the numbers and able to explain what the data means, rather than simply producing a report.
Able to work with stakeholders to understand what information they need and explain findings clearly to people who may not be data specialists.
Good attention to detail and a practical approach to keeping reports, calculations and supporting documentation organised and up to date.
Commercially aware, with an interest in how asset utilisation, demand, capacity and investment decisions affect the wider business.
Comfortable using AI and other productivity tools where they are useful, while checking outputs and following company requirements around data security.
Able to manage priorities, work well with colleagues across different teams and countries, and respond calmly when something is time sensitive.
The role supports teams across the Group. From time to time, some flexibility may be needed to




General responsibilities

Play an active part in improving how the team and wider business work. Follow Company policies, information security requirements and the processes and controls relevant to the role. This job description covers the main responsibilities of the role but is not exhaustive and may change as the business and team develop.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Legal & General (L&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.



We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.



We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.



This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time, term-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Technical Data Analyst (SQL)
Description:
Job Summary:

The Technical Data Analyst is responsible for maintaining investment data for clients. This role involves tasks such as analyzing and organizing raw data, building data systems and pipelines, conducting complex data analysis, and presenting information through data visualization techniques. Additionally, the analyst collaborates with clients and project management teams to grasp customer and company needs. This role requires the ability to merge data from various sources and present it in alignment with customer/company requirements, while also striving to improve data quality and reliability.




Responsibilities:

Utilize your analytical expertise to decipher and organize raw data, transforming it into valuable insights.
Build efficient and robust data systems and pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow.
Dive into complex data sets, conducting thorough analysis and delivering insightful reports on outcomes.
Showcase your findings using cutting-edge data visualization techniques, making data come to life.
Harness the power of multiple data sources, combining raw information into comprehensive and actionable insights.
Continuously explore innovative methods to improve data quality and reliability, contributing to the highest standards.
Develop and implement analytical tools and programs that empower teams to make data-driven decisions.
Collaborate closely with system architects and product development teams, fostering an environment of innovation and excellence.




Required Skills:

Familiarity with cloud platforms and big data technologies (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Understanding of database design and data warehouse principles.
Strong understanding of investment data, good to have
Knowledge of one or more programming languages (e.g. Java, Python, VBA).
Proficiency in data manipulation and data cleansing techniques.
Knowledge of data governance and best practices in data management.
Continuous improvement mindset for self and team.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment.
Ability to work with large datasets and perform data mining tasks.
Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
Outstanding verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organisational and interpersonal skills.
Exceptional problem-solving abilities.




Education and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, accounting, computer science, or related discipline.
4+ years of relevant experience in data analytics, reporting, and visualization.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases
Experience with data integration and exchange, transfer, load processes.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or D3.js.
Familiarity with dbt/Prophecy good to have, but not essential

BI Analyst

Lithia UK (Hybrid- to be worked at our Head Office in Annesley twice per week)

At Lithia UK, our mission is simple: to modernise personal transportation—whenever, wherever, and however our customers desire. We’re not just keeping up with change—we’re leading it. Whether it’s enhancing the customer journey, transforming operational efficiency, or unlocking new opportunities, data is at the heart of our decisions.

Reporting into the BI Manager, you’ll play a vital role in creating and maintaining reports, dashboards and data visualisations, enabling data-driven decision making and supporting informed strategies.

This is more than just a technical role—it’s a chance to shape the future of data at one of the world’s leading automotive groups. If you're driven by innovation, thrive on solving complex data challenges, and want to be part of a high-impact team —this is your opportunity!

Take the lead in creating and delivering high-quality business intelligence tools that help our teams make smarter, data-driver decisions
Maintain and continuously improve our reporting solutions, ensuring they’re accurate, reliable, and easy for users to navigate
Build clear, insightful reports and dashboards that support decision-making across the business
Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs and deliver information that adds real value
Collaborate with teams across the business to uncover insights and identify opportunities that support our strategic goals
Translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations that make a real difference
Keep our data accurate, consistent, and accessible—ensuring it remains a trusted source of truth
Implement checks, validation processes, and controls to maintain high standards of data quality across everything we do.

Expertise within Power BI and are confident with designing, building and optimising dashboard that bring data to life and help teams make informed decisions
A minimum of 2-3 years experience within Data / BI Analytics
Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract and manipulate data with ease
An analytical mindset and can spot trends, uncover insights and find practical solutions
Great attention to detail, especially regarding reconciliation and ensuring accuracy across reports
A self-starter attitude and is comfortable owning projects from end to end whilst managing their time effectively
Understanding of data modelling and statistical techniques, applying these tools to analyse performance and support strategic decisions
Clear communication skill and presentation skills, ensuring data is presented in a way that’s meaningful, engaging and tailored to different audiences
Strong leadership and project management abilities, whether it’s leading a BI initiative or working across teams you will bring structure and momentum to your work




What we can offer you:

Enjoy 33 days annual leave (including bank holidays), giving you more time to relax, recharge, and do what you love
Celebrate your special day with an extra day off on your birthday
Our industry-leading Family Leave Policies ensure you’re supported when it matters most
Access a new car through our Salary Sacrifice scheme and enjoy a smarter way to drive
Take a paid day to volunteer and give back to a cause close to your heart
We believe in recognising dedication and loyalty, that’s why we celebrate long service milestone anniversaries
Unlock your potential with tailored training and endless career growth opportunities
Commute for less with our cycle to work scheme
Access high street discounts to make the everyday a little more rewarding
Know someone perfect for Lithia UK? Earn rewards through our internal referral scheme

Title: MI Analyst
Description:
As Lockton’s continued investment in Data and MI the appetite for data is only increasing and is highly valued by senior management.As a result, we are looking to recruit the appropriate data individual to join the team.

First and foremost, the right candidate must fit in with Lockton’s culture. At Lockton we value the following principles:

Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement

Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, and translate reporting and analytics requirements.
Extract, transform, analyse, and interpret data from multiple sources to support business decision-making.

Excel

Exposure to version control and collaborative development practices (e.g., Git/GitHub).
Experience working within financial services, insurance, or other highly regulated industries.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About VPZ

VPZ is the UK’s leading specialist vape retailer. Since opening our first store in Edinburgh, we have grown to 200 locations across the UK.




We are continuing to invest in data and analytics so that teams across retail, e-commerce, manufacturing and operations can make faster, better informed decisions.




About the Role

As a Data Analyst, you will turn complex information into clear recommendations that influence commercial and operational decisions across the business.




You will build trusted dashboards, investigate performance trends and work with stakeholders to identify opportunities in areas such as store performance, product ranging, customer behaviour, stock management and campaign effectiveness.




This role would suit an analyst who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with commercial problem-solving and stakeholder communication.




Please note this role requires 5 days on site, here at Head Office in Newbridge, Edinburgh.




What You Will Do

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports in Power BI or a comparable visualisation platform.
Analyse sales and operational performance across more than 190 stores, identifying trends, risks and commercial opportunities.
Evaluate product, category, store and channel performance to support ranging and investment decisions.
Present regular performance updates and clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Analyse customer behaviour, segmentation, retention and marketing campaign effectiveness.
Support demand forecasting, stock analysis and supply-chain optimisation.




What Success Looks Like

During your first six months, you will:

Establish trusted and consistently used performance dashboards
Improve the speed and reliability of recurring reporting
Deliver analysis that leads to measurable commercial or operational action;
Improve visibility of store, product, customer and stock performance;
Strengthen data quality and reduce unnecessary manual processes.




Essential Experience and Skills

You will be a strong match for this role if you have:
At least two years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or comparable analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including the ability to work with joins, aggregations, CTEs and complex datasets.
Advanced Excel skills.
Experience creating dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau or a comparable platform.
The ability to interpret commercial performance and turn analysis into practical recommendations.




Desirable Experience

It would be beneficial, but not essential, if you have:
Experience in retail, e-commerce, FMCG or manufacturing analytics.
Experience extracting data from REST APIs.
Knowledge of MongoDB or another NoSQL database.
Experience using Python or R for analysis, automation or statistical modelling.
Experience in demand forecasting, stock optimisation or customer segmentation.




Please ensure you apply with an up-to-date CV.




Applicants must be 18 years old or above, any subsequent job offer is subject to pre-employment screening and right to work checks.

Title: Senior Data Analyst-(Re)Insurance- SQL, Power BI, Azure technologies
Description:
Introduction

At Gallagher Re, we bring clarity to complexity by helping clients around the world make confident, data-driven decisions in a rapidly evolving risk landscape. Here, you’ll be part of a team that leverages world-class analytics and deep reinsurance expertise to deliver strategic advisory services and transactional excellence. Together, we transform advanced insights and market intelligence into strategies that protect businesses, drive performance, and shape the future of reinsurance. We’re a community of decision makers, future shapers, and trusted experts working side by side to deliver meaningful impact through innovative thinking and practical solutions. At Gallagher Re, your curiosity is welcomed, your growth is championed, and your work truly matters. This is a place where you'll have the freedom to explore new ideas, take ownership of your career, and collaborate with people who are as driven and inquisitive as you are.

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our growing data and analytics team. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with underwriting, operations, claims, and finance stakeholders to deliver actionable insights that support business performance and strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will bring proven experience in the (Re)Insurance market, with hands-on experience working with Bordereaux and Delegated Authority data. You will play a key role in transforming complex data into meaningful analysis, improving data quality, and developing reporting solutions that drive operational efficiency and commercial outcomes. Previoous experience and knowldge of working with Data & Analytics in the insurannce industry is essential to be successful in this role.

We offer flexible/hybrid working and you will be expected in our London City office twice a week.

How You'll Make An Impact


Analyse and interpret large, complex datasets to provide business-critical insights and recommendations.
Work with Delegated Authority and Bordereaux data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations using Power BI.
Write and optimise complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyse data from multiple sources.
Support the development and enhancement of data models, reporting frameworks, and analytical solutions.
Collaborate with underwriting, actuarial, finance, and operational teams to understand business requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.
Work with cloud-based data platforms, including Azure Data Lake, to support modern data architecture and analytics capabilities.
Identify data quality issues and implement controls and improvements to enhance data integrity.
Provide subject matter expertise on (Re)Insurance data structures, reporting requirements, and market best practices.


About You


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or Senior Data Analyst within (Re)Insurance market is essential.
Extensive knowledge of Bordereaux and Delegated Authority business processes and datasets.
Advanced SQL skills with the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimise complex queries.
Hands-on experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI.
Experience working with Azure Data Lake and cloud-based data environments.
Fantastic analytical, problem-solving, and data visualisation skills.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Experience translating business requirements into meaningful analytical solutions.
Experience within the London Market insurance environment.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, or master data management principles.
Exposure to Azure Synapse, Data Factory, or other Azure analytics services.
Understanding of underwriting, claims, exposure management, or reinsurance reporting processes.


Compensation And Benefits

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.


Competitive compensation
Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and artificial intelligence ("AI") company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect.

We are headquartered in New York and have more than 60,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit www.exlservice.com.




Role Title: Data Analyst

BU/Segment: Analytics

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent




Summary of the role:

EXL is looking for a Data Analyst with a passion for sports who will play a key role in providing analytics support to a client within our Sports, Media and Entertainment practice. Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on fan growth, engagement and lifecycle metrics across international markets.
Monitor campaign and go-to-market (GTM) performance using agreed KPIs and success criteria.
Contribute to regular performance updates for team leads and senior stakeholders.




Campaign & Audience Enablement

Prepare audience segments and data for 1:1 marketing campaigns, including test/control groups.
Support segmentation analysis that helps regional teams deepen fan engagement in local markets.




Data Quality & Collaboration

Support user acceptance testing (UAT) of database changes and updates.
Help data engineering teams with root cause analysis (RCA) of data issues and bugs.
Work with marketing, international and data engineering teams to gather and document business requirements.
Liaise with third-party partners on data needs and definitions.




Qualifications and experience we consider to be essential for the role:

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
2–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations and window functions.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy).
Hands-on experience with at least one cloud data platform: Databricks, AWS or Snowflake.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences




Skills and Personal attributes we would like to have:

Experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
Experience in marketing, CRM or customer analytics.
Knowledge of consent management, identity resolution or UK GDPR.
Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment.
Passion for sport and an understanding of global fan cultures.




As part of a leading global Data and AI company, you can look forward to:

A competitive salary with a generous bonus, private healthcare, critical illness life assurance at 4 x your annual salary, income protection insurance, and a rewarding pension.
EXL provides everyday financial well-being solutions, such as cash back cards, in which you can earn cashback while enjoying discounts, promotions, and offers from top retailers. We also offer a Cycle Scheme where you can save money on bikes and cycling accessories.
At EXL, we are committed to providing our employees with the tools and resources they need to succeed and excel in their careers. We offer a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities. We also support a range of learning initiatives that allow our employees to build on their existing skills and knowledge. From online courses to seminars and workshops, our employees have the opportunity to enhance their skills and stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, EXL is committed to diversity. Our company does not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, age, or disability status.
EXL employees are eligible to purchase stock as part of our Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
At EXL, we offer a flexible hybrid working model that allows employees to live a balanced, healthy lifestyle while strengthening our culture of collaboration




To be considered for this role, you must already be eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

About the role

First Choice Homes Oldham (FCHO) has an exciting opportunity for a Business Intelligence Analyst (Insight & Performance) to join our Business Intelligence team and help shape how data and insight are used across the organisation.

This is a key business partnering role where you will work with services across FCHO to understand their priorities, translate business needs into meaningful analysis and provide clear, trusted insight that supports better decisions and service improvement.

You will design and develop dashboards and reports, undertake deep-dive analysis and support statutory and regulatory reporting. You will also help FCHO move beyond hindsight reporting by identifying trends, performance drivers and emerging risks, contributing to a more proactive and insight-led organisation.

Please see the full Job Description attached at the bottom of this page.

The impact you’ll make

You will provide high-quality performance reporting and analysis that gives colleagues, leaders and the Board a clear and consistent view of organisational performance.

Act as a trusted business partner to directorates, translating service priorities into analytical and reporting requirements.
Provide proactive insight into performance, identifying trends, risks, opportunities and the root causes of performance issues.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports aligned to organisational KPIs and the performance management framework.
Support Executive, Board and Committee reporting, ensuring insight is accurate, consistent and clearly presented.
Support statutory and regulatory reporting, including Tenant Satisfaction Measures and Statistical Data Returns.
Undertake quantitative and qualitative analysis, including analysis of survey data and customer feedback.
Translate complex data into clear, engaging and actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain SQL queries and views to support reporting and analysis.
Work closely with Analytics Engineers and Data colleagues to shape and use trusted analytical datasets.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting, automation and analytical processes.
Help embed a data-driven culture by supporting colleagues to understand and use data effectively.

Our ideal candidate

You will be an analytical, curious and collaborative BI professional who can combine strong technical skills with effective stakeholder engagement and data storytelling.

A relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience in a data, analytics or technology-related field.
Experience working in a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst role.
Experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Strong SQL skills, including extracting and manipulating data.
Experience delivering performance reporting and analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data.
The ability to turn data into meaningful, actionable insight that supports decision-making.
Excellent communication, presentation and data storytelling skills.
Strong stakeholder engagement and business partnering capability.
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and accuracy.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
A proactive and collaborative approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement.

It would also be great if you have:

An A Level in Maths or Statistics.
Experience using Python or similar analytical tools.
Knowledge of predictive or advanced analytics techniques.
Experience analysing survey or customer data.
Experience supporting regulatory or statutory reporting.
Experience using Microsoft Fabric or another modern data platform.
Experience with AI-assisted tools such as Copilot, OpenAI or Gemini.
Experience within social housing or another regulated sector.

Why join FCHO?

First Choice Homes Oldham is a housing association providing safe, affordable and high-quality homes across Oldham and the surrounding areas. We own and manage more than 11,500 homes and are proud to hold the highest G1/V1 regulatory rating.

Our work is focused on providing quality homes, excellent services and thriving communities. We care deeply about our customers, colleagues and neighbourhoods and are committed to improving lives across Oldham.

What’s in it for you?

A salary of £48,750 per annum.
A 37-hour working week with hybrid working options.
30 days’ annual leave plus 8 bank holidays.
Option to purchase additional annual leave.
Defined contribution pension scheme with up to 10% employer contribution and salary exchange option.
Death in service benefit.
Healthcare cash plan covering dental, optical and physiotherapy treatments.
Private health insurance.
Employee Assistance Programme offering 24-hour confidential support.
Doctorline, giving you and your family 24/7 GP access.
Access to our colleague benefits platform, including retail discounts and wellbeing tools.
Discounted gym membership.
Professional subscriptions paid where essential for the role.

Long service awards.

Interested?

Title: Audience Data Analyst
Description:
Salary: Up to £41,440 per annum based on skills and experience

Full time; 40 hours per week

Permanent position

Based in: Covent Garden, London




To ensure a fair process, late applications will not be considered under any circumstances.




The Royal Ballet and Opera continues to lead the way in opera, ballet, music and dance both live on stage and through multiple digital platforms, from live streaming to worldwide cinema screenings. Our Covent Garden theatre has been at the heart of London and British cultural life for three centuries. We are home to two world-class Companies: The Royal Ballet and The Royal Opera.




The Royal Opera House describes the place we work, not who we are. The whole is always more than the sum of its parts – we may be a House, but three quarters of our audiences experience what we do outside this building. While our Covent Garden theatre is the nerve centre, the impact and influence of the organisation can be felt in every corner of the country, and around the world. Understanding our global audience (their behaviours, preferences and habits) is central to our mission to engage more people with our art forms through programming and commercial development, as well as reporting accurately to our funders and supporters.




We are seeking to recruit an Audience Data Analyst to join our Analytics and Insight Team as we enter a new and exciting season of ballet and opera programming. This role will focus on delivering high-quality data analysis, ensuring that we continue to develop a holistic and evolving image of RBO audiences and sales. The postholder will provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders across the organisation, enabling them to make strategic, evidence-based decisions.

The ideal candidate will have an analytical mind, with the ability to operate independently to agreed deadlines, producing high quality and accurate work for a range of stakeholders at pace. They will be able to contribute to the output of a multi-functional and collaborative team, working with a range of specialists across UX and CX Research, Pricing, Ticketing and Marketing.




The Successful Candidate Will Be Able To Demonstrate

Strong practical data analysis skills, including SQL skills
Strong numeracy, analytical reasoning and attention to detail.
The ability to understand the underlying questions of an analytics request and to translate stakeholder requests into clear, focused analysis briefs.
Strong collaboration skills, with the confidence to work constructively with stakeholders, technical colleagues and subject matter experts
Clear experience of taking analytical work from an initial question through to accurate findings, clear conclusions and actionable insight.




An Understanding Of The Below Will Be Beneficial And Highly Regarded So Please Do Reflect These In Your Application If You Have

Experience with ticketing or CRM data.
Experience working across multiple data sets.
Experience with audience, visitor, member or customer data in a performing arts or visitor attraction environment.
Experience using Python, R or another analytical programming language for data analysis or automation.




Job Description

A full job description can be found here.




Closing date for applications: 11:59pm, Sunday 20th September 2026.

Interviews will take place over two stages – the first an initial online interview via MS Teams and the second in person at ROH Covent Garden.

Applicants must have work authorisation for the UK. No agencies.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Indigo is a strategic operational partner for critical digital infrastructure. We help customers design, deploy, support and scale the infrastructure their businesses rely on, giving them greater control, consistency and confidence. Our teams work across subsea, terrestrial, wireless, data centre and NOC environments, bringing specialist expertise, 24/7 support, field services and managed services together under one accountable model.




Being part of Indigo means working in a business where operational excellence, customer trust and doing things properly matter. We support customers in complex, performance-critical environments, helping them reduce risk, protect performance and deliver with confidence. Our people are central to that mission, bringing the skill, responsiveness and accountability needed to support the next generation of digital infrastructure. As an Investors in People Gold accredited employer, we're committed to investing in the growth and development of our people.




About The Role

Reporting to the Service Management Director, the Data Analyst supports the Service Management team by producing accurate reporting, analysing service performance data and helping maintain the quality of operational data across Indigo's service portfolio.




Working closely with Service Managers, you'll produce customer and internal reports, create dashboards and visualisations, identify trends and support performance analysis. You'll play an important role in helping the business understand how services are performing and where improvements can be made.




This role would suit someone with strong analytical skills who enjoys working with data and is looking to develop a career in reporting, business intelligence or service analytics.




What You'll Do

Collect, validate and analyse data from Salesforce and other business systems.
Produce recurring customer and internal performance reports.
Create charts, dashboards and visualisations to support monthly Service Reviews.
Monitor service performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Identify trends, recurring issues and areas for improvement.
Support data quality and data cleansing activities.
Assist with maintaining reporting templates and performance dashboards.
Work with Service Managers to provide reporting and performance insight.
Support the automation and continuous improvement of reporting processes.
Ensure reporting is accurate, consistent and delivered to agreed timescales.
Assist with ad hoc analysis and reporting requests as required.




What You'll Bring




Essential

Experience, education or training in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence or a related discipline.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, data manipulation and reporting.
Ability to analyse information, identify trends and present findings clearly.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Experience producing reports, dashboards or management information.
Good organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with a range of stakeholders.
A proactive approach to learning, problem solving and continuous improvement.




Desirable

Experience using Salesforce, Power BI or similar reporting tools.
Basic SQL knowledge.
Experience creating dashboards and data visualisations.
Understanding of service management, customer support or operational environments.
Telecoms or technology sector experience.
Degree in Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Computer Science or a related discipline.
ITIL Foundation certification, or willingness to work towards it.




At Indigo, we believe our greatest strength is our people. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience and potential. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, we're here to support you.

We're looking for an Associate Data Analyst to join our Data Services & Reporting team.

In this role you’ll help to deliver reporting, dashboards and insight that support business decisions across a wide range of functions and stakeholders at Radius.

Please note that we’re looking for candidates who can demonstrate an existing foundation in data analysis.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone in the early stages of their data career who wants to build on their technical and analytical skills while working on real business challenges.

Whether you're a recent graduate with a relevant degree or have gained some initial experience in a data-focused role, this position offers the opportunity to develop your skills in SQL, reporting, dashboard development and stakeholder engagement while working across a broad range of business functions.

You'll gain exposure to large datasets, real-world business challenges and experienced data professionals who can support your continued development.

This is an office-based role, working Monday to Friday from our offices in Crewe.

Important: Unfortunately, we are unable provide visa sponsorship for this role. This includes being unable to provide future sponsorship for candidates holding a Graduate visa.

What You'll Be Doing


Helping to develop and maintain reports, dashboards and visualisations using Tableau and other reporting tools.
Writing SQL queries to extract, validate and analyse data, with support from more experienced analysts.
Supporting stakeholders with reporting requests and helping translate business questions into analytical outputs.
Performing data quality checks and investigating data issues to ensure reporting accuracy.
Working closely with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Business Analysts and wider business teams on reporting and analytical initiatives.
Contributing to continuous improvements in reporting solutions, dashboards and team processes.
Building your understanding of business processes, data structures and analytical best practices.

We're interested in candidates who can demonstrate either:


A degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology or a related discipline; or
Up to 12 months of commercial experience in a Data Analyst, Reporting Analyst, BI Analyst or similar role.

A basic understanding of SQL and experience writing simple queries.
Exposure to Tableau, Power BI or another data visualisation tool through work, university projects, placements or personal projects.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and an interest in working with data.
Good communication skills
A willingness to learn new technologies, tools and analytical techniques.

Pension

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
*Hybrid or remote for people based in the UK*




What is the job?




We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next.

This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions.

Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth.

This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey.

We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact.




What will you be doing?




Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM.
Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making.
Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics.
Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources.
Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs.
Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality.
Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders.




What do you need?




Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment.
Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders.
Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action.
A confident communicator who can explain complex analysis in simple, practical terms. You’re able to identify the what and the why to help shape decisions.
Self-starter mindset - able to navigate ambiguity and work independently.
Experience with Braze or similar CRM platforms is a strong advantage.




What we offer:




Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays
Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave




About Us




Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Title: Power BI Analyst
Description:
About Us




Birketts is a full service, UK Top 50 law firm. With a heritage spanning 160 years, we have more than 700 lawyers and legal professionals and over 600 staff based in Bristol, Cambridge, Chelmsford, Ipswich, London, Norwich and Sevenoaks. We advise businesses, government and public sector organisations and individuals in the UK and internationally across four principal practice groups: Real Estate, Corporate Services, Dispute Resolution and Private Client.




The team you will join




Our Strategic Development Team plays a key role in shaping the future growth of the business. Working closely with our legal teams, we identify opportunities for growth, diversification, and innovation across our market sectors. We conduct in-depth research, develop robust business cases, and present recommendations to leadership.




Once opportunities are approved, we lead their implementation, support their ongoing development, and measure their performance to ensure long-term success and value for the business.




Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. We work alongside our Business Change and Projects Team, combining commercial insight with operational and technology expertise to deliver impactful initiatives. Our focus is on exploring and developing opportunities that complement and strengthen our core legal services, helping the business adapt, grow, and thrive in a changing market.




The work you will be doing




Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports. Create visually appealing, accurate, and user-friendly dashboards tailored to business needs.
Regularly update and refine dashboards based on team feedback.
Analyse data to uncover trends, insights, and actionable recommendations for various departments within the firm.
Collaborate with IT colleagues to ensure seamless integration of data sources and maintain data quality for reporting purposes.
Ensure that dashboards and datasets perform efficiently and meet user expectations. Identify and resolve performance issues promptly.
Adhere to established guidelines for creating consistent and effective reports. Strive for clarity and simplicity in presenting data insights.




Please note that this job profile is not an exhaustive list of duties but merely an outline of the key components of the role. You may be required by your line manager to take on additional responsibilities when requested.




What we are looking for




At least 3 years proficiency in Power BI development
Demonstrated ability to create and manage dashboards, with strong skills in DAX, Power Query, and data modelling.
Ability to analyse and interpret data to produce meaningful insights and actionable recommendations.
Basic knowledge of SQL and Familiarity with querying databases to extract and manipulate data.
Strong attention to detail to ensure data accuracy and report quality.
Comfortable working with team members and IT colleagues to deliver shared objectives.
Experience with advanced Power BI features, such as custom visuals and row-level security is desirable
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or similar data platform technologies.
Knowledge of data preparation and Extract, Transform, Load processes.
Relevant certifications in Power BI or data analysis tools would be desirable




Hybrid Working




Birketts is a flexible business which has embraced a hybrid working model where our colleagues enjoy a mix of home and office working.




This role attracts a split of 60% office days and 40% working from home days per week, with a minimum requirement of 2 days spent in the Ipswich office.




We welcome applications from people looking for flexible, agile, and part-time roles and we are happy to explore your preferred working patterns as part of your application.




Benefits




As a Birketts colleague, you will be eligible to receive a wide range of benefits:

25 days holiday (FTE) plus Bank Holidays
Long Service holiday award - 1 extra week every 10 years continuous service
Private Healthcare with BUPA (offered after probation is passed)
Scottish Widows Pension Scheme (5% employer / 5% Employee)
Staff Profit Share and Individual Performance Bonus Scheme
Salary sacrifice (Pensions, Staff Profit Share)
Life Assurance - 4 x salary / Permanent Health Insurance
Paid CSR Day
Enhanced Maternity/Paternity Leave
Subsidised gym membership
Electric car scheme
Dress for your Day Policy




You can find out more on our website: https://www.birketts.co.uk/recognition-reward-benefits/




Inclusivity and Culture




At Birketts, our culture is driven by ambition and a commitment to positively impact all the communities we serve. We are dedicated to the success, development, and wellbeing of our colleagues, helping them achieve their goals and seize the opportunities that come with our growth.




Birketts is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our policy is unequivocal: we do not tolerate discrimination based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, or sexual orientation.




We pride ourselves on being an inclusive organisation that actively promotes equality of opportunity for all, valuing the right mix of talent, skills, and potential. We welcome applications from a diverse range of candidates, and selection for roles is based solely on individual merit.




If you require this advert in an accessible format, please visit https://diversityjobsgroup.com/company/birketts/




Artificial Intelligence (AI)




At Birketts, we recognise the evolving role of artificial intelligence (AI) in the legal profession and recruitment. We welcome innovation and understand that candidates may use AI tools to support their job applications. However, we expect all applicants to use AI responsibly and ethically.




Our expectations regarding AI use in applications:

Your application should reflect your own voice, experiences, and insights. AI may assist in structuring or refining your responses, but it must not replace your personal input.
Do not use AI to misrepresent your qualifications, experiences, or skills. Any form of exaggeration or fabrication may result in rejection from the process.
If you have used AI tools to assist with your application, be prepared to discuss how and why you used them during the interview process.
Do not submit content generated by AI tools that may include personal or sensitive data not intended for public disclosure.
AI-generated content should be reviewed and edited by you to ensure accuracy, relevance, and alignment with the role and our firm’s values.




We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment practices. The use of AI should enhance, not

compromise, your application. We encourage candidates to demonstrate critical thinking, commercial awareness, and a genuine interest in our firm.




If you have any questions about our expectations or the use of AI in your application, please contact our Talent Acquisition Team via talent@birketts.co.uk

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
Contract type: Permanent

Hours: Full-time, 35 hours

Location: Head Office, Nottingham (Hybrid working, minimum 2 days per week)

Application process: Please apply via the application button which will direct you to our careers site. If you require any adjustments to assist you in applying, please contact careers@thenottingham.com




At Nottingham Building Society our talent acquisition approach is rooted in openness and inclusive hiring, so even if you don’t feel you tick every box, we’d still genuinely love to hear from you.




We are investing in the future of data, creating a brand-new enterprise Data Platform on Microsoft Fabric and Azure that will transform how we use data across the organisation. As a Data Engineer, you'll be at the heart of this initiative, helping to build the platform, frameworks and capabilities that will support everything from business insight and regulatory reporting to advanced analytics and AI. This is a rare opportunity to influence the design and direction of a modern data ecosystem from day one.




Joining a collaborative and forward-thinking team, you'll combine technical expertise with innovation to deliver scalable, secure and high-performing data solutions. You'll work closely with colleagues across the business, helping to unlock the value of data and drive better outcomes for our members. If you're passionate about modern data engineering and want to play a key role in shaping something new, we'd love to hear from you.




Here’s a taste of what you will be doing as a Data Engineer at Nottingham Building Society:




Build Our New Data Platform - Design, develop and operate a scalable, secure and high-performing data platform using Microsoft Fabric, Azure and Power BI technologies.
Develop Data Integration Solutions - Create and maintain robust ingestion and transformation pipelines, integrating data from internal systems and third-party platforms including Salesforce, Sopra Banking Services, CACI and Experian.
Engineer Modern Data Architectures - Design Lakehouse, Warehouse and Delta Lake solutions using medallion architectures to support enterprise analytics and reporting.
Deliver Analytics-Ready Data Assets - Build trusted, well-modelled datasets and semantic models that enable self-service BI, regulatory reporting and data-driven decision making.
Champion DataOps & DevOps - Develop automated deployment pipelines, CI/CD processes and engineering standards using Azure DevOps and Git-based development practices.
Drive Data Quality & Governance - Implement controls, monitoring, lineage and governance frameworks that ensure data remains reliable, secure and compliant.
Monitor & Optimise Performance - Continuously improve platform performance, observability and operational resilience through proactive monitoring and alerting.
Collaborate Across The Business - Work closely with Data Architects, Analysts and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that create meaningful value for members and colleagues.




About You:




Microsoft Fabric Expertise - You have strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric technologies including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Spark and Power BI.
Strong Engineering Skills - You're proficient in SQL, Python and PySpark, with experience developing scalable and maintainable data solutions.
Modern Data Platform Experience - You've successfully built, enhanced or operated cloud-based data platforms, ideally within Azure environments.
Data Architecture Knowledge - You understand data modelling, ELT/ETL design, Delta Lake principles, data quality frameworks and modern engineering best practices.
Cloud & DevOps Capability - You have experience with Azure services, automation, CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code approaches.
Collaborative Mindset - You enjoy working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, building strong relationships and delivering outcomes together.
Continuous Improvement Focus - You're naturally curious, enjoy exploring new technologies and are passionate about improving processes, standards and ways of working.
Quality & Purpose Driven - You take pride in delivering high-quality solutions, balancing technical excellence with a commitment to creating positive outcomes for customers, colleagues and communities.




Reward & Benefits:




Competitive Package: Fair salary benchmarked against market data, annual discretionary bonus, and 29 days holiday plus bank holidays.
Health & Wellbeing: Access to Medicash, mental health first aiders, and a suite of wellbeing resources to support you inside and outside of work.
Work-Life Balance: 35-hour working week for full-time roles, with flexibility to help you perform at your best.
Career Growth: Ongoing personal and professional development, we’ll support your ambitions and help you grow your potential.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a friendly, values-led team that genuinely cares about doing the right thing for colleagues and customers.
Giving Back: Use two paid volunteering days each year to support causes close to your heart, through our Samuel Fox Foundation.
Sustainability Focus: Join a business committed to reducing its carbon footprint and making a positive impact on the environment.
Free access to Octopus Money: Financial coaching & tools that help you plan, manage, and make the most of your money.




Embracing Diversity Together:




We proudly embrace and celebrate diversity as a fundamental cornerstone of our values. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is not just essential for our success but is also a reflection of the vibrant communities we serve. Our commitment to diversity extends beyond our internal culture to the way we approach advertising and engage with our customers.




Our commitment means actively working to eliminate barriers and biases that may hinder equal opportunities within our organisation. We strive to ensure that all individuals, regardless of background, have an equal chance to thrive and advance in their careers.




We acknowledge that diversity is not just a goal to be achieved but a continuous journey toward creating an environment that embraces differences and promotes equal opportunities for all. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, creativity, and a sense of belonging for every member of our community.

Job Summary

The Health and Safety Executive (HSE) is Britain’s national regulator for workplace health and safety. We are dedicated to protecting people and places and helping everyone lead safer and healthier lives.

The Change Team sits within our Operational Services Division and is comprised of three key pillars:


Transformation Office,
Programme & Project Management (“PPM”)
Business Design & Change (“BDC”).


These pillars contain professional practitioners who are deployed to projects and programmes within HSE, and each pillar is led by a Head of Change.

The Business Analyst (BA) role sits in the Business Design & Change Management (BDCM) pillar. The Business Analyst will work alongside other professionals, e.g. other Analysts, Business Design & Change Practitioners, Business Architects, and operational experts. The role is a key position in designing, building and implementing new operating models and digital services in line with HSE’s strategic priorities, focusing on efficiency, effectiveness, regulatory outcomes, and improving the user experience. They are responsible, at a project level, for baselining current activities, articulating business and user requirements, designing and implementing new services, processes, organisational structures and ways of working, as well as providing continuous improvement support to HSE’s operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to help us lead, drive and deliver significant change across HSE, driven by a new strategy and a number of new and challenging transformation programmes. You will grow your skills as part of our growing community of practice and will mentor or manage more Junior Business Analysts.

Part time working hours are available for this role. We can accept part time applicants who can commit to working a minimum of 30 hours per week.

Job Description

You will work within multidisciplinary teams to support the delivery of the various organisational benefits and enhancements. You will be responsible for supporting work across digital and transformation projects to articulate business and user requirements, design and implement new services, processes, organisational structures and ways of working. You will also provide continuous improvement support to HSE’s operations.

Key Responsibilities


Undertake business analytics, including performance and productivity baselining, demand analysis, impact and feasibility analysis, scenario modelling, activity-based costings, and benefits tracking to support the build of comprehensive transformation plans.
Collaborate with multi-disciplinary professionals and operational teams in the design and delivery of services and functions, which are efficient, effective and user centric across the end-to-end process.
Work with stakeholders to help gather and refine requirements for future operating models, using appropriate methodologies and approaches.
Understand and document the baseline and current state of services and functions, including end to end processes and user journeys.
Design future state processes, workflows, and user journeys, contributing to the production of full end to end target operating models and organisational designs, through defining operational pilots, test scenarios etc., reporting on outcomes and results, adjusting proposed solutions as appropriate.
Work with operational teams to ensure ongoing process control, performance, and compliance through the development of operational frameworks.
Identify and manage important stakeholders, tailoring communication to their needs, and work with teams effectively and collaboratively across the organisation.

Title: Category Manager
Description:
Category Manager – FMCG

Location: Nottingham

Sector: FMCG / Consumer Goods




The Role




An established and growing FMCG business is looking for a commercially focused Category Manager to lead category strategy and development across key retail customers.

This is a highly commercial role, using shopper, market and retailer data to identify growth opportunities, influence customer plans and support the wider commercial strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Own and develop category strategies and customer-specific category plans
Analyse market, shopper and retailer data to identify trends, opportunities and risks
Translate data and insights into clear commercial recommendations
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Customer teams

Identify opportunities across range, distribution, pricing, promotions, merchandising and NPD

Monitor competitor activity, market performance and category trends

Use data and insight to drive category growth, revenue and profitability

3–5+ years' FMCG Category Management / Category Insight experience
Experience working with major UK retailers
Strong understanding of category, shopper and market data
Experience using Nielsen/Circana, Kantar, IRI or similar data sources
Strong commercial understanding and the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations
Confidence presenting insights and recommendations to customers and senior stakeholders
Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills
Ideally, experience within FMCG, consumer goods, retail or a related category

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity for a commercially minded Category Manager to join a well-established consumer business, working across key retail customers and having a genuine influence on category growth and commercial strategy.
